w.name: Vivid Notions

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG and boosts Elemental Skill DMG and overall Elemental DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Varesa.

w.name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
w.text: High CRIT Rate with an Elemental DMG bonus that stacks during on-field time.

w.name: Crane's Echoing Call

w.name: Blackcliff Agate
w.text: CRIT DMG catalyst with an ATK boost after defeating enemies; weak against single bosses.

a.text: Greatly increases Plunging Attack damage by building stacks from Varesa’s combat actions. One of her strongest overall sets.
Grants 40% CRIT Rate after consuming Nightsoul points, making it a powerful alternative for Varesa. Avoid overcapping CRIT Rate.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid 2-piece combination for boosting Varesa’s Plunging Attack damage.

t.name: Plunge & Punishment
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika adds off-field Pyro and buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse provides healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro/Electro RES shred.

t.name: Natlan CrossFit
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse heals, buffs ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

t.name: Air Traffic Control
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Xianyun buffs Plunging Attacks and heals.

t.name: Bat Mobile
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs, and Chevreuse heals, boosts ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

why.v:
Plunge Hypercarry: Maximize Varesa’s enhanced Plunging Attack windows.
Nightsoul CRIT Alternative: Use a strong existing Codex set before farming Long Night’s Oath.

seo.about: Varesa is a 5-star Electro Main DPS built around fast Charged Attacks and powerful Plunging Attacks. Her Skill builds Nightsoul points, unlocking an enhanced state and a special Burst for high Plunge damage.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri

Boosts off-field Elemental Skill damage. Strong alternative to Husk, depending on weapon and team buffs.
Team-buff option: grants Elemental DMG Bonus after Skill, with stronger benefits in qualifying Hexerei teams.

t.name: Rock & Reload
t.text: Navia drives Geo damage; Albedo adds off-field hits and Crystallize. Durin supplies Pyro and buffs; Nicole shields and buffs.

t.name: Chemical Romance
t.text: Lohen leads Cryo damage; Durin enables Melt. Albedo contributes Geo and Hexerei buffs while Nicole protects the team.

t.name: Fullmetal Father
t.text: Arlecchino drives Pyro damage. Albedo adds Geo and Crystallize; Xilonen shreds RES while Nicole supports and shields.

t.name: Hopeless Impact
t.text: Noelle drives Geo and heals; Albedo adds off-field hits. Gorou buffs DEF, while Durin provides Pyro and team utility.

why.v:
Hexerei Team Buffer: Choose when Albedo’s teamwide damage buffs are more valuable than maximizing his personal Skill hits.
Personal Skill Damage: Choose when you want Albedo’s off-field Skill to contribute the most personal damage.

seo.about: Albedo deals consistent off-field Geo damage through his Skill. Hexerei upgrades add valuable team buffs, especially alongside other Hexerei characters.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate and ATK buffs from Skill hits and taking damage. Best without shields, but watch for CRIT overcap.

w.name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf

w.name: Serpent Spine

w.name: Earth Shaker
w.text: It's one of Kinich's best accessible weapons.

w.name: Tidal Shadow

w.name: "Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword"

a.text: Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Kinich consumes Nightsoul points, making it his best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 18% ATK and up to 50% DMG Bonus while Burning enemies are present, making it a strong alternative for Kinich in Burning teams.
Provides 15% Dendro DMG and 20% Elemental Skill DMG, offering a flexible option for boosting Kinich’s Dendro and Skill damage.

t.name: Kinich Me Outside
t.text: Kinich drives on-field Burning damage, Emilie adds off-field Dendro damage, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin supplies Pyro application, Dendro RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Ajaw & Order
t.text: Kinich deals powerful Skill damage while Emilie adds Dendro damage. Mavuika maintains Pyro for Burning, and Bennett provides healing and ATK buffs.

t.name: Let Him Cook
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Xiangling maintains Pyro, and Bennett heals and buffs ATK. Iansan offers extra ATK support, though another Dendro support may offer more.

t.name: Free to Burn
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Pyro Traveler provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and DMG Bonus.

why.v:
Burning DPS: Prioritize Kinich's Skill damage with consistent Burning, strong ATK buffs, and a teammate carrying Deepwood Memories.
Burgeon Option: Add Hydro and off-field Pyro for Burgeon reactions while preserving enough Burning uptime for frequent Scalespiker Cannons.
Unfinished Reverie: A strong alternative to Obsidian Codex in Burning teams, especially with excellent substats or a CRIT Rate weapon.
Budget Skill DPS: Use craftable Earth Shaker and Obsidian Codex with affordable Pyro supports to maximize Scalespiker Cannon damage.
Low ER Setup: Focus on ATK and CRIT instead of excessive ER when Bursting every rotation would sacrifice valuable Skill damage.

seo.about: Kinich is a 5★ Dendro on-field DPS who builds Nightsoul points to fire powerful Scalespiker Cannons. Burning and Burgeon help him generate points faster and maximize his damage.

vars.title: Burning Cannon DPS
vars.stats: ATK and CRIT take priority; Codex supplies CRIT Rate.
vars.teams: Stable Pyro for Burning; Deepwood on another teammate.
vars.when: Maintain Burning to support consistent Scalespiker cannon cycles.
vars.cond: Avoid CRIT overcap with Obsidian Codex.

vars.title: Burgeon Cannon DPS
vars.stats: Maintain ATK/CRIT with enough ER for rotation.
vars.teams: Hydro plus controlled Pyro to trigger Burgeon.
vars.when: Trade the pure Burning setup for Burgeon damage and Nightsoul generation.
vars.cond: Burgeon trigger should build EM as appropriate.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: High CD and a strong damage bonus while near enemies. Positioning matters.

w.name: The First Great Magic

w.name: Thundering Pulse

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun

w.name: Song of Stillness

w.name: Blackcliff Warbow

t.name: Starstruck

t.name: Moonstruck

why.v:
Furina CRIT Setup: Use Marechaussee Hunter when reliable HP changes maintain its CR bonus.
Budget Flight: A lower-cost setup that retains Chasca’s charged-shell damage.
Swirl Support: A niche alternative when Chasca’s team value matters more than her own damage.

seo.about: Chasca is an aerial on-field DPS who fires Charged Attack shells converted to Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo. Her best teams supply these elements and amplify her multi-element damage.

Team Support: Trade personal damage for team buffs and reliable uptime.

Provides EM after triggering reactions.
Boosts teamwide Stellar Glimmer damage after triggering its reactions. Best for off-field support when no teammate already carries it.

t.name: On-Field Live Wire
t.text: Mitya leads with powerful Stellar-Conduct attacks, while Yae adds Electro damage, Odette boosts reactions, and Valeriy shields and buffs.

t.name: Off-Field Puppet
t.text: Sandrone leads the damage while Mitya supplies off-field Stellar-Conduct support. Odette boosts reactions, and Valeriy adds protection.

t.name: Maximum Security
t.text: Wriothesley deals on-field Cryo damage while Mitya supports Stellar-Conduct. Cryo Traveler adds application, and Valeriy provides protection.

t.name: Economitya F2P
t.text: Mitya drives Stellar-Conduct while Valeriy shields, Sucrose shares EM and groups enemies, and Qiqi supplies Cryo and healing.

why.v:
On-field Stellar-Conduct: Use Hold Skill and enhanced Charged Attacks for Stellar-Conduct damage. Prioritize EM, CRIT, and uninterrupted attack windows.
Off-field Support: Use Tap Skill and swap out to provide teamwide EM and Stellar-Conduct damage. Burst is generally optional.
Premium Conduct: Pair Mitya with Odette, Yae Miko, and Valeriy for strong reaction buffs, Electro damage, and shielding.
Accessible Team: Use affordable Cryo and Electro teammates, with Sucrose for EM sharing. Prioritize reliable reactions and protection.
C1 Energy Comfort: C1 restores Energy and improves Beacon generation, reducing ER demands. Invest more into EM and CRIT when Burst uptime is comfortable.

seo.about: Flexible Stellar-Conduct unit who can be played as either an on-field DPS or off-field support. His C0 dmg is solid, while his Cons significantly boost both his personal dmg and team utility.

Noblesse Oblige is a strong alternative for Valeriy, providing a 20% teamwide ATK buff after his Burst, especially when another teammate already carries Heart of the Furnace.
Combines two ATK bonuses for a simple support build when a suitable four-piece set is unavailable.

t.name: Current Situation

t.name: Short Circuit

t.name: Guilty as Charged

t.name: Budget Conductors

General Burst Support: A generic support option outside specialized Conduct teams.

seo.about: Valeriy is a flexible support who provides shielding and buffs Electro teams, especially those built around SSC. Best in teams that can fully use his buffs. He is a specialized support.

why.v:
Pyro Hexerei: Pair Varka with a second Anemo and two Pyro teammates for maximum passive damage. Nicole, Durin, and Bennett are excellent partners.
Hydro Core: Use two Hydro teammates with an Anemo support. Furina and Vodyanitsa offer strong buffs.
Cryo Stellar Swirl: Pair Prune and Odette with another Cryo teammate.
Furina CRIT Build: Marechaussee Hunter is a strong alternative with Furina.
Accessible Setup: Use accessible supports and a craftable claymore. Prioritize Skill DMG, balanced CRIT stats.

seo.about: Varka is an Anemo on-field DPS built around fast, aggressive combat and reaction driven teams. He shines with strong supports, especially in Stellar Swirl teams.

seo.about: Xilonen is a versatile Geo support who shreds enemy RES while providing strong healing and team buffs. She fits into a huge variety of teams thanks to her low field time and excellent support utility.

t.name: Frostbound Scholars
t.text: Yae supplies Electro for Stellar-Conduct, Odette raises Stellar damage, and Qiqi keeps the team healthy while Traveler stays on the field.

t.name: Frost and Thunder
t.text: Yae and Odette boost Stellar-Conduct damage while Alyosha offers healing and extra buffs. Traveler uses field time to build Frostglow.

t.name: Swirl Society
t.text: Mizuki drives Stellar Swirl while Traveler supplies Cryo and Burst damage. Odette boosts Stellar reactions and Sucrose adds grouping and EM.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: Fischl applies Electro for Stellar-Conduct while Rosaria adds Cryo damage. Diona provides shields and healing for a budget option.

why.v:
On-field Conduct: Use Disenchantment and stay on the field to build Frostglow through coordinated attacks. Finish with your enhanced Charged Attack and Burst.
Off-field Swirl: Use Heart of the Furnace or Tenacity when another Anemo character drives Stellar Swirl. Cast Skill and Burst during their rotation.
CRIT Rate caution: Account for conditional CRIT bonuses from the artifact set, Cryo Resonance and Traveler passives before chasing more CRIT Rate.
Weapon investment: Exaiphanes Blade is free and often better than premium swords. You do not need to pull a five star weapon for this build.

seo.about: Cryo Traveler is a flexible Cryo DMG dealer who powers Stellar-Conduct & Stellar Swirl teams. They fight on the field in Stellar-Conduct & offer off-field DMG in Stellar Swirl. Their strongest attacks rely on building Frostglow stacks before using their Burst.

t.name: Headed to jail

why.v:
Aggravate Driver: Choose for frequent Aggravate reactions and flexible Skill rotations.
Overloaded Duelist: Use Chevreuse’s resistance reduction and buffs for consistent Electro damage.
Shielded Budget: A lower-cost build that keeps her fast gun-and-lunge gameplay.

seo.about: Clorinde is an on-field Electro DPS who converts Bond of Life into rapid pistol shots and lunges. Her Skill supplies self-healing, and she performs well in Aggravate, Overloaded, and Electro-Charged teams.

why.v:
Aggravate DPS: Use Thundering Fury, an Electro Goblet and Dendro support. Fischl is particularly valuable for team damage.
Gilded Alternative: Gilded Dreams is a good choice when its artifact substats beat your Thundering Fury pieces.
Overload: Run only Pyro and Electro teammates with Chevreuse. Xiangling needs considerable Energy Recharge.
CRIT Rate: Keqing gains 15% CRIT Rate after using her Burst, so avoid exceeding 100% after buffs.

seo.about: Keqing is a fast Electro DPS who teleports into combat and chains infused attacks with her Burst. She shines in Aggravate teams, where frequent Electro hits trigger reactions and work especially well with Fischl. Her flexible rotations also support Overload and Lunar-Charged teams.

seo.about: Beidou deals off-field Electro damage through her bouncing Burst and counters attacks with her Skill. She excels in multi-target fights but often needs an Electro battery and enough ER.

t.name: Wushou Royal Court
t.text: Citlali enables powerful Melt plunges and lowers Pyro resistance. Nicole adds buffs and shielding, while Xianyun boosts plunge damage and heals.

t.name: Cloudborne Vaporize
t.text: Furina enables Vaporize and boosts damage. Xianyun buffs plunges and heals the team, while Bennett provides ATK and Pyro particles.

t.name: Frostfire Festival
t.text: Citlali supplies Cryo for Melt, Bennett buffs ATK, and Sucrose shares EM and reduces Pyro resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Budget Lion Dance
t.text: Use Normal Attacks between plunges to trigger Xingqiu’s Hydro swords. Sucrose supports Vaporize while Bennett buffs and heals.

why.v:
Melt DPS: Crimson Witch with EM Sands works well when Citlali or another Cryo teammate consistently enables Melt.
Vaporize DPS: Use Rainslasher or a premium damage weapon with reliable Hydro application from Furina or Xingqiu.
Marechaussee: With Marechaussee and C6, aim for no more than 44% sheet CRIT Rate for Charmed Cloudstrider.
Before C4: Prioritize enough ER to Burst consistently. C4 greatly reduces his Energy needs.

seo.about: Gaming is a Pyro Plunges DPS who repeatedly launches Charmed Cloudstrider using his Skill & Burst. He excels in Melt & Vaporize teams, where his strong DMG & self-healing make him a powerful four-star carry. His Burst needs enough Energy to stay active each rotation.

vars.title: Melt Plunge

vars.teams: Reliable Cryo aura; healer and plunge support.
vars.when: Use when Gaming can Melt a meaningful share of his plunge hits.
vars.cond: Check aura stability and field-time requirements.

w.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
w.text: Top premium Melt bow with CRIT DMG and a large Charged Attack bonus after teammates trigger reactions. Strongest in Melt teams.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: High CRIT DMG and Charged Attack damage. Its ATK bonus improves with additional Cryo teammates. Especially strong in Freeze and Mono Cryo.

w.name: Hunter's Path
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and boosts Charged Attack damage using EM, making it a standout Melt option. Best for Melt. Watch CRIT Rate.

w.name: Amos' Bow
w.text: A classic Ganyu option. Its ATK and Charged Attack bonus grow with arrow travel time, including her Frostflake Bloom. Good in both Melt and Freeze.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Offers huge CRIT DMG and a damage bonus while Ganyu stays near enemies. Its low Base ATK favors external ATK buffs. Stay within passive range.

w.name: Flower-Wreathed Feathers
w.text: Gives ATK and strong Charged Attack damage bonuses. A useful four-star gacha bow for both Melt and Freeze. Stronger with refinements. R5 improves its value.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: CRIT Rate and a debuff that increases Charged Attack damage against marked enemies. Avoid excess CRIT in Freeze.

w.name: Hamayumi
w.text: A reliable craftable Melt bow that buffs Charged Attacks, especially when Ganyu keeps her Burst unused. Best for Melt with full Energy. R5 recommended.

a.text: Reliable Melt set with 80 EM and a 35% Charged Attack damage bonus.
Best for traditional Freeze against freezable enemies. Adds substantial CRIT Rate against Cryo and Frozen targets.
Best for Burnmelt when teammates maintain Burning on enemies. Gives a large conditional damage bonus.

t.name: Frostbound Royalty
t.text: Furina buffs and supplies Hydro, Escoffier heals and lowers Cryo and Hydro resistance, and Shenhe empowers Ganyu’s Cryo damage.

t.name: Embers in the Snow
t.text: Emilie and Dehya maintain Burning for Ganyu’s Melt shots. Bennett buffs ATK and heals, while Dehya provides interruption resistance.

t.name: Melt the Mountains
t.text: Xiangling applies Pyro for Melt, Bennett boosts ATK, and Zhongli shields Ganyu while she charges her shots.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: Xiangling enables Melt, Bennett buffs and heals, and Sucrose shares EM and reduces Cryo resistance. Careful aiming is needed without a shield.

why.v:
Melt DPS: Use Wanderer’s Troupe, an EM Sands, and consistent off-field Pyro. Her Burst can interfere with the Pyro aura.
Freeze DPS: Use Blizzard Strayer and focus on CRIT DMG. Frozen enemies give more CRIT Rate through the set bonus.
Burnmelt: Unfinished Reverie shines when Burning stays active through Emilie or a Dendro and Pyro combination.
Off-field Burst: Prioritize her Burst and enough ER to cast every rotation. A support set or Favonius Warbow can help the team.

seo.about: Ganyu is a Cryo damage dealer whose Frostflake Charged Shots deliver powerful area damage. She excels in Freeze, Melt, and Burning teams. Freeze helps control groups, while Melt rewards precise aiming and reliable Pyro application. Her Burst also makes her a useful off-field Cryo option.

vars.title: Melt Charged Shots
vars.stats: EM Sands can work; prioritize CRIT DMG and charged-shot damage.
vars.teams: Consistent off-field Pyro and interruption protection.
vars.when: Use for high-damage Frostflake Arrow Melt hits.
vars.cond: Needs reliable Pyro application.

vars.title: Freeze / Mono Cryo

vars.teams: Hydro for Freeze or strong Cryo buffers.
vars.when: Blizzard Strayer offers easy CRIT Rate when enemies stay Cryo-affected.
vars.cond: Freeze is unreliable against some bosses.

vars.title: Burnmelt
vars.stats: EM is valuable; still balance ATK and CRIT.
vars.teams: Dendro and Pyro teammates that maintain Burning.
vars.when: Use Burning to sustain Pyro aura for Ganyu’s Melt shots.
vars.cond: Unfinished Reverie needs stable Burning uptime.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Can provide teamwide Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG and ATK buffs after Kirara triggers reactions.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and a modest HP bonus. Better for personal damage than pure shield utility. Use for a hybrid damage build.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Generates neutral Energy particles to help the whole team recharge. Build enough CR to trigger its passive. Favonius must CRIT while Kirara is on field.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Can reset her Skill cooldown for another shield refresh and extra Dendro particles. Passive needs a Skill hit to trigger.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: Offers team Energy Recharge based on Kirara’s EM, though a shield build usually stacks HP instead. More useful with some EM investment.

w.name: Sapwood Blade
w.text: Craftable sword with ER. Dendro reactions create a leaf that one teammate can collect for an EM buff. A teammate must pick up the leaf.

a.text: Two HP bonuses strengthen Kirara’s shield without relying on reaction timing or Burst uptime.
Triggering a reaction grants teammates EM.
Reduces enemy Dendro resistance after Skill or Burst hits.

t.name: Lightning Delivery
t.text: Keqing and Fischl trigger Aggravate while Kazuha groups and buffs Electro damage. Kirara provides shielding and Quicken support.

t.name: Forest Express
t.text: Tighnari deals Spread damage with support from Nahida and Yae Miko. Kirara shields him and generates extra Dendro particles.

t.name: Bloom Delivery
t.text: Nilou enables Bountiful Cores. Nahida supplies Dendro, Kokomi applies Hydro and heals, and Kirara shields against Bloom damage.

t.name: Budget Courier
t.text: Lisa and Fischl deal Aggravate damage. Dendro Traveler maintains Quicken while Kirara protects the team with her shield.

why.v:
Full Shield: Use two HP sets and triple HP main stats for the strongest general shield.

why.v:

C4 Shield Support: At C4, her Burst creates a shield. Use HP and ER with Prototype Amber for a separate support build.

why.v:
Classic Vaporize: Use Crimson Witch with Xingqiu or Yelan. Balance HP, EM, and CRIT, and learn Charged Attack cancels.
Furina Teams: Use Marechaussee Hunter with frequent HP changes. A reliable healer helps build Fanfare and keep the set active.
C0 Combos: Jump cancel Charged Attacks to save stamina. C1 removes their stamina cost during her Skill and allows easier dash cancels.
Burst Timing: Use Burst for emergency healing, area damage, or invulnerability frames. Do not sacrifice damage just to Burst every rotation.

seo.about: Hu Tao is an on-field Pyro DPS who uses her Skill to strengthen Charged Attacks and trigger powerful Vaporize reactions. She converts HP into damage and rewards careful stamina management. Double Hydro teams are especially comfortable, while Furina teams need reliable healing.

why.v:
Hexerei DPS: Complete Witch’s Homework for Klee and a second Hexerei teammate. Prioritize Burst uptime and her Spark-enhanced attacks.
Overload: Pair Klee with Chevreuse and off-field Electro. High Pyro application drives reactions, but small foes may be knocked away.
Furina Carry: Furina enables Marechaussee Hunter and HP-dependent weapons. Bring a healer to sustain the team and build Fanfare.
Burning: Emilie and Durin support Burning damage. Unfinished Reverie is an alternative if farming a dedicated Burning build.
C2 Support: At C2, Klee can apply 23% enemy DEF reduction with her Skill and use Thrilling Tales to support a main damage dealer.

seo.about: Klee is an on-field Pyro DPS who floods enemies with explosive attacks. Complete her Witch’s Homework and pair her with another Hexerei character to unlock powerful Spark-enhanced attacks. Overload and Furina teams are excellent, while her C2 also offers DEF shred support.

Favonius Battery: Choose Favonius Warbow and prioritize CRIT Rate. Trade personal damage for smoother team rotations.
Lunar-Charged: Pair him with reliable Lunar-Charged enablers. Keep CRIT and ER high, with EM as a useful secondary stat.
Overload Support: Chevreuse teams can use Scroll buffs and Electro application. Full EM is situational when Ororon owns many Overloaded reactions.
Double Electro: With Fischl or another Electro teammate, his ER needs often drop substantially. Shift those rolls toward CRIT and ATK.

why.v:
Standard Bountiful Bloom: Use two HP% sets and three HP% main stats. Reach as close to 74,444 HP as possible with buffs and Hydro Resonance.
F2P Bloom: Use Serenity’s Call or Iron Sting with HP artifacts.
Lunar-Bloom Support: In Nefer teams, Bountiful Cores are replaced by Seeds of Deceit.
Nilou Bloom Ownership: If Nilou triggers many Blooms, EM becomes more valuable after you secure strong HP.
Comfort Rotation: Use Skill then three Whirling Steps for her Hydro aura. Her Burst is optional, so do not sacrifice HP to force it.

seo.about: Nilou transforms ordinary Bloom into fast, powerful Bountiful Cores when her party uses only Hydro and Dendro. Stack HP to strengthen the whole team’s Bloom damage, and bring a healer for core self-damage. She can also support Lunar-Bloom teams, which require a different setup.

w.text: Can reset her multi-hit Hold Skill for extra Cryo particles and improved shield coverage.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: Provides ER and team ATK/EM buffs when its sigils activate; buff timing can be inconsistent.

w.name: Breezeborne Refrain
w.text: Provides ER and a team Stellar Glimmer DMG buff after using Skill.

w.name: Recurve Bow
w.text: HP% improves her shield and healing, but provides no Energy support for her Burst. Need more ER from artifacts.

a.text: Buffs party ATK after Burst. Best for ATK-scaling carries when nobody else uses Noblesse.
Witch's Revelation follow-up paws can maintain ATK buffs during Cryo Swirl or Superconduct/Stellar reactions.
Converts Burst healing into extra damage for the active character when Noblesse is already covered.

t.name: The Purrfect Storm
t.text: Sandrone drives Stellar-Conduct; Yae supplies Electro and Odette buffs the reaction. C6 Diona shields and buffs from her Burst field.

t.name: Cat-5 Snowstorm
t.text: Vesna drives Stellar Swirl, Odette enables and buffs it, and Faruzan boosts Anemo damage. C6 Diona supplies shields and reaction buffs.

t.name: Freeze Frame
t.text: Ayaka deals Cryo damage, Mona applies Hydro and boosts Burst damage, and Kazuha groups and shreds Cryo RES. Diona batteries Ayaka.

t.name: Melted Ice Cream
t.text: Diona shields Ganyu's Charged Shots, Bennett buffs ATK, and Xiangling applies Pyro for Reverse Melt. Avoid Diona Burst if it steals Melts.

why.v:
Stellar-Conduct C6: 4pc Tenacity with Witch’s Revelation; shield and buff Sandrone/Cyno teams with Cryo + Electro reactions.
Stellar Swirl C6: 4pc Tenacity and Favonius/Breezeborne; shield Vesna while buffing Stellar Swirl inside Burst.
Cryo Battery: Sacrificial Bow and 4pc Noblesse; double Hold Skill for more Cryo particles and shield coverage.
Healing Focus: 4pc Song of Days Past and HP%/Healing Bonus; use when another ally carries Noblesse.

seo.about: Diona is a Cryo support who shields with her Hold Skill, heals with her Burst, and generates Cryo particles. At C6 she grants EM to healthier allies; with Witch's Revelation unlocked, she also buffs Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl teams.

vars.title: Stellar-Conduct C6
vars.stats: ER to Burst reliably, then HP% and Favonius CRIT.
vars.teams: Stellar-Conduct enabler (Sandrone, Odette or Cryo Traveler), Electro unit and C6 Diona.
vars.when: Witch’s Revelation follow-up Icy Paws help sustain Tenacity while her C6 Burst area boosts reaction damage.
vars.cond: C6 + Witch’s Revelation unlocked; active ally in Burst field
vars.notes: Tenacity uptime has brief gaps; avoid duplicate Noblesse.

vars.title: Stellar Swirl C6
vars.stats: ER as needed, then HP%; CRIT Rate if Favonius.
vars.teams: Vesna or Mizuki with Odette/Cryo Traveler; ideally another Anemo buffer.
vars.when: Protect the Stellar Swirl driver and apply Diona’s C6 reaction bonus while the driver remains inside her Burst.
vars.cond: C6 + Witch’s Revelation unlocked
vars.notes: For Mizuki, ensure a separate Stellar Swirl enabler.

vars.title: Cryo Battery / Freeze
vars.stats: ER until Burst is consistent, then HP% for shields.
vars.teams: Cryo carry such as Ayaka or Ganyu; Hydro for Freeze teams.
vars.when: Sacrificial Bow can provide a second Hold Skill and additional Cryo energy for Burst-hungry Cryo damage dealers.
vars.cond: Sacrificial reset depends on cooldown and rotation
vars.notes: Diona works at C0; C1 lowers ER demand.

vars.title: Healing Focus
vars.stats: HP% / HP% / Healing Bonus; get enough ER for Burst.
vars.teams: A team with another Noblesse holder and a carry who can benefit from healing-based damage.
vars.when: Trade some shield strength for stronger Burst healing; Song of Days Past adds damage to the active ally.
vars.cond: Song value depends on healing and rotation
vars.notes: Healing Bonus improves healing, not the shield.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Huge CRIT DMG, HP bonus, and off-field damage boost. Best for personal damage when her Energy needs are met. Requires sufficient ER from artifacts, teammates, or C1.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: ER supports Burst uptime while the teamwide EM and ATK buff improves reaction-focused teams. Best when teammates benefit from EM/ATK; trades Yelan damage for team buffs.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: Massive ER and neutral particles keep her Burst ready and lower team Energy needs. Use enough CRIT Rate to activate its passive reliably.

w.name: Sacrificial Bow
w.text: Can reset her Skill for extra Hydro particles and damage, but extends rotations and is less reliable than Favonius. Catch particles from both Skills. R3+ preferred.

w.name: Mouun's Moon
w.text: Boosts Burst damage based on the team’s combined Burst costs; best with low ER requirements. Needs ER from team and artifacts. R3-R5 preferred.

w.name: The Stringless
w.text: Boosts Skill and Burst damage; EM is less useful outside reaction-triggering situations. Use when her Burst is already funded. R5 preferred.

w.name: Fading Twilight
w.text: Provides ER and a rotating damage bonus, making it a workable event alternative. Event-exclusive; cannot currently be obtained.

w.name: Slingshot
w.text: Large CRIT Rate stat stick; Normal Attack passive does not boost her Burst. Only when energy needs are solved by her team.

a.text: Best general set: 20% ER plus Burst DMG scaling with ER. Do not overstack ER past her rotation requirement.
Accessible interim mix of ER and HP for reliable Bursts; weaker damage than 4pc Emblem.
Low-ER transition set with Hydro DMG and HP bonuses; mainly when strong Emblem pieces are unavailable.

t.name: Vape and Vanish
t.text: Yelan applies off-field Hydro for Arlecchino to Vaporize. Bennett supplies ATK; Xilonen shreds RES and buffs damage.

t.name: Double Trouble
t.text: Yelan and Xingqiu supply steady Hydro for Hu Tao’s Vaporize attacks; Zhongli protects the team and reduces enemy RES.

t.name: Bloom Service
t.text: Yelan’s Hydro and Nahida’s Dendro form cores; full-EM Kuki triggers Hyperbloom while Alhaitham drives Dendro damage.

t.name: National Security
t.text: Raiden restores team Energy and helps stabilize Hydro aura for Xiangling’s Vaporizes; Bennett boosts Xiangling and heals.

why.v:
Team Buffer: Elegy for the End trades Yelan’s personal damage for teamwide EM and ATK buffs in reaction teams.
High ER / Solo Hydro: Favonius Warbow + 4pc Emblem; prioritize enough ER to Burst every rotation before HP and CRIT.
Double Hydro: With a Hydro battery or C1, reduce ER as needed and shift substats toward HP and CRIT.
C6 On-field: At C6, invest in Breakthrough Barb damage and on-field time; Normal Attack talent gains value.

seo.about: Yelan is an HP-scaling off-field Hydro DPS whose Burst follows Normal Attacks to apply Hydro and deal strong single-target damage. She also ramps up the active character’s damage bonus. Prioritize enough Energy Recharge to Burst every rotation; ATK does not increase her Skill or Burst damage.

vars.title: Team Buff (Elegy)
vars.stats: Maintain rotation ER first. HP and CRIT remain useful but teammate damage matters more than Yelan’s personal ceiling.
vars.teams: Best with an ATK- or EM-scaling reaction carry such as Arlecchino or Hu Tao.
vars.when: Use Elegy when its teamwide ATK/EM buff adds more damage than Aqua’s personal damage advantage.
vars.cond: Team must benefit from Elegy buffs.
vars.notes: Elegy buffs teammates; it does not make Yelan an ATK-scaling character.

vars.title: High ER / Solo Hydro
vars.stats: ER Sands is often needed; with 1 Skill and Favonius, solo-Hydro ER can reach ~215–260%. Build CRIT Rate for Favonius.
vars.teams: Yelan is the only Hydro unit and has limited external battery support.
vars.when: Use when missing even one Burst would cost more damage than upgrading HP or CRIT.
vars.cond: ER needs drop with 2 Skill uses, Raiden, and Favonius teammates.
vars.notes: ER numbers are scenario estimates, not universal stat requirements.

vars.title: Double Hydro / Low ER
vars.stats: Use HP% Sands when ER is met; aim for HP, CRIT and Hydro DMG rather than stacking excess ER.
vars.teams: A second Hydro character, C1, or strong external particles should fund her Burst.
vars.when: Use for stronger personal damage in lower-ER teams, especially with Xingqiu or Furina.
vars.cond: Only when she can Burst every rotation.
vars.notes: Normal Attack triggers are still necessary for Burst coordinated attacks.

vars.title: C6 On-field Burst Window
vars.stats: Her C6 Breakthrough Barbs make Normal Attack talent investment relevant; balance HP, CRIT and enough ER.
vars.teams: Requires Yelan C6; support buffs should cover her opening on-field damage window.
vars.when: For C6 owners using her frontloaded Breakthrough Barb attacks instead of a purely off-field role.
vars.cond: C6 only.
vars.notes: Do not recommend upgrading Normal Attack talent for ordinary C0 off-field builds.

w.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
w.text: CRIT DMG, HP and Charged Attack damage perfectly match his kit; refunds Energy when its HP change stacks are consumed.

w.name: Surf's Up
w.text: High CD and HP; useful as a stat stick.

w.name: Jadefall's Splendor
w.text: HP and some Energy support help his beam build, but its shield and Burst related passive is not fully utilized.

w.name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking Elemental DMG help sustained field time, but the stacks reset when he swaps.

w.name: Sacrificial Jade
w.text: CR and an off-field HP buff boost his beams. Swap out before its HP buff expires to maintain uptime.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: HP, Burst Energy refund and party healing make it his most practical freely craftable weapon. Especially good when Energy or Furina Fanfare is needed.

w.name: Ash-Graven Drinking Horn
w.text: HP and periodic area damage can edge out Prototype Amber if Energy needs are already low. Low ER requirement; no Burst Energy refund. R5 preferred.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: CRIT DMG is useful, but only its Elemental DMG song boosts his damage reliably; ATK and EM rolls are often wasted. Inconsistent passive.

a.text: His own HP changes activate all three CR stacks.
a.stats: HP% · Hydro DMG/HP% · CRIT DMG/CRIT Rate

a.text: Boosts Hydro damage and Charged Attacks after using Skill, but falls behind Marechaussee Hunter.
Two HP bonuses make a workable temporary set while farming Marechaussee Hunter.

t.name: Judgment Day
t.text: Furina buffs the beam and activates Hydro Resonance. Kazuha buffs Hydro and shreds RES; Xilonen adds shred and healing. C0 needs careful dodging.

t.name: Moonlight Verdict
t.text: Columbina and Ineffa enable Lunar-Charged while Neuvillette drives with Hydro beams. Kazuha groups enemies and shreds Hydro RES.

t.name: Frozen in Court
t.text: Furina buffs Neuvillette, Escoffier heals and shreds Cryo/Hydro RES, while Citlali shields and helps Freeze susceptible enemies.

t.name: Bloom and Order
t.text: Neuvillette creates cores with Nahida; full EM Raiden triggers Hyperbloom off-field, and Zhongli shields against interruptions.

why.v:
C0 Shield Comfort: Use Zhongli or Citlali when beam interruptions are a problem. C1 allows more freedom to run buff heavy teams.
Lunar-Charged: Pair with Columbina and Ineffa for Lunar-Charged damage. Keep Neuvillette on his normal HP and CRIT build.
Hyperbloom Driver: Pair with Nahida and a full EM Electro trigger. Neuvillette stays on his normal beam build while producing Bloom cores.
Budget Build: Use Prototype Amber with Marechaussee Hunter. Its HP, Energy refund and healing make it an excellent accessible option.

seo.about: Neuvillette is an HP-scaling Hydro carry whose Charged Attacks deliver sustained area damage. Sourcewater Droplets speed up his beams and restore HP. At C0, a shield or careful positioning helps prevent interruptions; C1 gives him more freedom with team building.
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

vars.title: C0 Shield Comfort
vars.stats: Keep usual HP, Hydro and CRIT stats; ER must still cover Burst rotations.
vars.teams: A reliable shield such as Zhongli or Citlali plus two reaction types when feasible.
vars.when: Use when enemy attacks would regularly interrupt the Charged Attack beam.
vars.cond: At C1, interruption resistance makes shielding less necessary.
vars.notes: Furina double Hydro can still outperform a third reaction stack at C0.

vars.title: Lunar-Charged Driver
vars.stats: Maintain HP, CRIT and sufficient ER; do not convert Neuvillette into an EM reaction trigger.
vars.teams: Columbina and Ineffa enable Lunar-Charged; add Kazuha or a compatible support.
vars.when: Use to combine his sustained Hydro beams with strong off-field Lunar-Charged damage.
vars.cond: Requires the relevant Lunar-Charged teammates.
vars.notes: Electro and Hydro reaction damage from teammates is separate from his Charged Attack scaling.

vars.title: Hyperbloom Hydro Driver
vars.stats: Keep normal HP and CRIT stats; stack EM on Raiden or Kuki, not on Neuvillette.
vars.teams: Dendro applicator plus full EM Electro trigger; shield is helpful at C0.
vars.when: Use when you want consistent Hyperbloom damage alongside his personal Hydro beams.
vars.cond: Electro trigger needs Level 90 and substantial EM.
vars.notes: Neuvillette supplies Hydro for Bloom; the Electro character owns Hyperbloom damage.

vars.title: F2P Prototype Amber
vars.stats: Use HP sands, Hydro or HP goblet, and CRIT circlet. ER may be lower with Prototype Amber.
vars.teams: Any off-field reaction enablers; prioritize shield for C0 comfort.
vars.when: Choose this for accessible HP scaling, Burst refund and team healing without premium weapons.
vars.cond: Ash-Graven is best when Energy needs are already low.
vars.notes: Prototype Amber supports Furina teams with extra party healing.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: His signature adds CRIT DMG and Charged Attack damage. Multiple Pyro teammates grant ATK stacks that suit his favored teams. Strongest in teams with at least two Pyro characters.

w.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
w.text: Huge CRIT DMG and Charged Attack buffs make it a premium alternative. Its passive favors a different elemental team setup. Value depends on activating its Charged Attack passive.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Its large CRIT DMG stat and nearby-enemy damage bonus boost his Prop Arrows and Skill without relying on reactions. Stay reasonably close to targets to activate its passive.

w.name: Thundering Pulse
w.text: Strong base ATK, CRIT DMG and ATK% are useful. Its Normal Attack bonus does not enhance Lyney’s Charged Attacks. Mostly a strong stat stick; Normal Attack stacks are not the goal.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: High base ATK, CRIT Rate and bonus CRIT DMG provide reliable damage. Watch for CRIT Rate overcap with Marechaussee Hunter. Keep displayed CRIT Rate below about 64% with full Hunter stacks.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: A Charged Attack hit marks a target for extra damage, with an added Charged Attack bonus against that target. Most reliable against one marked enemy. Higher refinements strengthen its marked-target payoff.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Fontaine craftable with ATK% and a damage bonus after receiving healing. Bennett can activate it consistently. Bring reliable healing, preferably Bennett. R5 is a strong accessible goal.

w.name: Prototype Crescent
w.text: An ATK% bow that grants a major ATK boost after a Charged Attack hits an enemy weak point. Excellent when the passive works. Enemy must have a hittable weak point. R5 rewards consistent weak-point hits.

a.text: His Prop Arrows consume HP and his Skill heals, giving reliable access to 36% CRIT Rate plus 15% Charged Attack DMG.
Boosts damage against Pyro-affected enemies. Works in Mono Pyro but is less consistent and generally weaker than Hunter.
Simple ATK% mix for an interim build while farming Hunter. Choose the pieces with the strongest CRIT stats.

t.name: Final Curtain
t.text: Bennett heals, buffs ATK and keeps Pyro active. Kazuha Swirls Pyro for damage buffs and RES shred; Zhongli protects Lyney while he aims.

t.name: House of Flames
t.text: Xiangling adds strong off-field Pyro damage and helps maintain Pyro aura. Bennett powers both DPS units, while Zhongli guards charged shots.

t.name: Smoke and Mirrors
t.text: Dehya adds Pyro and interruption resistance; Bennett heals and buffs. Sucrose holds Viridescent Venerer and can pass Thrilling Tales ATK.

t.name: Budget Magic Show
t.text: Bennett and Xiangling keep enemies burning with Pyro while Lynette shreds Pyro RES using Viridescent Venerer. Dodge carefully without a shield.

why.v:
Mono Pyro Carry: Use Bennett plus another Pyro teammate to keep enemies affected by Pyro. Fire Prop Arrows, then spend Prop Surplus stacks with Skill.
Shielded Comfort: Zhongli or Dehya helps prevent interrupted Charged Attacks. Choose this when enemies attack aggressively.
Craftable F2P: Use Song of Stillness with a healer such as Bennett, or Prototype Crescent when enemies expose weak points.
No Hunter Set Yet: Use Lavawalker against Pyro-affected foes or a 2-piece ATK mix until a good Marechaussee Hunter set is ready.

seo.about: Lyney is an on-field Pyro DPS who fires Prop Arrows to summon Grin-Malkin Hats, then cashes in Prop Surplus stacks with his Skill. His HP changes make Marechaussee Hunter easy to activate. He shines against Pyro-affected enemies.

vars.title: Shielded Mono Pyro
vars.stats: ATK% / Pyro DMG / CRIT. Aim for no more than 64% displayed CRIT Rate with full Hunter stacks.
vars.teams: Bennett plus a shield or interruption resistance source, with reliable Pyro aura.
vars.when: Best for dangerous enemies that interrupt aimed shots. Bennett heals and buffs; Zhongli or Dehya lets Lyney charge safely.
vars.cond: Prefer Pyro-affected enemies to maximize his Ascension 4 passive.
vars.notes: Lyney should land several Prop Arrows before using Skill to spend Prop Surplus stacks.

vars.title: Offensive Mono Pyro
vars.stats: CRIT DMG and ATK% after reaching practical CRIT Rate. ER matters more if bursting each rotation.
vars.teams: Bennett, another Pyro damage source, and Anemo RES shred; no guaranteed shield.
vars.when: For faster clears when dodging is comfortable. Xiangling contributes damage while Anemo support shreds Pyro RES.
vars.cond: Less comfortable against aggressive enemies or frequent stagger.
vars.notes: Weapon ranking changes with teams, refinements, and available buffs.

vars.title: Accessible Craftable
vars.stats: ATK% sands and Pyro goblet. Use the better CRIT circlet while avoiding Hunter CRIT overcap.
vars.teams: Song of Stillness needs healing; Prototype Crescent needs an enemy weak point.
vars.when: An excellent F2P or low-spend setup. Bennett reliably activates Song of Stillness, making it the simpler choice for most fights.
vars.cond: Prototype Crescent loses value against bosses without weak points.
vars.notes: Refining craftable bows can improve their performance without limited wishes.

vars.title: Lavawalker Alternative
vars.stats: Without Hunter stacks, aim for a conventional CRIT ratio with roughly 65%–75% CRIT Rate.
vars.teams: Enemies should remain affected by Pyro; Bennett and Xiangling help maintain aura.
vars.when: Use an existing well-rolled Lavawalker set before finishing Marechaussee Hunter. Stronger only when its Pyro aura condition holds.
vars.cond: Lavawalker loses its benefit when the enemy loses Pyro aura.
vars.notes: A mixed ATK set is more universal if Pyro aura is unreliable.

w.name: Crane's Echoing Call
w.text: Very high Base ATK strengthens her plunge buff. A Skill plunge buffs allies’ plunges and their plunges restore her Energy. Strongest in teams that plunge repeatedly.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: High Base ATK and ATK% help maximize her healing and plunge buff when Energy Recharge is already covered. Best with adequate ER, especially Xiao plus Faruzan.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Energy Recharge and CRIT-triggered particles help Xianyun Burst every rotation and lower team Energy needs. Build some CRIT Rate and hit enemies to trigger its passive. Higher refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Oathsworn Eye
w.text: ATK% raises healing and plunge buffs.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Craftable high Base ATK and ATK% help her buff and healing; its personal damage passive is not the main reason to use it. Use when Burst uptime is already comfortable.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Gives the next character a large ATK buff, useful for Xiao or Gaming, but its low Base ATK weakens Xianyun’s own plunge bonus. Swap directly to an ATK-scaling carry. R5 recommended for the full ATK buff.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Restores Xianyun’s Energy and heals the party after Burst. A comfort option, though HP% does not strengthen her ATK-based buff. Prefer when extra sustain and Energy matter. R5 improves Energy and healing.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: Energy Recharge and elemental buffs can help Electro teams after she triggers an Electro-related Swirl reaction. Situational Electro teams only; not for Xiao hypercarry.

a.text: Swirling Pyro, Hydro or Electro reduces that element’s enemy RES by 40%. Best for reaction carries when Xianyun can Swirl the right aura.
Turns her large Burst healing into an added damage bonus for the active carry, useful when VV cannot shred the carry’s Anemo RES.
Burst grants the party 20% ATK for 12 seconds.

t.name: Cloud Nine
t.text: Xianyun's healing fuels Furina's Fanfare while her plunge buff amplifies Xiao. Faruzan shreds Anemo RES and boosts his damage.

t.name: Curtain Call
t.text: Furina supplies Hydro for Gaming's Vaporized plunges. Bennett boosts ATK while Xianyun heals, enables jumps and buffs his plunge hits.

t.name: Dragon Drop
t.text: Xianyun lets Diluc spam his strong plunges. Furina applies Hydro for Vaporize; Bennett adds ATK and Xianyun provides healing and buffs.

t.name: Budget Takeoff
t.text: Gaming plunges with Xianyun's buff; weave Normal Attacks to trigger Xingqiu's Hydro swords for Vaporize. Bennett buffs ATK and heals.

why.v:
Xiao Hypercarry: With Xiao and Faruzan, prioritize ATK after meeting ER needs. Song of Days Past or Noblesse often beats VV for Anemo damage.
Pyro Vaporize: Swirl Pyro before swapping to Gaming or Diluc to activate Viridescent Venerer. Furina supplies Hydro for Vaporize plunges.
Energy First: As solo Anemo, Favonius Codex and an ER Sands may be needed. Reliable Burst uptime matters more than reaching 4,500 ATK.
C2 Plunge Buff: C2 raises Xianyun’s plunge support ceiling substantially. Still meet her Energy needs before stacking ATK.

seo.about: Xianyun heals the whole party and lets allies plunge during her Burst. Her ATK-based passive adds DMG to plunges, making her exceptional with Xiao, Gaming, and other plunge carries. Build enough ER to Burst every rotation, then stack ATK.

vars.title: Xiao Plunge Support
vars.stats: After meeting ER needs, push ATK toward the 4,500 buff cap. Double Anemo and Faruzan reduce required ER.
vars.teams: Xiao and Faruzan; Furina is an excellent fourth teammate.
vars.when: Use with Xiao when Viridescent Venerer cannot shred the Anemo damage he deals. Her healing also builds Furina Fanfare.
vars.cond: Do not duplicate Noblesse on the same team.
vars.notes: C2 is an especially strong support upgrade.

vars.title: Vaporize Plunge Enabler
vars.stats: ER first, then ATK. Aim for a Pyro Swirl to shred Pyro RES before the carry begins plunging.
vars.teams: Gaming or Diluc; Hydro application from Furina or Xingqiu.
vars.when: Choose this setup to enable and buff Pyro plunges while decreasing enemy Pyro resistance.
vars.cond: VV must Swirl Pyro to shred Pyro RES.
vars.notes: Xingqiu needs Normal Attacks between plunges to launch his Burst swords.

vars.title: High Energy / Budget
vars.stats: Use an ER Sands if needed; add CRIT Rate for Favonius procs, then focus on ATK.
vars.teams: Any plunge carry; team battery or Favonius holders ease the Energy demand.
vars.when: For teams where her Burst is not ready every rotation. Comfortable healing and jump access outweigh a little extra ATK.
vars.cond: Favonius requires a CRIT hit; Prototype Amber gives less ATK.
vars.notes: Check ER per team. Solo Anemo needs substantially more Energy Recharge.

vars.title: C6 On-field Plunge
vars.stats: Build CRIT and ATK with enough ER; unlike the support build, personal Anemo damage matters.
vars.teams: C6 Xianyun, C6 Faruzan, Furina, and Bennett offer a strong damage shell.
vars.when: Only for players who want Xianyun herself to be the plunge carry instead of supporting another character.
vars.cond: Requires C6 for the intended offensive playstyle.
vars.notes: Situational constellation build, not the recommended C0 support setup.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Best in slot: huge CD, extra DEF.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking DMG Bonus make this an exceptional alternative; at R5 it can approach R1 Redhorn. Protect stacks with a shield. Keep passive stacks active. R5 is especially strong.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: ER helps maintain Burst uptime.

w.name: Whiteblind
w.text: Best craftable choice: DEF% and stacking DEF/ATK increase his Burst damage. Build Normal Attack stacks before Bursting when practical. Accessible alternative. R5 recommended.

w.name: Blackcliff Slasher
w.text: CRIT DMG is useful, but its ATK bonus requires defeating enemies and does little in boss fights. Best against multiple waves.

w.name: "Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword"
w.text: Energy Recharge plus ATK buffs make a comfortable event option; ATK is less valuable than DEF or CRIT for Itto. If already obtained.

w.name: Tidal Shadow
w.text: Craftable ATK% claymore whose ATK buff activates after healing. A fallback if Whiteblind is unavailable. Requires healing.

a.text: His strongest general set: stacks increase DEF and Geo DMG while he deals Geo damage or waits off-field.
A viable alternative with 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG while protected by a shield.
Combine DEF% from Husk with Geo DMG from Archaic Petra while farming a complete Husk set.

t.name: Oni Royalty
t.text: Gorou supplies DEF and Geo buffs, Chiori deals off-field damage and makes particles, and Zhongli shields and shreds RES for safe Kesagiri combos.

t.name: Oni Goes to Fontaine
t.text: Xilonen heals and shreds Geo RES in this double-Geo setup. Furina boosts team damage, while Bennett adds healing and an ATK buff.

t.name: Full House Geo
t.text: A classic four-Geo shell: Gorou buffs Itto, Albedo adds off-field damage and Geo particles, and Zhongli enables safe, uninterrupted slashes.

t.name: Budget Bonk Brigade
t.text: Gorou and Kachina give Itto a three-Geo core and more particles. Diona shields and heals, letting him finish his Burst combos safely.

why.v:
Mono Geo: Pair with Gorou, another Geo damage dealer and a shield. Lower Energy needs and reliable DEF/Geo buffs.
Double Geo: With Xilonen, use two non-Geo teammates to activate her RES shred and healing; Furina plus Bennett is a strong option.
F2P Oni: Whiteblind, Husk, Gorou and Kachina form an accessible core. Add a shielder or healer for comfort.
Burst Rotation: Prepare team buffs, Burst on Itto, then use Ushi and Normal Attacks to build stacks for Kesagiri. Swapping ends Burst.

seo.about: Arataki Itto is an on-field Geo DPS who converts DEF into ATK during his Burst. Build Superlative Superstrength with Normal Attacks and Ushi, then spend stacks on powerful Arataki Kesagiri Charged Attacks. Keep his Burst ready, and finish setting up teammates before he takes the field.

vars.title: Double Geo with Xilonen
vars.stats: DEF% remains standard; a DEF% Goblet can compete only with unusually high external DMG buffs. Check ER for the rotation.
vars.teams: Xilonen plus two Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo teammates, e.g. Furina and Bennett.
vars.when: Use to access Furina’s team damage bonus and Xilonen’s healing and Geo RES shred while keeping Itto as your main carry.
vars.cond: Xilonen requires two eligible non-Geo elements for her standard support mode.
vars.notes: Set up healing and buffs before Itto’s Burst.

vars.title: F2P / Craftable
vars.stats: Prioritize CRIT and ER on artifacts to compensate for Whiteblind’s DEF% stat.
vars.teams: Gorou and another Geo teammate help charge Burst; bring shields or healing.
vars.when: A practical low-spend setup that gets strong value from craftable Whiteblind and existing Geo supports.
vars.cond: Whiteblind stacks its passive through Normal/Charged Attack hits.
vars.notes: R5 Whiteblind is a strong investment if you already own billets.

vars.title: Shielded Kesagiri
vars.stats: Maintain normal DEF / Geo DMG / CRIT main stats; sustain enough ER for each rotation.
vars.teams: A reliable shielder such as Zhongli or Diona.
vars.when: Useful when shield comfort matters or you already own strong Retracing Bolide pieces. Husk is preferred for most builds.
vars.cond: Bolide’s damage bonus only works while shielded. Serpent Spine wants uninterrupted stacks.
vars.notes: Shield before Itto enters his Burst window.

w.name: Calamity Queller
w.text: 741 Base ATK, ATK% and a passive that builds more ATK while Shenhe is off-field maximize Icy Quill buffs. Meet Burst Energy needs first.

w.name: Engulfing Lightning
w.text: Energy Recharge and ER-to-ATK conversion help balance Burst uptime with stronger Icy Quills. Especially useful when ER needs are high.

w.name: Skyward Spine
w.text: High Base ATK and Energy Recharge help Shenhe maintain Burst uptime without giving up too much buff strength.

w.name: Vortex Vanquisher
w.text: High Base ATK and an ATK% substat strengthen Icy Quills; the shield-dependent passive is less useful off-field. Value mainly comes from its stats.

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: CRIT hits generate neutral particles for Shenhe and her team, often making this the most practical 4-star choice. Build some CRIT Rate and hit an enemy on-field. Higher refinements improve reliability.

w.name: Missive Windspear
w.text: ATK% substat and a reaction-triggered ATK boost make it a useful accessible stat stick for Cryo support. Trigger an elemental reaction for the passive. R5 if available.

w.name: Prospector's Drill
w.text: ATK% and its Liyue-party passive can raise her buffing ATK, but team restrictions reduce its flexibility. Best with several Liyue teammates.

w.name: Prototype Starglitter
w.text: Craftable Energy Recharge option when better polearms are unavailable; its Normal and Charged Attack passive adds little. Budget stopgap rather than a damage pick.

a.text: After Burst, gives the team 20% ATK.
a.stats: ATK% / ER · ATK% · ATK% / CRIT Rate

a.text: Two ATK% set bonuses maximize Icy Quill damage when another teammate already wears Noblesse.
Improves Shenhe’s own Burst DMG with ER.
a.stats: ATK% / ER · ATK% / Cryo · ATK% / CRIT

t.name: Father Shenhe
t.text: Shenhe boosts Skirk’s Cryo hits; Furina supplies DMG buffs and Hydro.

t.name: Winter Court
t.text: Ayaka spends Shenhe’s Icy Quills with her Burst; Kokomi keeps enemies Frozen and heals.

t.name: Cold Front
t.text: Hold Shenhe’s Skill to buff Wriothesley’s attacks. Escoffier adds healing and Cryo shred.

t.name: Budget Snow Day
t.text: Chongyun uses Shenhe’s Quills through infused Cryo attacks.

why.v:
Tap Skill · Burst Teams: Tap for 5 Icy Quills per ally and a 15% Skill/Burst DMG buff.
Hold Skill · Attack Teams: Hold for 7 Icy Quills per ally and a 15% Normal, Charged and Plunging Attack DMG buff.
Favonius Utility: Use Favonius Lance and enough CR to trigger particles.
ATK Buff Focus: When another ally has Noblesse.

seo.about: Shenhe is an ATK-scaling Cryo support whose Icy Quills add damage to allies’ Cryo hits. Her Skill also buffs attack types, while her Burst shreds Cryo and Physical RES. Build enough Energy Recharge to Burst reliably, then stack ATK; she shines beside Cryo damage dealers.
stats: Skill: Tap 5 / Hold 7 Icy Quill uses

vars.title: Favonius Battery
vars.stats: Build Energy Recharge to Burst every rotation; add CRIT Rate to trigger Favonius.
vars.teams: Teams with high Energy needs or limited Cryo particles.
vars.when: Give Shenhe a brief on-field hit to trigger Favonius, then swap to your Cryo carry.
vars.cond: Favonius only triggers on on-field CRIT hits.

vars.title: Maximum Icy Quill ATK
vars.stats: After reaching required ER, focus on ATK% across Sands, Goblet and Circlet.
vars.teams: Another teammate already wears Noblesse Oblige.
vars.when: Maximize Shenhe’s ATK to amplify Cryo hits from teammates consuming Icy Quills.
vars.cond: Calamity Queller still needs enough ER for Burst uptime.

vars.title: Hold Skill · Cryo Attacks
vars.stats: Similar ATK / ER support stats; prioritize reliable Burst uptime.
vars.teams: Cryo carry relying on Normal, Charged or Plunging Attacks.
vars.when: Hold Skill before Wriothesley or other attack-focused Cryo carries: 7 Quills each and a 15% attack-type DMG buff.
vars.cond: Longer cooldown than Tap Skill.

vars.title: Burst Damage Sidegrade
vars.stats: Use ER Sands if needed; seek more personal CRIT after sufficient ATK.
vars.teams: A team already has Noblesse and can support Shenhe’s Burst.
vars.when: Emphasizes her own periodic Cryo Burst damage while keeping RES shred active.
vars.cond: Usually less team damage than buff-focused builds.
