w.name: The Daybreak Chronicles
w.text: HEX-focused signature bow that enhances Venti’s on-field Windsunder Arrow damage; strongest fit for his HEX DPS playstyle. HEX Main DPS with Witch’s Homework completed.

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking ATK from varied hits boost direct Anemo damage in a HEX DPS build. Requires stack management for best value.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: CR and CD strengthen direct Anemo DMG.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: Energy Recharge and a teamwide ATK/EM buff after its effect triggers make it excellent for off-field support. Support / Sub DPS, especially reaction teams.

w.name: The Stringless
w.text: Elemental Mastery strengthens Swirl while the passive increases Skill and Burst damage; excellent off-field option. Swirl support or off-field damage.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: Energy Recharge plus neutral particles from CRIT hits help Venti and energy-hungry teammates Burst reliably. Support; needs some CRIT Rate to trigger.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Craftable ATK bow with a damage bonus after healing, offering a lower-spend route for HEX DPS. Best with a healer to activate its passive.

w.name: Windblume Ode
w.text: Elemental Mastery boosts Swirl; Skill use grants a short ATK buff for a flexible older event alternative. Only if obtained during its event.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Best for Venti’s HEX on-field DPS: sustained on-field attacks benefit from its ATK and CRIT bonuses.
Boosts Swirl and reduces enemy RES to the Swirled element by 40%, greatly improving elemental team damage.
Burst grants the party 20% ATK for 12s.

t.name: Winds of the Witch
t.text: Durin enables HEX and adds off-field damage; Faruzan boosts Anemo damage while Bennett supplies ATK, healing and a Swirlable Pyro aura.

t.name: Thunderous Encore
t.text: Fischl activates HEX, Furina adds damage and buffs, and Jean heals. Venti drives Electro-Charged Swirls with infused attacks.

t.name: Permafrost
t.text: Ganyu and Mona freeze grouped enemies while Diona protects and heals. Venti gathers targets and shreds Cryo RES.

t.name: Swirl and Chill
t.text: Mizuki drives Swirls; Furina and Ororon supply off-field damage. Venti groups enemies and supports Electro-Charged reactions.

why.v:
HEX Main DPS: A Day Carved From Rising Winds; ATK/Anemo/CRIT. Complete Witch’s Homework and bring another Hexerei teammate.
Swirl Support: Viridescent Venerer with EM/EM/EM and Elegy, Stringless or Favonius; prioritize Burst uptime.
CRIT Sub DPS: Use ATK/Anemo/CRIT and Skyward Harp for personal Skill/Burst damage instead of pure Swirl scaling.
Noblesse Team Buff: Use Noblesse when another Anemo already provides Viridescent shred; keep enough ER to Burst reliably.
F2P HEX: Use craftable Song of Stillness with a healer and build ATK/Anemo/CRIT.

seo.about: Venti can play on-field HEX Main DPS after completing Witch’s Homework alongside another Hexerei teammate, using Windsunder Arrows for Anemo damage. Alternatively, he groups enemies and supports off-field damage with Swirl, Viridescent Venerer RES shred, and Energy refunds.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.title: HEX Main DPS

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.stats: ATK% sands, Anemo DMG goblet and CRIT circlet; prioritize CRIT, ATK and sufficient ER.
vars.teams: Witch’s Homework completed and a second Hexerei teammate.
vars.when: Use Venti as the on-field damage dealer with Windsunder Arrows and HEX buffs.
vars.cond: Requires Hexerei team activation.
vars.notes: This is the main on-field option within the same Studio guide, not a second build ID.

vars.title: Swirl Support / Sub DPS
vars.stats: Prefer EM/EM/EM for Swirl and enough ER for Burst. CRIT Rate matters on Favonius.
vars.teams: Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo teammates who benefit from grouping and RES shred.
vars.when: Swap to Venti for grouping, Swirl damage, elemental RES shred and team utility rather than extended on-field attacks.
vars.cond: Viridescent only shreds the element actually Swirled.
vars.notes: Noblesse is an option if another teammate already handles Viridescent.

vars.title: CRIT Off-field DPS
vars.stats: ATK% / Anemo DMG / CRIT with enough ER for Burst.
vars.teams: Teams where direct Burst damage matters and reaction-focused EM is less valuable.
vars.when: For well-invested Venti builds that favor personal direct damage while still providing grouping.
vars.cond: Needs good CRIT and ATK investment.
vars.notes: Swirl damage itself cannot CRIT.

vars.title: Accessible HEX DPS

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.stats: ATK% / Anemo DMG / CRIT; build enough ER for regular Bursts.
vars.teams: Another Hexerei character plus a healer for Song of Stillness.
vars.when: A low-spend approach to Venti’s HEX playstyle without his signature bow.
vars.cond: Complete Witch’s Homework and trigger weapon healing passive.
vars.notes: Song of Stillness is craftable; other options depend on owned inventory.

w.name: Hunter's Path
w.text: CRIT Rate and Elemental DMG boost pair with a Charged Attack bonus based on EM. His strongest personal damage weapon. Prioritize an EM Sands.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Massive CRIT DMG and a nearby-enemy DMG bonus enhance Charged Attacks and Burst. Stay reasonably close to enemies for the passive.

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: CR and stacking ATK improve DMG.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: CD and Charged Attack DMG provide strong value.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: High Base ATK plus CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG make this a reliable all-purpose damage option.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: Energy Recharge and its teamwide EM and ATK buff benefit Quicken teams, trading some personal damage for team output. Team-focused choice, especially with higher ER needs.

w.name: Slingshot
w.text: Excellent 3-star option: high CRIT Rate and a large Charged Attack DMG bonus when shots land quickly. Stay close enough to trigger the fast-hit passive. R5 recommended.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Craftable ATK% bow that increases damage after receiving healing. Useful when paired with an off-field healer. Needs reliable healing to maintain its passive. R5 recommended.

a.text: 80 EM and 35% Charged Attack DMG directly strengthen his main damage source. Excellent general-purpose choice.
Grants EM and/or ATK after reactions.
Reduces enemy Dendro RES by 30%.

t.name: Forest of Thunder
t.text: Nahida supplies EM and Deepwood shred, Yae maintains Quicken, and Zhongli shields Tighnari during aimed shots.

t.name: Foxfire Circuit
t.text: Double Electro maintains Quicken, while Baizhu heals, protects, and can hold Deepwood to boost Tighnari’s Spread damage.

t.name: Greenhouse Effect
t.text: Nahida shares EM and shreds Dendro RES, Fischl applies Electro, and Kuki adds healing and Quicken uptime.

t.name: Budget Botanists
t.text: Dendro Traveler can carry Deepwood; Fischl and Kuki sustain Quicken, provide Electro damage, and keep the team comfortable.

why.v:
Hunter’s Path: Prioritize an EM Sands; its Charged Attack buff scales with Elemental Mastery.
No Deepwood Holder: Equip 4-piece Deepwood Memories if nobody else provides the essential Dendro RES reduction.
F2P: Use R5 Slingshot near enemies, Wanderer’s Troupe, and a reliable Electro teammate for Spread.
Burst Frequency: Two Skills per Burst needs little ER; one Skill per Burst can need much more, especially without a second Dendro.

seo.about: Tighnari is a quick-swap Dendro DPS who excels in Spread teams. His Skill greatly shortens the charge time of his next three Wreath Arrows, while his Burst adds fast Dendro damage. Rotate through Skill, three Charged Attacks, and Burst, then swap to Electro teammates to maintain Quicken.

vars.title: Hunter’s Path Spread
vars.stats: EM Sands strongly preferred; prioritize CRIT and EM after meeting ER needs.
vars.teams: Keep Quicken active with an Electro teammate; another character should hold Deepwood.
vars.when: Choose when using his signature bow to maximize EM-based Charged Attack damage.
vars.cond: Hunter’s Path equipped
vars.notes: Gilded Dreams can slightly outperform Wanderer’s Troupe with Hunter’s Path.

vars.title: Solo Deepwood Carrier
vars.stats: Keep normal EM/ATK%, Dendro DMG, CRIT stats; set bonus replaces a stronger personal damage set.
vars.teams: No other reliable Deepwood Memories user.
vars.when: Use when Tighnari must provide the 30% Dendro RES shred himself.
vars.cond: No other teammate using 4-piece Deepwood

vars.title: F2P Spread
vars.stats: Aim for 60–75% CRIT Rate, solid CRIT DMG and roughly 250–450+ EM; adjust for weapon.
vars.teams: Fischl or another consistent Electro applier; healer needed for Song of Stillness.
vars.when: Affordable Spread setup built around R5 Slingshot and accessible teammates.
vars.cond: Slingshot passive needs close-range hits
vars.notes: Slingshot is a 3-star weapon and can beat many 4-star alternatives.

vars.title: Flexible Burst Rotation
vars.stats: Around 100–110% ER for two Skills per Burst; ~130–160% may be needed for one Skill per Burst.
vars.teams: Maintain Quicken and choose the rotation that fits team energy generation.
vars.when: Trade frequent Bursts for stronger offensive stats in flexible 12-second quick-swap cycles.
vars.cond: ER depends strongly on particles and Favonius procs

w.name: Black Tassel
w.text: Large HP% secondary stat maximizes Jade Shield durability. The slime-damage passive is irrelevant. Best for maximum shield strength.

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: Energy Recharge and on-field CRIT hits generate neutral particles for the team. Build enough CRIT Rate to trigger it. Use when allies need energy; passive cannot trigger off-field.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: CRIT DMG, bonus HP and HP-to-ATK conversion make it a strong hybrid or Burst-damage option. Burst or hybrid investment; not needed for pure shielding.

w.name: Skyward Spine
w.text: Energy Recharge and a little CRIT Rate can help a Burst-focused Zhongli cast more frequently. Burst-focused playstyle.

w.name: Vortex Vanquisher
w.text: His signature grants shield strength to its wielder and stacking ATK, but neither notably improves shields given to allies. On-field niche only; not recommended for shieldbot.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: Energy Recharge plus Burst DMG and Burst CRIT Rate supports an affordable meteor-focused setup. Burst damage build. R5 recommended.

w.name: Crescent Pike
w.text: Physical DMG and extra Normal Attack hits enable a niche on-field Physical Zhongli. Physical driver only; requires particle pickup.

w.name: Prototype Starglitter
w.text: Craftable Energy Recharge option when Favonius is unavailable; its Normal/Charged Attack passive does little for shield support. Temporary ER option only.

a.text: HP and team ATK buff when Skill hits land.
Grants a strong elemental DMG buff after Zhongli personally collects the matching Crystallize shard.
Situational Dendro RES shred for teams lacking another Deepwood holder; Skill hit coverage can be inconsistent.

t.name: Unbreakable Verdict
t.text: Zhongli protects C0 Neuvillette from interruption and shreds RES; Furina buffs DMG.

t.name: Golden Contract
t.text: Geo Resonance and Zhongli’s shield help Navia attack safely.

t.name: Pyro-Proof Plan
t.text: Zhongli shields Arlecchino through her combos and shreds RES.

t.name: Forest Fortress
t.text: Zhongli safeguards Tighnari’s charged shots; Yae keeps Quicken active and Nahida boosts Dendro DMG.

why.v:
Favonius Battery: Trade some HP for CR to trigger Favonius Lance on-field, feeding the team energy while keeping a durable shield.
Burst Support: Staff of Homa or The Catch, Geo DMG goblet and CRIT circlet add meteor DMG.
Physical Driver: Crescent Pike and a Physical DMG goblet support on-field Normal Attacks. Fun.
Dendro Utility: Use Deepwood only when no teammate can carry it.

seo.about: Zhongli protects the team with a durable Jade Shield that also reduces nearby enemies' Elemental and Physical RES by 20%. Stack HP for shield strength, or use Favonius Lance for team energy. His Burst offers Petrification, but may cost more time than it is worth in damage-focused rotations.

vars.title: Favonius Team Battery
vars.stats: HP% main stats; use a CRIT Rate circlet or substats to proc Favonius reliably.
vars.teams: Teammates with meaningful Energy Recharge needs.
vars.when: Choose when giving allies particles matters more than maximum shield HP.
vars.cond: Favonius procs only from on-field CRIT hits.
vars.notes: Add a Normal Attack after Hold Skill if needed for a reliable proc.

vars.title: Meteor Burst Support
vars.stats: HP%/ATK% sands, Geo DMG goblet, CRIT circlet; gain sufficient ER for chosen rotation.
vars.teams: Prefer teams with a window for his long Burst animation.
vars.when: For Petrification and extra Geo Burst damage when sacrificing some shield strength is acceptable.
vars.cond: Higher investment; often less team DPS than skipping Burst.
vars.notes: Focus Burst and Skill talents; use an HP sands for a sturdier hybrid shield.

vars.title: Physical Driver
vars.stats: ATK% sands, Physical DMG goblet, CRIT circlet; prioritize Normal Attack talent.
vars.teams: Superconduct support and consistent particle pickups.
vars.when: A fun off-meta playstyle built around fast Normal Attacks and Crescent Pike procs.
vars.cond: Niche; weaker personal damage than most dedicated carries.
vars.notes: Keep the shield up and use Cryo + Electro teammates for Physical RES reduction.

vars.title: Dendro RES Shred
vars.stats: Keep HP% main stats, adding CRIT Rate if using Favonius.
vars.teams: Only use when no other teammate already carries 4-piece Deepwood.
vars.when: Provides Dendro RES reduction while protecting a Dendro damage or reaction team.
vars.cond: Stele placement limits repeated hits.
vars.notes: Deepwood on Nahida or another reliable Dendro applier is typically easier to maintain.

w.name: Primordial Jade Winged-Spear
w.text: High base ATK, CRIT Rate, and stacking ATK/DMG buffs suit Xiao’s sustained on-field plunges. Build stacks by hitting enemies.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Huge CRIT DMG and HP-based ATK make this an excellent premium alternative, even above half HP. Do not sacrifice healing to force the low-HP bonus.

w.name: Lumidouce Elegy
w.text: High CRIT Rate and ATK-oriented stats make a strong premium stat stick; much of its passive is irrelevant to Xiao. Avoid overcapping CRIT Rate with Marechaussee Hunter.

w.name: Calamity Queller
w.text: High base ATK and Elemental DMG Bonus help Xiao, although its off-field-oriented passive is not fully utilized. Best if ATK buffs are limited.

w.name: Vortex Vanquisher
w.text: Large ATK gains can work with a shield, but it offers no CRIT and its shield-strength bonus applies to Xiao only. Requires reliable shielding to exploit its ATK passive.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: Its CRIT Rate makes Xiao easier to build, and its situational ATK passive works in both single-target and AoE fights. Avoid excess CRIT Rate on Marechaussee Hunter.

w.name: Lithic Spear
w.text: ATK% and Liyue-party stacks can give strong value in compatible teams, especially at higher refinements. Requires Liyue teammates for its passive. Higher refinements improve performance.

w.name: Missive Windspear
w.text: An accessible ATK% option; its reaction-triggered ATK buff is situational, and EM contributes little to standard Xiao damage. Event-only; passive depends on triggering a reaction.

a.text: Burst HP drain quickly stacks up to 48% extra ATK at four stacks; reliable across long plunging rotations, especially in AoE.
Burst HP drain activates up to 36% CRIT Rate. Excellent with Xianyun/Furina; avoid overcapping CRIT Rate.
Greatly boosts Plunging Attack DMG through successive plunges. Strong with Bennett; requires consistent plunge timing.

t.name: Adeptal Air Force
t.text: Premium plunge hypercarry: Faruzan shreds Anemo RES, Xianyun boosts plunges and heals, and Furina adds damage buffs.

t.name: Lament on Repeat
t.text: A classic Xiao hypercarry. Faruzan boosts Anemo, Zhongli protects and shreds RES, and Bennett grants major ATK buffs.

t.name: Windborne Remedy
t.text: Faruzan buffs Anemo damage, Jean heals and batteries Xiao, and Furina provides off-field damage and Fanfare buffs.

t.name: Budget Yaksha
t.text: A lower-cost triple-Anemo core: Faruzan buffs Xiao, Sucrose funnels particles, and Bennett heals and boosts ATK.

why.v:
Xianyun/Furina: Marechaussee Hunter gains 36% CRIT Rate from HP changes; reduce displayed CRIT Rate and favor CRIT DMG.
Bennett Plunges: Long Night's Oath excels with steady plunge timing and Bennett ATK buffs; Anemo DMG Goblet favored.
High AoE: Vermillion Hereafter provides reliable ATK during HP-draining Burst rotations, especially against multiple enemies.
Accessible Xiao: Deathmatch or Missive Windspear, with Sucrose battery and a healer; prioritize enough ER for every Burst.

seo.about: Xiao is an on-field Anemo hypercarry who converts his attacks to Anemo during Burst and delivers powerful Plunging Attacks. His Burst drains HP, making healing and Anemo energy support valuable. Build CRIT, ATK, and enough Energy Recharge to Burst every rotation.

vars.title: FFXX Premium Plunge
vars.stats: Aim for 45–64% displayed CRIT Rate on Marechaussee; invest the rest in CRIT DMG, ATK and sufficient ER.
vars.teams: Xianyun, Furina and ideally C6 Faruzan.
vars.when: Best for maximum single-target plunge damage and mobile buffs. Xianyun heals through Xiao’s HP drain.
vars.cond: CRIT Rate cap includes Marechaussee 36%.

vars.title: Bennett Plunge Hypercarry
vars.stats: Anemo DMG Goblet and strong CRIT rolls; ensure Burst uptime before stacking more ATK.
vars.teams: Bennett and Faruzan; add shielding or an Anemo battery.
vars.when: Use when playing inside Bennett’s field and maintaining consecutive high plunges.
vars.cond: Long Night’s Oath loses stacks when plunge timing is interrupted.

vars.title: Classic AoE Vermillion
vars.stats: Balance 70%+ CRIT Rate, CRIT DMG, and ATK; 110–140%+ ER depending on batteries.
vars.teams: Faruzan plus sustain and an Anemo energy source.
vars.when: Reliable general-purpose Xiao for grouped enemies and prolonged Burst rotations.
vars.cond: Use Skill charges before Burst to pre-funnel particles.

vars.title: Accessible Battery Team
vars.stats: ER can rise above 140% without C6 Faruzan; maintain CRIT balance and use ATK% Sands.
vars.teams: Sucrose or other Anemo battery, Bennett and a healer/shielder.
vars.when: For players without premium supports or weapons. Consistent Burst uptime outweighs occasional larger plunges.
vars.cond: Lithic Spear needs Liyue teammates for stronger passive.

vars.title: FFXX Premium Plunge
vars.stats: Aim for 45–64% displayed CRIT Rate on Marechaussee; invest the rest in CRIT DMG, ATK and sufficient ER.
vars.teams: Xianyun, Furina and ideally C6 Faruzan.
vars.when: Best for maximum single-target plunge damage and mobile buffs. Xianyun heals through Xiao’s HP drain.
vars.cond: CRIT Rate cap includes Marechaussee 36%.

vars.title: Bennett Plunge Hypercarry
vars.stats: Anemo DMG Goblet and strong CRIT rolls; ensure Burst uptime before stacking more ATK.
vars.teams: Bennett and Faruzan; add shielding or an Anemo battery.
vars.when: Use when playing inside Bennett’s field and maintaining consecutive high plunges.
vars.cond: Long Night’s Oath loses stacks when plunge timing is interrupted.

w.name: Song of Broken Pines
w.text: High base ATK, Physical DMG and team ATK SPD synergize with her Normal Attacks and Lightfall stacking. Reliable all-round signature; speed changes combos.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: CR and ATK buffs make this a top contender, sometimes stronger than her signature.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Huge ATK and an enemy-low-HP team ATK buff strengthen her Burst and Normal Attacks.

w.name: The Unforged
w.text: ATK stat and shield-enhanced ATK stacks offer strong DMG when protected.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: Energy Recharge eases Burst uptime; its vacuum blades add Physical damage during normal attacks. Excellent if struggling to fund her Burst.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacked DMG bonus provide excellent sustained damage at higher refinements. A shielder helps preserve stacks. High refinement improves value.

w.name: Akuoumaru
w.text: Raises Burst damage based on the party’s combined Energy costs, rewarding Burst-heavy teams. Use in high team-Burst-cost compositions. R5 particularly valuable.

w.name: Tidal Shadow
w.text: Craftable ATK weapon whose passive grants more ATK after Eula receives healing. Requires reliable healing and passive uptime. Refinements improve ATK buff.

a.text: Best general Physical build: Skill hits stack ATK and double the 2-piece Physical DMG bonus.
Unconditional 50% Physical DMG bonus, easier to use when 4-piece Pale Flame stacks are inconsistent.
With Furina’s HP changes, gains up to 36% CRIT Rate, making damage stats easier to balance.

t.name: Keomi Fox Vengeance
t.text: Keomi Fox brings the vengeance! Raiden enables Superconduct and energy; Furina buffs damage; Mika heals and boosts Physical attacks.

t.name: Frostbound Retribution
t.text: Raiden enables Superconduct, Rosaria supplies Cryo energy and CRIT support, and Zhongli shields Eula during Burst stacking.

t.name: Knights of High Heels and Mika
t.text: Fischl maintains Superconduct, Rosaria helps battery Eula, and Mika provides healing and Physical buffs.

t.name: Budget Icebreaker
t.text: Fischl enables Superconduct; Diona shields, heals, and batteries; Lisa offers DEF reduction with her Burst and Thrilling Tales support.

why.v:
Furina CRIT: Use Marechaussee Hunter with Furina and a healer; lower sheet CRIT Rate to account for its 36% bonus.
Shielded Carry: Serpent Spine or The Unforged shines with a strong shielder; prioritize uninterrupted Lightfall stacks.
Energy Comfort: Skyward Pride or an ER Sands helps if her Burst is not ready each rotation.
F2P Physical: Tidal Shadow with a healer offers a craftable option; use Pale Flame and prioritize enough ER.

seo.about: Eula is an on-field Physical DPS who builds Lightfall Sword stacks before a massive Burst detonation. Electro teammates enable Superconduct to lower Physical RES, while Cryo batteries help fund her costly Burst. Keep her on-field through the explosion when using Mika’s buffs.

vars.title: Furina Marechaussee
vars.stats: Target 40–64% sheet CRIT Rate before the 36% set bonus; favor CRIT DMG after reaching effective CRIT cap.
vars.teams: Furina plus a reliable healer such as Mika; an Electro teammate for Superconduct.
vars.when: When Furina is on the team and her HP fluctuations reliably maintain Marechaussee Hunter stacks.
vars.cond: Requires consistent HP changes.
vars.notes: Mika’s buffs need Eula to stay on-field through the Burst detonation.

vars.title: Shielded Physical Carry
vars.stats: Balance ATK and CRIT; ensure enough ER despite the lack of an ER weapon.
vars.teams: Bring Zhongli, Diona, or another reliable shielder plus an Electro Superconduct enabler.
vars.when: Best for comfortable Burst stacking and maintaining Serpent Spine stacks or The Unforged shield condition.
vars.cond: Shield uptime must cover Eula’s combo.
vars.notes: Shielding improves consistency but does not remove her energy requirements.

vars.title: Energy-Friendly Burst
vars.stats: Use ER Sands if necessary; often 140–160%+ ER on teams with weak Cryo battery support.
vars.teams: An Electro teammate and preferably a Cryo battery such as Rosaria or Diona.
vars.when: When inconsistent Burst uptime is a bigger damage loss than dropping some offensive substats.
vars.cond: ER varies greatly with teammates and Favonius procs.
vars.notes: Prioritize getting Burst every rotation over chasing a fixed ATK target.

vars.title: Craftable F2P
vars.stats: ATK% / Physical DMG / CRIT; build ER as needed for consistent Burst uptime.
vars.teams: A healer to activate Tidal Shadow, Electro for Superconduct, and ideally a Cryo battery.
vars.when: For low-spender or F2P teams seeking a reliable craftable weapon and accessible teammates.
vars.cond: Tidal Shadow passive requires receiving healing.
vars.notes: Diona can provide both healing and Cryo energy.

w.name: Sunny Morning Sleep-In
w.text: Huge EM boosts Swirl DMG and team healing.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Massive EM for reaction DMG and healing.

w.name: Starcaller's Watch
w.text: Very high EM makes it a strong stat stick for Swirl and healing; its shield-based team buff is usually inactive. No reliable shield application from Ifa.

w.name: Wandering Evenstar
w.text: EM secondary stat enhances reactions and healing.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: High EM supports healing and Swirl. Its Skill-reset passive is unreliable because casting Ifa’s Skill does not hit. Use for EM, not the reset.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Energy Recharge and neutral particles help Burst uptime and team rotations; build CRIT Rate to trigger its passive. Needs on-field CRIT hits.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable EM option that supports Swirl and healing; its reaction-triggered Elemental DMG bonus mainly helps personal damage. F2P craftable choice.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: Provides a large ATK buff to the next character after swapping, sacrificing personal EM and healing. Swap directly into an ATK-scaling carry. R5 preferred.

a.text: Best overall for an EM Swirl driver: increases Swirl damage and lowers the RES of swirled Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Team-buff alternative if someone else already wears Viridescent Venerer; trigger an applicable reaction for elemental DMG buffs.
EM-focused alternative that improves Swirl damage and healing when another Anemo teammate already supplies VV resistance shred.

t.name: Cacucu Air Control
t.text: Ororon adds Nightsoul and Electro; Furina supplies Hydro and buffs. Sayu adds healing and can hold VV for a CRIT Ifa build.

t.name: Storm Chasers
t.text: Ifa drives Xingqiu and Fischl while Ororon contributes off-field Electro and Nightsoul points, strengthening Electro-Charged reactions.

t.name: Moonlit Medevac
t.text: Ororon contributes Nightsoul points; Aino and Ineffa enable Lunar-Charged while Ifa drives, heals and Swirls.

t.name: Budget Air Ambulance
t.text: Accessible Taser-style team: Ifa drives off-field attacks and shreds RES. Without another Nightsoul unit, his reaction buff is weaker.

why.v:
EM Swirl Driver: 4pc Viridescent, triple EM, Sunny Morning or Sacrificial Fragments; drive Electro-Charged and heal on-hit.
Anemo CRIT DPS: 4pc Obsidian Codex; ATK% / Anemo / CRIT with Widsith or Cashflow. Best with a separate VV user.
Team Buff Support: 4pc Scroll or TTDS when appropriate; swap directly to an ATK carry. Keep enough EM and ER.
Extra Healing: Use a Healing Bonus circlet or Prototype Amber for greater sustain, especially with Furina.
F2P Reactions: Mappa Mare + 4pc Viridescent; pair Hydro/Electro off-field units and prioritize Level 90.

seo.about: Ifa is an on-field Anemo driver who fires Tonicshots during Nightsoul's Blessing, healing the team based on his EM. His passive boosts Swirl and Electro-Charged DMG using party Nightsoul points, making Ororon a valuable partner. Build EM for reactions and healing.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.title: Anemo CRIT DPS
vars.stats: ATK% / Anemo DMG / CRIT; prioritize CRIT, ATK and enough ER rather than triple EM.
vars.teams: Best with a second Anemo VV holder and damage buffers (e.g. Faruzan).
vars.when: Use for personal Tonicshot damage, particularly single-target. Obsidian Codex boosts CRIT Rate after Nightsoul-point consumption.
vars.cond: Team damage may fall without VV on someone else.
vars.notes: Cashflow performs best with consistent HP changes, such as Furina.

vars.title: Extra Healing / Furina
vars.stats: Use Healing Bonus circlet if needed; retain enough EM for reaction damage and healing.
vars.teams: Furina teams benefit from an additional healer if Ifa cannot keep pace.
vars.when: Use when survival or Fanfare generation is a problem rather than maximizing Swirl damage.
vars.cond: Prototype Amber requires using Burst.
vars.notes: Ifa heals teammates on Tonicshot hits, not passively off-field.

vars.title: Team Buffer / Scroll

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: Prioritize ER and EM; add CRIT Rate if Favonius is equipped.
vars.teams: Prefer another Anemo unit holding VV if choosing Scroll; TTDS needs an ATK-scaling swap target.
vars.when: Use when your main damage dealers benefit more from buffs or particle support than from Ifa’s own Swirl damage.
vars.cond: Scroll bonus requires relevant reactions.
vars.notes: Avoid duplicating VV on two units unless the team benefits from their separate coverage.

vars.title: F2P Electro-Charged Driver
vars.stats: EM / EM / EM; prioritize Level 90 and enough ER to use Burst as desired.
vars.teams: Bring strong off-field Hydro and Electro; Ororon improves Nightsoul-based buff when available.
vars.when: Low-spend setup focused on reactions and teamwide healing; Xingqiu, Fischl and Beidou all work.
vars.cond: Without other Natlan Nightsoul characters, his passive buff is smaller.
vars.notes: Mappa Mare is craftable; Sacrificial Fragments is gacha.

vars.title: Lunar-Charged Driver
vars.stats: Prioritize EM and ER; use CRIT-focused build only when teammates strongly buff personal damage.
vars.teams: Requires compatible Hydro and Electro Lunar-Charged partners such as Aino and Ineffa.
vars.when: Use to drive Lunar-Charged teams while Swirling and healing; Ororon boosts Ifa’s passive through Nightsoul points.
vars.cond: Exact best stats depend on team damage distribution.
vars.notes: C2 increases the Rescue Essentials cap and makes stacking easier.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: CD, Skill DMG and DEF bonuses suit Tamoto; Geo DMG from teammates strengthens its passive.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Huge CR and an HP-based ATK bonus boost her dual-scaling DMG. Avoid excess CR.

w.name: Peak Patrol Song
w.text: DEF-focused sword that can buff party Elemental DMG, but Chiori needs on-field Normal or Plunging hits to trigger it. Requires extra field time; utility choice.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: Excellent low-cost CD and CR while her HP stays above 90%. Keep HP above 90%. R5 recommended.

w.name: Cinnabar Spindle
w.text: DEF% and a DEF-scaling Skill hit bonus make this a powerful option for Tamoto.

w.name: Wolf-Fang
w.text: CRIT Rate and Skill/Burst DMG bonuses help her personal output; off-field hits do not stack its CRIT passive. Skill/Burst CRIT stacks require on-field hits.

w.name: Flute of Ezpitzal
w.text: Craftable DEF% weapon that can boost DEF after casting Skill, improving Tamoto damage. Accessible Natlan craftable.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and team particles on CRIT hits; sacrifices personal damage for utility. Passive requires CRIT while Chiori is on-field.

a.text: Strong Skill DMG amplification for Tamoto, which deals most of Chiori’s damage when played off-field.
a.stats: DEF% / Geo DMG or DEF% / CRIT

a.text: Stacks DEF and Geo DMG for both dolls and Burst; a flexible option with strong substats.
a.stats: DEF% / Geo DMG or DEF% / CRIT

a.text: Skill DMG plus DEF% is a practical interim set while farming a full 4-piece set.
a.stats: DEF% / Geo DMG or DEF% / CRIT

t.name: Oni Fashion Week
t.text: Itto’s Ushi and Zhongli’s pillar are Geo Constructs, enabling two Tamoto dolls at C0; Gorou buffs DEF.

t.name: Runway Ricochet
t.text: Navia gains Geo damage and Crystallize support; Furina buffs and Bennett heals. Chiori needs C1 for two dolls here.

t.name: Moonlit Couture
t.text: A Lunar-Crystallize Geo core can enable Chiori’s second Tamoto even at C0; check team sustain before using.

t.name: Budget Beauty Supplies
t.text: Ningguang and Geo Traveler create constructs for both Tamoto dolls at C0; Bennett adds healing and ATK.

why.v:
C0 Double Doll: Pair with a Geo Construct user or Lunar-Crystallize enabler for two Tamoto dolls. Otherwise expect lower damage.
C1 Navia Pair: C1 enables a second Tamoto with any other Geo teammate, including Navia and Noelle.
F2P CRIT Sword: R5 Harbinger of Dawn excels if Chiori stays above 90% HP; use DEF% / Geo or DEF% / CRIT artifacts.
Burst Optional: Skill is the priority. Burst every other rotation, or skip it when its field time and energy cost are not worthwhile.
On-Field C6: At C6, DEF-scaling Normal Attacks support an on-field carry build. Not recommended as a default C0 playstyle.

seo.about: Chiori is an off-field Geo DPS whose Tamoto dolls deal damage based on DEF and ATK. At C0, a Geo Construct or compatible Lunar-Crystallize interaction enables her second doll. C1 allows any other Geo teammate. Cast Skill twice for a quick swap and coordinated hits.

vars.title: C0 Double-Tamoto Off-Field
vars.stats: Prioritize CRIT and DEF%; little ER is needed when Burst is skipped.
vars.teams: Use a Geo Construct teammate or compatible Lunar-Crystallize enabler.
vars.when: Best for C0 Itto, Zhongli, Ningguang, or Geo Traveler setups; summon both dolls before swapping.
vars.cond: Needs construct or Lunar-Crystallize interaction.
vars.notes: The extra doll is a major part of Chiori’s personal output.

vars.title: C1 Navia Double Geo
vars.stats: DEF% / Geo or DEF% / CRIT. Tune ER only if using Burst.
vars.teams: Navia plus a healer or defensive support; another Geo character is required.
vars.when: With C1, Chiori brings two dolls to Navia teams without needing a Geo Construct.
vars.cond: C1 required for second Tamoto without another enabler.
vars.notes: At C0, this exact Navia/Furina/Bennett team produces only one doll.

vars.title: Budget DEF & CRIT
vars.stats: Aim for balanced CRIT and DEF; keep HP above 90% with Harbinger.
vars.teams: A Geo Construct teammate is preferred at C0.
vars.when: Low-spender setup using 3-star, craftable, or previously available event equipment.
vars.cond: Cinnabar Spindle is past-event only.
vars.notes: Choose weapons by ownership; a well-refined Harbinger can be especially efficient.

vars.title: Team Buff Utility
vars.stats: Build DEF for Peak Patrol; build CRIT Rate for Favonius triggering.
vars.teams: Teams that value elemental damage buffs or particles over Chiori’s own damage.
vars.when: A situational utility alternative when Chiori’s damage is not the team priority.
vars.cond: Peak Patrol requires on-field hits; Favonius must CRIT on-field.
vars.notes: Do not assume the Peak Patrol buff activates from off-field dolls.

vars.title: C6 On-Field Geo Carry
vars.stats: Invest in DEF%, Geo DMG, and CRIT; Normal Attack talent matters.
vars.teams: Geo teammates, buffs and sustain for extended field time.
vars.when: For C6 owners using Chiori’s enhanced Normal Attacks as the primary DPS.
vars.cond: C6 only.
vars.notes: A distinct playstyle; do not use these priorities for standard off-field Chiori.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: EM boosts Swirl and Kazuha’s Elemental DMG buff.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: EM converts to ER for Kazuha and shares some with allies.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Generates neutral particles on CRIT hits.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: ER substat and Skill reset can provide extra grouping and Anemo particles.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: High base ATK and ER help Burst uptime, though its offensive passive contributes little to an EM support build. Use when lacking better EM or team-battery options.

w.name: Iron Sting
w.text: Craftable EM stat boosts Swirl damage and Kazuha’s elemental buff; easy to use without wishing. May require an ER Sands if Burst is essential. R1 is sufficient for support.

w.name: Toukabou Shigure
w.text: Provides substantial EM for Swirl and elemental buffs; its marked-target passive mostly benefits personal damage. Event-limited; manage ER through artifacts.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Free fishing sword supplies ER; its Skill CRIT bonus is not a substitute for EM or Favonius team particles. Use when ER is the priority and other swords are unavailable.

a.text: Core support set: boosts Swirl and reduces Swirled Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo RES by 40%.
Budget 4-star support option: an on-field reaction gives teammates 120 EM for 8 seconds.
Specialized on-field Aggravate/Electro-Charged setups can reduce Skill cooldown through reactions. Not standard support.

t.name: Hydro Hurricane
t.text: Kazuha groups foes and buffs Hydro with Swirl/VV; Furina boosts damage and Xilonen adds healing, buffs, and RES Shred.

t.name: Emberleaf Waltz
t.text: Kazuha shreds and buffs Pyro for Arlecchino; Xingqiu enables Vaporize and Bennett boosts ATK. Avoid unwanted Hydro absorption.

t.name: Thunder in the Leaves
t.text: Yaoyao sustains Quicken; Kazuha buffs and shreds Electro, while Keqing and Fischl trigger Aggravate.

t.name: Budget Leaf Blower
t.text: Accessible National core: Xingqiu enables Vaporize, Bennett powers Xiangling, and Kazuha groups and shreds Pyro/Hydro RES.

why.v:
Full EM Buffer: 4pc Viridescent Venerer, EM/EM/EM, and Freedom-Sworn or Iron Sting; meet Burst ER needs first.
Team Battery: Favonius Sword plus some CRIT Rate generates particles for energy-hungry teams; keep 4pc VV.
Burst-Lite: In teams where Burst is unnecessary or disrupts reactions, focus on EM and short Skill rotations.
Budget Support: Iron Sting or the free Fleuve Cendre Ferryman; aim for VV, with Instructor as a temporary fallback.
Thunder Driver: 4pc Thundering Fury on-field is an unusual Electro-reaction option, not his default buffer build.

seo.about: Kazuha groups enemies, amplifies Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo DMG through his EM-scaling passive, and shreds their RES with Viridescent Venerer. Prioritize enough ER for teams needing his Burst, then stack EM. He cannot directly buff Dendro or Geo DMG with his passive.

vars.title: Favonius Team Battery
vars.stats: Get enough ER to Burst as required; add ~20%+ CRIT Rate to trigger Favonius reliably.
vars.teams: Energy-hungry allies; a target for Kazuha to hit while on-field.
vars.when: Choose this over pure EM when smoother team rotations are worth more than a slightly larger elemental buff.
vars.cond: Favonius must CRIT while Kazuha is on-field.
vars.notes: Exact ER depends on rotation, skills, particles and team batteries.

vars.title: Burst-Optional Quick Swap
vars.stats: Favor EM; reduce ER if Burst is intentionally skipped.
vars.teams: An element Kazuha can Swirl; team does not rely on Burst application.
vars.when: Use shorter Skill-only rotations where Burst would lengthen setup or disrupt Melt/Vaporize.
vars.cond: Only when the team does not require his Burst.
vars.notes: The VV shred requires Kazuha to trigger a Swirl on-field.

vars.title: F2P Elemental Support
vars.stats: Aim for EM/EM/EM; switch to ER Sands when Burst uptime cannot be met.
vars.teams: Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo allies who appreciate VV shred.
vars.when: An accessible setup without premium swords; 4pc VV remains the long-term priority.
vars.cond: Toukabou Shigure was event-limited.
vars.notes: Instructor is a temporary or niche 4-star alternative, not an equal substitute for VV.

vars.title: Electro Reaction Driver
vars.stats: Build EM and sufficient ER; prioritize reactions over personal CRIT.
vars.teams: Frequent Electro-related reactions with an Electro aura and off-field applicators.
vars.when: Use a specialized on-field cooldown-reduction playstyle for fun or niche multi-target teams.
vars.cond: Thundering Fury requires Kazuha to trigger its qualifying reactions.
vars.notes: More field time than normal; usually less universally useful than 4pc VV support.

vars.title: C6 Anemo Carry
vars.stats: Hybrid EM/ATK/Anemo/CRIT is team-dependent; compare to EM-centric normal builds.
vars.teams: C6 Kazuha, strong personal-damage buffs and planned on-field time.
vars.when: Optional investment build that exploits C6 Anemo infusion and EM-based attack bonuses.
vars.cond: Requires C6; not a general recommendation.
vars.notes: Weapon and artifact optimization differs substantially from EM-support Kazuha.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: High CRIT Rate and ATK buffs when Skill hits or Dehya takes damage; boosts HP when unshielded. Best for on-field damage; avoid shields for the HP passive.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Large ATK bonus and a teamwide ATK buff against low-HP enemies; straightforward Burst damage. Team ATK buff activates below 30% enemy HP.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Very high CRIT DMG helps Burst builds, but its DEF-based Normal and Charged Attack passive does not buff Burst punches. Primarily a CRIT stat stick.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: Energy Recharge helps costly Burst rotations; high base ATK supports her punches. Vacuum blades require Normal or Charged Attacks and do not trigger from Burst punches.

w.name: Akuoumaru
w.text: Boosts Burst damage based on the total Energy costs of the team, suiting high-cost Burst lineups. Best with high combined team Burst costs. High refinements improve value.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking damage bonus can strengthen Burst DPS; stacks are harder to maintain when taking hits. A shielder helps retain stacks, but blocks some Beacon/Vourukasha synergies. Higher refinements increase damage.

w.name: Favonius Greatsword
w.text: Generates neutral particles with on-field CRIT hits, helping teammates and offering ER for Dehya. Support utility; build enough CRIT Rate to trigger. Refinements help proc reliability.

w.name: Tidal Shadow
w.text: Craftable ATK claymore; its ATK buff activates after Dehya receives healing, making it useful with a healer. Requires healing to activate the passive.

a.text: A consistent Burst-focused set: Energy Recharge and Burst DMG fit her high-cost on-field rotation.
HP changes grant CRIT Rate during on-field play; strong with Furina or reliable self-damage and healing.
a.stats: ER% / ATK% · Pyro DMG · CRIT DMG

a.text: Boosts Skill and Burst damage after Dehya takes damage; stronger with reliable stacks and lower ER needs.

t.name: Flame-Mane Encore
t.text: Furina enables Vaporize and damage buffs, Kazuha shreds Pyro RES, and Bennett buffs and heals Dehya. Manage Furina team HP.

t.name: Burn Notice
t.text: Burning activates Emilie while Dehya drives Pyro damage. Bennett powers Burst; Kazuha groups and shreds Pyro RES.

t.name: Overload and Out
t.text: Chevreuse amplifies Pyro/Electro teams, Fischl supplies off-field Electro, and Raiden helps recharge Dehya’s costly Burst.

t.name: Budget Fire Brigade
t.text: An accessible Mono Pyro core: Bennett batteries and buffs, Xiangling adds damage, and Sucrose groups and shreds Pyro RES.

why.v:
Furina Burst DPS: Marechaussee Hunter with Furina; adjust CRIT Rate for its 36% bonus and keep enough ER for every Burst.
High-Investment Burst: Vourukasha's Glow becomes attractive with reliable damage stacks and lower ER needs, especially at C4+.
Defensive Support: Tenacity of the Millelith + Favonius Greatsword; prioritize HP% and CRIT Rate for team protection and energy.
Burgeon Trigger: Flower of Paradise Lost or Gilded Dreams with EM/EM/EM. Slow Skill hits mean Burgeon is supplemental.
Accessible Burst: Tidal Shadow or Akuoumaru plus Emblem; run Bennett and a Pyro battery for reliable rotations.

seo.about: Dehya is a flexible Pyro bruiser who unleashes Burst punches or protects allies with DMG mitigation and interruption resistance. Her on-field DMG needs substantial ER and investment; off-field support and Burgeon instead focus on her Skill. Her Burst punches do not trigger Normal Attack-linked effects.

vars.title: Furina Vaporize Burst
vars.stats: Build enough ER to Burst every rotation, then CRIT and ATK. Marechaussee adds up to 36% CRIT Rate; avoid overcapping.
vars.teams: Furina with dependable healing, plus Pyro energy support; Kazuha or another RES shredder helps.
vars.when: Choose this for an invested on-field Dehya with reliable HP fluctuations and Furina buffs.
vars.cond: Furina + consistent HP changes; Burst punches cannot trigger Xingqiu/Yelan Burst attacks.
vars.notes: Furina application, reaction frequency and ER needs vary by rotation; test your exact team.

vars.title: High-Constellation Burst
vars.stats: C1 makes HP% more valuable; C4 reduces ER burden, permitting more CRIT and offensive stats.
vars.teams: Pyro battery and healing; Dehya needs to take damage for Vourukasha stacks.
vars.when: For players with C4–C6 who can maintain damage-taken stacks and Burst uptime.
vars.cond: Damage must reach Dehya; shield-heavy teams can reduce set uptime.
vars.notes: Emblem is still a dependable alternative, especially when ER demands stay high.

vars.title: Off-Field Defensive Support
vars.stats: HP% / HP% / HP% for mitigation; use CRIT Rate circlet with Favonius. Little or no Burst ER required.
vars.teams: An on-field ally who values interruption resistance and Pyro application. Team may still need healing.
vars.when: Pick this for Skill-based protection and Tenacity ATK buffs instead of Dehya’s personal damage.
vars.cond: Her Skill has downtime; defensive mitigation is not a full substitute for healing.
vars.notes: Skill coordinated hits maintain Tenacity during field uptime. Instructor is a lower-rarity reaction alternative.

vars.title: Burgeon Skill Trigger
vars.stats: EM / EM / EM; prioritize character level 90 and EM, with HP% if more protection is needed. No Burst ER required.
vars.teams: Hydro and Dendro sources to produce Bloom cores plus a healer or additional sustain.
vars.when: Use Dehya’s Skill to trigger occasional Burgeons without using Burst.
vars.cond: Coordinated Skill hits are slow and may miss cores; Burgeon performance is limited.
vars.notes: Do not recommend her as an especially consistent sole Burgeon trigger.

vars.title: F2P-Friendly Burst
vars.stats: ER Sands if needed, Pyro DMG Goblet, CRIT Circlet; balance ER before damage.
vars.teams: Bennett and preferably Xiangling or another Pyro teammate for particles; healer required for Tidal Shadow.
vars.when: For accessible weapon options while retaining Dehya’s on-field Burst playstyle.
vars.cond: Tidal Shadow needs healing; Luxurious Sea-Lord is an old limited event weapon.
vars.notes: Lower-constellation Burst damage is modest; prioritize comfortable rotations over perfect CRIT rolls.

vars.title: Furina Vaporize Burst
vars.stats: Build enough ER to Burst every rotation, then CRIT and ATK. Marechaussee adds up to 36% CRIT Rate; avoid overcapping.
vars.teams: Furina with dependable healing, plus Pyro energy support; Kazuha or another RES shredder helps.
vars.when: Choose this for an invested on-field Dehya with reliable HP fluctuations and Furina buffs.
vars.cond: Furina + consistent HP changes; Burst punches cannot trigger Xingqiu/Yelan Burst attacks.
vars.notes: Furina application, reaction frequency and ER needs vary by rotation; test your exact team.

w.name: Thundering Pulse
w.text: Signature CRIT DMG bow with ATK and stacking Normal Attack DMG. Shimenawa energy consumption can help maintain its third stack. Manage energy below 100% for all three stacks.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Huge CD and unconditional HP.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: Provides CD and Charged Attack/ATK bonuses.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate, CRIT DMG, and high base ATK, making it an easy general-purpose option.

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: High CRIT Rate and Skill/Burst DMG buffs; its ATK stacking is awkward for a Normal Attack-focused rotation. Not all passive stacks are convenient to maintain.

w.name: Rust
w.text: One of her best bows at high refinements: directly boosts her Normal Attack damage, which supplies most of her output. Especially strong at R4–R5. R4–R5 recommended.

w.name: Slingshot
w.text: Outstanding 3★ CRIT Rate option that buffs fast, close-range Normal Attack hits. Can rival premium bows with strong ATK buffs. Use Bennett and/or Yun Jin; stay close enough for passive. R5 recommended.

w.name: Hamayumi
w.text: Accessible ATK bow that buffs Normal Attacks, but its full-energy passive conflicts with Shimenawa energy consumption. Better without 4pc Shimenawa; avoid spending energy for full passive. R5 improves bonus.

a.text: A reliable 50% Normal Attack DMG boost after Skill use.
Can rival Shimenawa with frequent Normal Attack procs; performance varies with latency and reaction timing.
With Furina-driven HP changes.
a.stats: ATK% / EM · Pyro DMG · CRIT; lower sheet CRIT Rate

t.name: Fireworks Finale
t.text: Yelan enables Vaporize, Yun Jin strengthens rapid Normal Attacks, and Zhongli prevents interruptions while shredding RES.

t.name: Summer Night Encore
t.text: Double Hydro supports Vaporize; Furina buffs damage and Jean heals and can shred Pyro RES when Pyro is Swirled.

t.name: Sparkler Overload
t.text: Pyro/Electro-only lineup unlocks Chevreuse buffs; Fischl and Beidou add damage and Beidou aids interruption resistance.

t.name: Discount Fireworks
t.text: Xingqiu enables Vaporize and adds resistance; Bennett supplies ATK and heals while Layla protects Normal Attack strings.

why.v:
Vaporize: Use Yelan or Xingqiu for Hydro; ATK% or EM Sands depends on buffs and substats. Keep Normal Attack strings uninterrupted.
Furina Setup: 4pc Marechaussee Hunter is excellent with Furina and reliable healing. Account for its 36% CRIT Rate buff.
Budget Bow: R5 Slingshot performs especially well with Bennett or Yun Jin; high-refinement Rust is a premier 4★ choice.
Burst Usage: Shimenawa usually favors skipping Burst. Outside Shimenawa, use Burst when useful without delaying Skill windows.
Overloaded: Chevreuse Pyro/Electro teams emphasize raw Pyro damage and Overloaded; avoid stacking EM solely for Overloaded.

seo.about: Yoimiya is an on-field Pyro DPS who rapidly fires infused Normal Attacks after using her Skill. Vaporize teams excel against single targets, especially with a shielder to protect her full attack string. Prioritize Normal Attack talent levels; her Burst is optional, particularly with Shimenawa.

vars.title: Furina / Marechaussee
vars.stats: Use less sheet CRIT Rate to account for up to 36% from Marechaussee. ATK% or EM Sands based on buffs.
vars.teams: Furina plus sufficient party healing; add reliable Hydro application if needed.
vars.when: Use when Furina is available and can maintain the HP fluctuations required for Marechaussee.
vars.cond: Requires consistent HP changes; healers matter.
vars.notes: Marechaussee is strong with Furina, not a generic set for standard Yoimiya teams.

vars.title: High-Refinement Rust
vars.stats: Balance CRIT stats from artifacts because Rust gives ATK% rather than CRIT.
vars.teams: Any Yoimiya team that preserves complete Normal Attack sequences.
vars.when: Use when you have a high-refinement Rust but do not want to pull a signature 5★ bow.
vars.cond: R4–R5 recommended for top performance.
vars.notes: Strong in Vaporize or raw Pyro builds; monitor Shimenawa Energy requirement.

vars.title: F2P Slingshot Vape
vars.stats: Prioritize ATK% buffs and CRIT DMG; Slingshot provides substantial CRIT Rate. Add EM for Vaporize.
vars.teams: Bennett or Yun Jin strongly recommended, plus Xingqiu or Yelan; shielding helps.
vars.when: Low-spender setup using an accessible R5 three-star bow without giving up strong single-target damage.
vars.cond: R5 Slingshot; stay close enough for its hit-speed passive.
vars.notes: If using Hamayumi, prefer sets that do not drain Energy and preserve its full-Energy bonus.

vars.title: Chevreuse Overloaded
vars.stats: Favor ATK% and CRIT; EM is less important for a raw Pyro damage-focused Chevreuse setup.
vars.teams: Chevreuse with only Pyro and Electro teammates; sustain/interruption resistance recommended.
vars.when: Use when you prefer a reaction team that does not need Hydro or Vaporize setups.
vars.cond: Chevreuse passive team restriction must be met.
vars.notes: Fischl and Beidou are accessible Electro damage options; Beidou Burst favors multi-target fights.

w.name: Everlasting Moonglow
w.text: HP% and Healing Bonus improve sustain; Normal Attacks during Burst gain damage and refund Energy. Mostly for on-field Kokomi. On-field Burst driver.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Large Elemental Mastery for Kokomi-owned Bloom reactions and a small team EM share. Not a standard healing-support upgrade. Bloom-trigger build.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: At R5, swapping from Kokomi grants the next character a large ATK buff. Outstanding for teams with an ATK-scaling carry. Swap directly into the main ATK DPS. R5 recommended.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: HP% boosts healing; casting Burst restores Energy and heals the team. Comfortable craftable choice for on-field or refresh builds. R5 improves Energy return.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: After Kokomi triggers an Electro reaction, grants relevant Elemental DMG Bonuses to teammates. Niche but useful in Electro-Charged teams. Kokomi must trigger an Electro-related reaction.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: Elemental Mastery improves Bloom damage; Skill cooldown reset can reposition the jellyfish, though it is chance-based. Bloom teams with mobile enemies. Higher refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Fruit of Fulfillment
w.text: Energy Recharge substat helps Burst uptime; its passive trades ATK for Elemental Mastery, especially useful when triggering Bloom. Bloom-focused use.

w.name: Magic Guide
w.text: Cheap Elemental Mastery option for Bloom reactions; its damage passive is inconsistent and does not boost reaction damage. Budget Bloom builds.

a.text: Jellyfish hits can maintain the partywide ATK buff. Ideal for off-field Kokomi supporting an ATK-scaling carry.
Converts healing into extra Physical bubble damage. Excellent for Kokomi driving on-field during Burst.
Boosts Bloom damage when Kokomi triggers cores; only choose it when her Bloom ownership justifies an EM build.

t.name: Watatsumi Winter
t.text: Kokomi maintains Freeze and healing with her jellyfish; Shenhe buffs Ayaka while Kazuha groups and shreds Cryo resistance.

t.name: Blooming Tides
t.text: Kokomi drives Nilou Bountiful Blooms and heals self-damage. Build EM on Kokomi; keep Deepwood on a Dendro teammate.

t.name: Storm-Surf Society
t.text: Kokomi drives Electro-Charged while sustaining the team; Fischl and Beidou deal off-field damage, and Sucrose groups and shreds.

t.name: Fanfare by the Sea
t.text: On-field Kokomi heals the team to build Furina Fanfare while Yelan deals off-field damage and Kazuha buffs Hydro.

why.v:
On-field Driver: 4pc Ocean-Hued Clam; HP%/ER, Hydro DMG, Healing Bonus. Burst and Normal Attacks heal the team and deal extra Clam damage.
Nilou Bloom: 4pc Flower of Paradise Lost; EM-heavy stats and Sacrificial Fragments. Trade some EM for healing if Bountiful Core self-damage is too high.
Electro-Charged: 4pc Tenacity or Ocean-Hued Clam; Hakushin Ring if Kokomi triggers Electro reactions. Supports off-field Electro teammates.
Skill-only Support: 4pc Tenacity with R5 Thrilling Tales; HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus. Skip Burst if 12s jellyfish uptime covers the rotation.

seo.about: Kokomi is a versatile Hydro healer whose jellyfish applies Hydro and sustains teammates off-field. Her Burst refreshes the jellyfish and lets her heal the entire team while attacking on-field. Build HP and enough ER for your rotation.

vars.title: On-field Hydro Driver
vars.stats: HP% or ER Sands / Hydro DMG Goblet / Healing Bonus Circlet; prioritize Burst uptime, HP and healing.
vars.teams: Off-field damage teammates who benefit from Kokomi attacking during Burst.
vars.when: Use Kokomi on-field after Burst to heal the entire team and drive Hydro reactions; Ocean-Hued Clam converts her healing into damage.
vars.cond: Burst must be available consistently.

vars.title: Nilou Bloom Trigger
vars.stats: EM Sands / EM or HP% Goblet / EM or Healing Bonus Circlet; level Kokomi to 90.
vars.teams: Nilou with Dendro and Hydro only; a Dendro ally should carry Deepwood Memories.
vars.when: Use when Kokomi owns many Bloom triggers. Prioritize EM while retaining enough healing to survive Bountiful Core damage.
vars.cond: Only for Nilou Bountiful Bloom teams.
vars.notes: Bloom ownership varies by team and rotation; do not force full EM if healing becomes inadequate.

vars.title: Electro-Charged Driver
vars.stats: Prioritize HP, Healing Bonus and ER; Hakushin requires Kokomi to trigger an Electro-related reaction.
vars.teams: Off-field Electro teammates such as Fischl and Beidou.
vars.when: Drive Electro-Charged with Hydro Normal Attacks while healing and enabling Electro teammates.
vars.cond: Hakushin buff depends on Kokomi triggering the reaction.

vars.title: Short-Rotation Skill Support
vars.stats: HP% Sands / HP% Goblet / Healing Bonus Circlet; minimal ER if skipping Burst.
vars.teams: Carry that appreciates Hydro application and ATK buffs; ideally stationary enemies.
vars.when: Use jellyfish healing and Hydro application without relying on an every-rotation Burst.
vars.cond: Skill uptime is not continuous without a Burst refresh or other timing plan.
vars.notes: Jellyfish cannot follow moving opponents.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: Her rapid-hit Burst stacks Elegy to grant team EM and ATK; its ER substat helps meet demanding Burst needs. Ideal in reaction teams benefiting from EM and ATK.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: ER and neutral particles help Amber and her team cycle Bursts. Build CRIT Rate and land a field-time CRIT to trigger it. Requires CRIT hits while Amber is on-field. Higher refinements improve proc consistency.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: Provides substantial ER, but the Skill reset is inconsistent because Baron Bunny may explode after Amber has left the field. Use mainly for its ER substat; do not rely on the reset.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: Event bow with ER and a rotating DMG bonus.

w.name: Sacrificial Bow
w.text: Fishing bow with ER and modest extra damage. Practical permanent-access fallback for Burst uptime. Purchased through Sumeru fishing exchange.

w.name: Fading Twilight
w.text: Normal Attacks may group smaller enemies briefly; its CRIT Rate can help Fav-like stat goals, but lacks ER. Paid Battle Pass; only a niche utility choice.

a.text: Reliable 20% party ATK buff after Burst.
a.stats: ER · flexible goblet · CRIT Rate (Fav) / flexible

a.text: Reaction-triggered team EM buff.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Situational elemental DMG buff if Amber triggers a relevant reaction; less potent without Nightsoul mechanics.

t.name: Outrider VV Vape
t.text: Amber sets up Pyro for Kazuha to Swirl, enabling Pyro RES shred before Hu Tao attacks. Xingqiu enables Vaporize; no dedicated sustain.

t.name: Firework Support Crew
t.text: Triple Pyro supports Lyney. Amber offers Pyro Resonance, Burst utility and possible Elegy/Noblesse buffs; Zhongli protects charged shots.

t.name: Outrider Frostfire
t.text: Alternate Melt DPS build: Citlali offers Cryo and protection while Xilonen and Bennett boost Amber’s Charged Shots.

t.name: Bunny Bloom Patrol
t.text: Alternate EM Burgeon build: Collei and Kokomi form Dendro Cores; Rosaria adds Freeze. Aim Pyro shots at cores, not enemies.

why.v:
Melt Charged Shot: 4pc Wanderer’s Troupe; Astral Vulture’s Crimson Plumage or Hamayumi; EM/ATK%, Pyro, CRIT. Normal Attack first.
C2+ Bunny Bomber: 4pc Crimson Witch; manual Baron Bunny foot detonation at C2. C4 gives a second charge; prioritize Skill.
Burgeon Trigger: 4pc Flower of Paradise Lost; EM/EM/EM, Level 90. Aim Charged Shots at Dendro Cores; avoid Burst-driven Burning.
Budget Burst Support: Favonius Warbow and 4pc Noblesse or Instructor; stack ER and CRIT Rate for Favonius.
Reverse Melt Utility: Fast Burst Pyro enables a short Cryo Melt window and shield breaking; requires deliberate team timing.

seo.about: Amber is a flexible Pyro support whose rapid-hit Burst enables Pyro Swirls, shield breaking, and buffs from Elegy or support artifacts. She needs substantial Energy Recharge for frequent Bursts. Her alternate playstyles include C0 Melt Charged Shots, C2+ Baron Bunny detonations, and EM-based Burgeon.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.title: Melt Charged Shot
vars.stats: EM or ATK% / Pyro DMG / CRIT; 150–300 EM as a starting aim; level Normal Attack first.
vars.teams: Reliable Cryo aura, protection against interruption, and offensive buffs.
vars.when: For C0+ Amber fans who enjoy aimed-shot Melt; a balanced CRIT build is safer against weak-spotless bosses.
vars.cond: Accuracy and Cryo uptime matter.
vars.notes: Shimenawa consumes energy. Hamayumi rewards saving Burst; do not combine those assumptions indiscriminately.

vars.title: C2+ Bunny Bomber
vars.stats: Build EM/ATK%, Pyro DMG and CRIT; prioritize Skill over Normal Attack as C4+ becomes available.
vars.teams: Pyro-friendly Melt setup and time to detonate Baron Bunny with fully charged shots at its feet.
vars.when: Use when you want big manual Baron Bunny detonation damage and AoE.
vars.cond: C2 required; C4 strongly preferred.
vars.notes: C2 enables manual foot detonation, and C4 adds a second charge and lowers cooldown.

vars.title: Burgeon Trigger
vars.stats: Level 90; EM/EM/EM with maximum EM. Talent investment is optional; Burst is not part of standard rotation.
vars.teams: Reliable Dendro Core generation from Hydro + Dendro, plus interruption resistance or Freeze.
vars.when: Aim Amber’s Charged Shots at Dendro Cores to trigger controlled AoE Burgeon.
vars.cond: Needs generated cores; avoid aiming at enemies and causing Burning.
vars.notes: Avoid Burst because heavy Pyro application may prevent Dendro Core production.

vars.title: Accessible Burst Utility
vars.stats: Prioritize ER; add CRIT Rate if using Favonius. Offensive stats are optional.
vars.teams: ATK-scaling carry for Noblesse, or reaction-oriented carry for Instructor.
vars.when: Use when you want Amber’s quick Pyro setup and team buffs without premium weapons.
vars.cond: Instructor must trigger a reaction while Amber is on-field.
vars.notes: ER varies widely with Favonius procs; do not assume Burst uptime at low ER.

vars.title: Reverse Melt Enabler
vars.stats: Prioritize Burst access with ER; personal damage is secondary.
vars.teams: Cryo characters that can use a short, rapid Pyro application window.
vars.when: Use Burst to help set up specific reverse Melt actions or break shields.
vars.cond: Short Pyro window; not a substitute for sustained off-field Pyro.
vars.notes: Check rotation timing and aura consistency for the exact team.

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: Craftable EM polearm that restores Energy after Skill, easing Burst uptime while scaling Burgeon damage. Use Burst before Skill to avoid Kitain draining Energy needed for Burst. R3–R5 preferred.

w.name: Kitain Cross Spear
w.text: Offers substantial EM for stronger Burgeon explosions, but its damage passive does not boost Burgeon itself. Only if you can meet the higher ER requirement without Kitain.

w.name: Dragon's Bane
w.text: Provides ER and team particles.

w.name: Engulfing Lightning
w.text: HP% strengthens the shield and its passive can restore Energy, letting Thoma invest elsewhere. Only useful when he receives healing during rotations.

w.name: Rightful Reward
w.text: Craftable EM alternative; its leaf can give the on-field ally ATK but does not increase Burgeon reaction damage. Best after solving Burst energy needs.

w.name: Moonpiercer
w.text: Easy HP% option for stronger shielding, not Burgeon damage or Energy restoration. Shield-support variation only; high ER needed from artifacts.

a.text: Best Burgeon DMG set by a small margin.
Nearly as strong as Flower and usually more efficient to farm; grants valuable EM in mixed-element teams.
Simple 160-EM bridge build while farming a complete four-piece set.

t.name: Burgeon House Rules
t.text: Nahida and Xingqiu create Cores; Kokomi drives Hydro and heals while Thoma’s Burst triggers Burgeon.

t.name: Garden of Fireworks
t.text: Ayato drives Hydro during Thoma’s Burst, Nahida supplies Dendro.

t.name: Budget Bloom Patrol
t.text: Accessible Burgeon core: infuse Dendro Traveler’s Burst with Hydro, not Pyro.

t.name: Shielded Summer
t.text: Shield-support variation: Yoimiya’s Normal Attacks refresh Thoma’s shield.

why.v:
Shield Support: Favonius Lance + 4pc Noblesse; ER/HP%/HP% or CR. Keep Burst available to refresh his shield with Normal Attacks.
Hybrid Burgeon: Keep Flower or Gilded; replace an EM main stat with HP% only if additional shielding is essential. Burgeon DMG falls.
F2P Burgeon: Kitain Cross Spear and 4pc Gilded (or 2pc EM + 2pc EM). Prioritize ER before stacking EM.
C4 Energy Relief: C4 restores 15 Energy after Burst; adjust ER to your team and invest extra rolls in EM or HP.
C6 Shield Buffer: C6 buffs teammates’ Normal.

seo.about: Thoma triggers Burgeon with coordinated Pyro strikes from his Burst, turning Dendro Cores into powerful AoE explosions. Prioritize Level 90, enough Energy Recharge to Burst consistently, then Elemental Mastery. He also offers a separate HP-focused shield-support build, especially for Normal Attack users.

vars.title: Shield Support
vars.stats: ER or HP% Sands / HP% Goblet / HP% Circlet (CRIT Rate for Favonius). ER first, then HP%.
vars.teams: Normal Attack-focused carry to refresh stacked shields; Burst uptime is essential.
vars.when: Choose for Yoimiya, Wanderer, or another Normal Attack user when protection matters more than Burgeon damage.
vars.cond: Single-Pyro teams can need especially high ER.
vars.notes: C4 cuts Energy needs; Favonius requires CRIT. Tenacity + Emblem is a mixed HP/ER option.

vars.title: Hybrid Burgeon / Shield
vars.stats: After meeting ER, replace one EM piece with HP% only if needed for survivability.
vars.teams: Dendro + Hydro Core generation and a driver using Normal Attacks.
vars.when: Use when Thoma is the main defensive unit and you need stronger shields at the cost of some Burgeon damage.
vars.cond: Enough ER for Burst every rotation.
vars.notes: Level 90 remains important for Burgeon damage. Keep another unit on Deepwood Memories.

vars.title: F2P Burgeon Starter
vars.stats: ER Sands if required; otherwise EM/EM/EM. Level Thoma to 90.
vars.teams: Accessible Hydro + Dendro teammates; avoid Pyro infusing Dendro Traveler Burst.
vars.when: Use craftable equipment and efficiently farmed artifacts to start a Burgeon team without premium weapons.
vars.cond: Kitain refinements reduce ER demand.
vars.notes: Do not assume limited-time event weapons are owned. Favor a healer against Core self-damage.

vars.title: C4+ Burgeon Efficiency
vars.stats: C4 refunds Energy; lower ER only after confirming smooth Burst uptime, then add EM.
vars.teams: C4+ Thoma with Hydro + Dendro and enough team Energy generation.
vars.when: Use when C4 allows improved EM investment while retaining reliable Burgeon rotations.
vars.cond: Only at C4 or higher.
vars.notes: With Kitain, cast Burst before Skill. The exact ER need depends on team, Skills, and Favonius procs.

vars.title: C6 Normal Attack Buffer
vars.stats: ER and HP% first; CRIT Rate only to support Favonius.
vars.teams: C6 Thoma and on-field carry benefiting from Normal, Charged or Plunging Attack DMG.
vars.when: Adds offensive utility to a shield-support team when Thoma gains or refreshes his Blazing Barrier.
vars.cond: Only at C6.
vars.notes: This is a shield-support variant, not a Burgeon-specific damage upgrade.
