w.name: Exaiphanes Blade
w.text: Best all-round option: strong ER and team-neutral particles when Pyro Traveler crits on-field.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Premium EM sword with an additional teamwide attack buff after triggering reactions.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: EM adds reaction DMG while the passive gives Pyro Traveler and allies ER.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: At R5, a Skill reset can support shorter rotations; otherwise less consistent than Favonius. Primarily for ~16-second rotations. R5 strongly preferred.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Provides ER and improves Skill damage. A good legacy option when Favonius particles are unnecessary. Past limited event; unavailable to new players.

w.name: Festering Desire
w.text: Fishing sword grants ER and temporary post-Skill ER, helping a budget support Burst consistently.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Craftable EM sword for Burgeon or Overloaded triggering after meeting Burst energy needs. Reaction-trigger setup; little help with ER.

w.name: Iron Sting
w.text: Craftable ER option; its EM leaf buff is conditional on triggering Dendro-related reactions. Best with Burning or Burgeon; ally must collect the leaf.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Best general support set: Nightsoul-aligned Pyro reactions grant large Elemental DMG buffs to relevant team elements.
Skill hits maintain the team ATK buff when Scroll is already assigned to another support.
For Kinich/Emilie Burning teams when no teammate holds Deepwood; reduces enemy Dendro RES.

t.name: Wildfire Vanguard
t.text: Maintains Burning for Kinich and Emilie. Equip Traveler with Deepwood if nobody else uses it; Bennett buffs Kinich.

t.name: Overload Patrol
t.text: Off-field Pyro sustains Overloaded for Chevreuse; Sara boosts Raiden. Scroll on Traveler provides team buffs.

t.name: Frostfire Relay
t.text: Nahida helps sustain Burning so Wriothesley can Melt; Traveler adds Pyro and Scroll buffs. Pyro alone is not enough.

t.name: Shark-Fin Spark
t.text: A precise single-target Vape setup for Mualani; Traveler’s slow Pyro can struggle in multi-target encounters. Scroll may be redundant.

why.v:
Scroll Support: 4pc Scroll and Favonius: prioritize ER and reliable Pyro reactions to buff teammates.
Kinich Burning: 4pc Deepwood if absent elsewhere; sustain Burning for Kinich and Emilie.
Burgeon Trigger: 4pc Flower of Paradise Lost, EM weapon, level 90; reach ER needs before stacking EM.
C6 On-Field: 4pc Obsidian Codex, Pyro DMG/CRIT; Pyro-infused attacks only during Nightsoul Blessing.
Burst Nuke: Invest Burst, CRIT and ATK; Vaporize or Melt the initial hit with proper enemy aura.

seo.about: Pyro Traveler supplies off-field Pyro through their Nightsoul Skill and boosts teammates with C1 and Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City. Tap Skill follows melee allies; Hold Skill targets enemies for ranged teams. Their Pyro application is slow.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.title: Kinich Burning Support

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: Prioritize ER to Burst consistently; CRIT Rate if using Favonius.
vars.teams: Kinich plus Dendro/Burning; put Deepwood on Traveler only if nobody else carries it.
vars.when: Use to maintain Burning and shred Dendro RES while Kinich and Emilie deal damage.
vars.cond: Deepwood effect must be maintained on targets.

vars.title: Burgeon Trigger
vars.stats: Level 90; ER until reliable Burst, then EM/EM/EM when feasible.
vars.teams: Consistent Hydro and Dendro application, healing/sustain, and Bloom Core creation.
vars.when: Tap Skill can trigger Burgeon on nearby Dendro Cores. Use when Traveler owns the reaction damage.
vars.cond: Keep Skill in range of Cores; manage Burning interference.

vars.title: Overloaded Reaction Support

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: ER first; EM matters only when Traveler frequently owns Overloaded reactions.
vars.teams: Chevreuse teams restricted to Pyro/Electro; enough Electro application.
vars.when: Supplies off-field Pyro and optional Scroll buff to Pyro/Electro damage dealers.
vars.cond: Reaction ownership varies; do not assume all Overloads belong to Traveler.

vars.title: C6 On-Field Pyro
vars.stats: ATK%/Pyro DMG/CRIT; balance CRIT around Obsidian Codex and Energy needs.
vars.teams: C6 Traveler; strong external buffs, with Furina specifically for Marechaussee.
vars.when: C6 enables Pyro-converted Normal/Charged attacks during Nightsoul Blessing for an invested alternative build.
vars.cond: Requires C6; niche compared with dedicated on-field Pyro DPS.

vars.title: Vaporize / Melt Burst

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: ER for each Burst; then CRIT, ATK and EM on reaction-enabled hits.
vars.teams: Reliable Hydro or Cryo aura before Traveler's initial Burst strike.
vars.when: Use an invested Burst for a single amplified Pyro hit while retaining some off-field utility.
vars.cond: Reaction aura and Burst availability required.

vars.title: Alternative ATK Buffer
vars.stats: ER first; Favonius CRIT Rate if equipped.
vars.teams: Another teammate already uses Scroll; main carry values ATK buffs.
vars.when: Tenacity gives consistent ATK buff through Skill ticks; Noblesse is an option for Burst-dependent setups.
vars.cond: Do not stack redundant artifact buffs.

mats: The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Premium CRIT Rate and EM-to-ATK conversion benefit reaction-focused Pyronado. Do not waste field time stacking its passive. Best when reactions and EM investment matter.

w.name: Engulfing Lightning
w.text: Converts ER into ATK and buffs Burst DMG.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Large CRIT DMG and HP-based ATK make it a strong damage option, though its low-HP bonus is not always active. Meet ER needs through artifacts and teammates.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: Outstanding free choice: ER.

w.name: Wavebreaker's Fin
w.text: Boosts Burst damage based on the team’s combined Energy costs; competitive with high refinements and strong CRIT artifacts. Best with high-cost Bursts. R5 preferred.

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: Generates neutral particles on an on-field CRIT hit, reducing team Energy pressure; lower personal damage than offensive options. Build enough CRIT Rate and trigger passive on field. Higher refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Dragon's Bane
w.text: Provides EM and bonus damage against Hydro/Pyro-affected enemies, making it strong in Vaporize and Overvape teams. Use in reaction teams; solve ER separately. Refinements improve passive damage.

w.name: Kitain Cross Spear
w.text: Craftable EM polearm that restores Energy through its Skill passive; good in energy-hungry reaction teams. Use Skill after Burst to manage its initial Energy cost. R5 preferred.

a.text: Best general set: 20% ER and Burst DMG scaling with ER strengthen Pyronado while helping meet Energy requirements.
a.stats: ER / EM / ATK% · Pyro DMG · CRIT

a.text: Good in reaction-heavy teams, especially Overvape.
a.stats: ER / EM / ATK% · Pyro DMG · CRIT

a.text: Flexible interim 2-piece Burst DMG and 2-piece Pyro DMG while farming a complete Emblem set.
a.stats: ER / EM / ATK% · Pyro DMG · CRIT

t.name: National Kitchen
t.text: Xingqiu enables Pyronado Vaporize, Bennett fuels and buffs Xiangling, and Sucrose shares EM and shreds resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Raiden Hot Pot
t.text: Raiden helps recharge the team while Xingqiu enables Vaporize. Cast Pyronado inside Bennett’s Burst to snapshot his ATK buff.

t.name: International Heat
t.text: Tartaglia applies Hydro for frequent Pyronado Vaporizes; Kazuha buffs and groups while Bennett supplies ATK and Pyro particles.

t.name: Overload Express
t.text: Chevreuse supports a Pyro/Electro-only Overloaded team; Fischl adds off-field Electro and Bennett strengthens Xiangling’s Pyronado.

why.v:
Vaporize: 4pc Emblem, The Catch or Scarlet Sands; prioritize ER, CRIT and EM. Snapshot Bennett before Pyronado.
Overloaded: 4pc Emblem with Chevreuse and Pyro/Electro allies; build ER and CRIT rather than full EM.
No Bennett: Engulfing Lightning or Favonius; expect higher ER requirements and reduced snapshot ATK buffs.
Burgeon: 4pc Gilded Dreams or Flower of Paradise Lost; stack EM after meeting steep Burst ER needs.
Budget: R5 The Catch + 4pc Emblem; funnel Bennett particles and use an ER Sands if needed.

seo.about: Xiangling is an off-field Pyro DMG dealer whose Pyronado delivers powerful AoE DMG and reaction application. Cast it inside Bennett’s Burst to snapshot his ATK buff, then use a Hydro or Electro teammate to enable reactions.

vars.title: Accessible National
vars.stats: Meet team ER first; then CRIT, EM and ATK%.
vars.teams: Bennett plus a Hydro applier such as Xingqiu; Anemo flex works well.
vars.when: An accessible way to learn Vaporize Xiangling without premium weapons. Catch R5 is a standout option.
vars.cond: Funnel Bennett Skill particles to Xiangling.
vars.notes: Bennett buffs should be active when Pyronado is cast.

vars.title: Chevreuse Overloaded
vars.stats: Prioritize ER and CRIT; do not stack full EM solely for Overloaded.
vars.teams: Only Pyro and Electro teammates when relying on Chevreuse’s team passive.
vars.when: Use in Pyro/Electro damage teams where Chevreuse improves damage and RES shred.
vars.cond: Requires Chevreuse and compatible Pyro/Electro-only party.
vars.notes: Xiangling snapshots applicable ATK buffs when casting Burst.

vars.title: No-Bennett Pyronado
vars.stats: Raise ER significantly; ATK% can become more valuable without Bennett.
vars.teams: Needs strong battery or multiple Favonius procs; consider Raiden.
vars.when: For teams using Bennett on the other side, accepting much more demanding Burst uptime.
vars.cond: Energy requirements vary widely by team.
vars.notes: Do not imply Pyronado is consistently available without sufficient Energy.

vars.title: Burgeon Trigger
vars.stats: Level 90; prioritize ER until Burst is consistent, then as much EM as practical.
vars.teams: Consistent Hydro + Dendro for Bloom cores, plus healing or shielding.
vars.when: Triggers Burgeon via off-field Pyro; best suited to encounters where AoE cores are available.
vars.cond: Requires a stable Bloom-core supply and sufficient Burst Energy.
vars.notes: Burgeon scales with level and EM; avoid assuming standard CRIT benefits reaction damage.

vars.title: Early-Game Mixed Set
vars.stats: Use an ER Sands if needed; 2pc Noblesse + 2pc Crimson Witch is a transition.
vars.teams: Any team that can battery her Burst; Bennett helps considerably.
vars.when: A transitional setup while farming a proper 4pc Emblem set.
vars.cond: Alternative mixed pieces are temporary; listed 4pc Emblem is the final target.
vars.notes: Do not farm weak 4pc pieces at the expense of functioning ER and CRIT.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: High CD and DEF improve Physical DPS builds.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: Energy Recharge helps costly Bursts, and vacuum blades benefit from Physical DMG bonuses during on-field attacks. Use Burst before on-field attacks.

w.name: The Unforged
w.text: High ATK potential when shielded.

w.name: Song of Broken Pines
w.text: Physical DMG and an attack-speed team buff suit on-field Physical combos, though passive uptime varies. On-field Physical DPS.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Strong ATK stat stick and occasional party ATK buff; valuable if you can meet Energy needs elsewhere. ATK buffs can dilute its relative value.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CRIT Rate and stacking damage bonus are excellent with reliable protection, but its passive increases damage taken. Maintain stacks; protective teammates recommended. R5 is especially strong.

w.name: Prototype Archaic
w.text: Accessible ATK claymore with an extra hit on Normal/Charged Attacks; a straightforward Physical DPS fallback. General on-field DPS.

w.name: Snow-Tombed Starsilver
w.text: Physical DMG substat supports this build, but its icicle passive is inconsistent and often weaker than alternatives. Physical DPS; not automatically best against Cryo.

a.text: Reliable unconditional 50% Physical DMG; best all-purpose choice without shield/pulse requirements.
Can slightly outperform 2+2 when Skill hits sustain two stacks; unreliable when the shield lacks Pyro pulses.
For C2+ quickswap Burst damage rather than on-field Normal/Charged Attack damage.
a.stats: ER or ATK% / Physical DMG / CRIT DMG

t.name: Rockstar Superconduct
t.text: Fischl and Rosaria trigger Superconduct for Physical RES shred. Bennett buffs attacks and heals; Xinyan drives with Physical hits.

t.name: Thunderous Encore
t.text: Raiden and Rosaria enable Superconduct. Raiden restores energy and covers downtime; Bennett amplifies Xinyan’s damage.

t.name: Rebel Shield Crew
t.text: Shield-support Xinyan boosts Physical damage and at C4 shreds Physical RES. Eula carries; Raiden and Mika support her.

t.name: Pyro Mosh Pit
t.text: Requires Bennett C6 for Pyro-infused attacks. Xiangling adds off-field Pyro while Kazuha buffs Pyro and shreds resistance.

why.v:
C2 Burst Nuke: 4pc Emblem, Physical Goblet, CRIT DMG focus; C2 guarantees only the Physical Burst hit CRITs.
Shield Support: 4pc Tenacity, Sacrificial Greatsword; build DEF and enough ER. Shield is conditional and can break.
C6 Pyro DPS: With Bennett C6, use Pyro Goblet and 4pc Crimson Witch; focus on Charged Attacks.
Budget Physical: 2pc Pale Flame + 2pc Bloodstained, Prototype Archaic; ATK% / Physical / CRIT.
C6 Spin DPS: Physical Charged Attack playstyle; DEF% Sands is an optional defensive tradeoff, not universally best.

seo.about: Xinyan is a Physical Claymore DPS who uses her shield to boost Physical damage and her Burst for a powerful hit. Superconduct helps her attacks, while C2 guarantees the Physical Burst hit CRITs. She can also shield Physical carries or play Pyro DPS with C6 Bennett, but her shield is fragile without DEF investment.

vars.title: C2+ Physical Burst Nuke
vars.stats: Physical Goblet; emphasize CRIT DMG, ATK and enough ER; Burst Physical hit auto-CRITs at C2.
vars.teams: Physical buffers, Superconduct if possible, and adequate particles.
vars.when: Swap in for Skill then Burst; maximize the upfront Physical strike, rather than long on-field strings.
vars.cond: C2+ for guaranteed Physical Burst CRIT
vars.notes: Only the Physical Burst hit gets the guaranteed CRIT; other attacks still use normal CRIT Rate.

vars.title: DEF Shield Support
vars.stats: DEF% / DEF% / DEF%; add ER for regular Burst and CRIT Rate if Favonius.
vars.teams: Best with Physical carry; second defensive source recommended if shield is insufficient.
vars.when: Support a Physical carry with shielding, 15% Physical DMG buff, and C4 Physical RES reduction.
vars.cond: C4 improves Physical support value
vars.notes: Tenacity uptime requires shield Pyro pulses and can be inconsistent; Noblesse needs Burst every rotation.

vars.title: C6 Bennett Pyro Driver
vars.stats: Pyro Goblet; ATK% or DEF% Sands for C6 spins; standard CRIT ratio.
vars.teams: Requires Bennett C6 to Pyro-infuse Normal and Charged Attacks.
vars.when: Use when building Xinyan around Pyro-infused Charged Attacks instead of Physical damage.
vars.cond: Bennett C6 required; Xinyan C6 helps spins
vars.notes: Lavawalker is only suitable with stable Pyro aura; do not apply C2 auto-CRIT benefit to Pyro attacks.

vars.title: Accessible Physical DPS
vars.stats: ATK% Sands, Physical Goblet, CRIT Circlet; prioritize ER before damage substats.
vars.teams: Electro + Cryo for Superconduct, plus healer or buffer.
vars.when: Practical low-spend option for players without premium Claymores.
vars.cond: 4pc Pale Flame needs sustained Skill hits
vars.notes: Prototype Archaic is craftable; Luxurious Sea-Lord was a limited event reward, not currently obtainable.

vars.title: C6 Physical Spin Driver
vars.stats: ATK% Sands for damage; DEF% Sands optionally strengthens shield but usually lowers DPS.
vars.teams: Superconduct support, stamina management and protection.
vars.when: At C6, reduced Charged Attack stamina costs and DEF-to-ATK benefit enable an extended spinning playstyle.
vars.cond: Xinyan C6 required
vars.notes: DEF conversion applies to Charged Attacks only; do not assume it buffs her Normal Attacks or Physical Burst.

w.name: Favonius Greatsword
w.text: ER and neutral particles help Aino and the team Burst reliably.

w.name: Makhaira Aquamarine
w.text: EM secondary stat and an EM-based party ATK buff support reaction teams that already have enough Energy. For ATK-scaling teams with sufficient ER.

w.name: Flame-Forged Insight
w.text: Event weapon gives substantial EM and Energy support.

w.name: Master Key
w.text: Craftable EM and Energy option for players without the event weapon.

w.name: Forest Regalia
w.text: ER secondary stat and a collectible EM-granting Leaf after Bloom; pickup can be inconvenient. Bloom teams; teammate must collect Leaf. R5 improves EM buff.

w.name: Sacrificial Greatsword
w.text: A second Skill can generate more Hydro particles and help battery an ally, but is less flexible than Favonius. Works best with high refinement. High refinement preferred.

w.name: Katsuragikiri Nagamasa
w.text: Craftable ER weapon with a flat Energy refund that helps stabilize Burst uptime. Useful when already crafted/refined.

a.text: Best Lunar support set: grants ER, team EM and Lunar Reaction DMG bonuses.
Aino triggers an on-field reaction to grant teamwide EM.
Burst grants an ATK buff to the whole team; best when teammates value ATK more than EM.

t.name: Moonlit Circuit
t.text: Flins drives Lunar-Charged; Aino enables Ascendant Gleam and Hydro, Shinobu supplies Electro/healing, and Sucrose shreds RES and shares EM.

t.name: Ducky Power Grid
t.text: Aino and Ineffa enable Ascendant Gleam and Lunar-Charged. Ororon adds Electro damage, while Ifa drives reactions and boosts them.

t.name: Overvape Fireworks
t.text: Aino and Ineffa enable Ascendant Gleam, Hydro and Lunar-Charged; Bennett buffs Yoimiya. Vaporize consistency remains matchup-dependent.

t.name: Ducky Hyperbloom
t.text: Xingqiu supplies reliable Hydro, Baizhu applies Dendro and heals, Raiden triggers Hyperbloom; Aino adds off-field Hydro and team buffs.

why.v:
Lunar-Charged: 4pc Silken Moon, Favonius/Makhaira; pair with Flins or Ineffa to activate Ascendant Gleam.
Overvape: With Ineffa and a slow-Pyro DPS, use Silken Moon and reliable Burst uptime; Vape is not guaranteed.
Hyperbloom: Use Aino as secondary Hydro with Xingqiu/Yelan, Dendro and an EM Electro trigger; never solo Hydro.
ATK Buffer: Noblesse or Makhaira in ATK-scaling teams; use only if Energy and Lunar buff coverage are handled.

seo.about: Aino is an off-field Hydro support whose Burst enables reactions while her Moonsign passive raises the team's Moonsign level. Pair her with another Nod-Krai character for Ascendant Gleam, improving her Hydro application and Silken Moon buffs. Prioritize Burst uptime.

vars.title: Lunar-Charged EM Support
vars.stats: Reach ER first, then emphasize EM; add CRIT Rate with Favonius.
vars.teams: Flins or Ineffa; second Nod-Krai character for Ascendant Gleam.
vars.when: Best for Moonsign and Lunar-Charged teams needing Hydro, EM buffs, and a short team rotation.
vars.cond: Aino plus another Nod-Krai unit enables Ascendant Gleam.

vars.title: Overvape Support
vars.stats: Focus on ER and team buffs; personal damage is secondary.
vars.teams: Ineffa plus a slower-applying Pyro damage dealer such as Yoimiya.
vars.when: Provides Hydro, Lunar-Charged and EM buffs for mixed Vape/Overloaded teams.
vars.cond: Vaporize timing can be inconsistent; do not rely on Aino as solo Hydro for faster Pyro application.

vars.title: Hyperbloom Secondary Hydro
vars.stats: ER until Burst uptime is secure; EM is secondary if Aino rarely owns Bloom reactions.
vars.teams: Dendro + EM-built Electro trigger + a primary Hydro applicator.
vars.when: Adds some Hydro and buffs while teammates generate and trigger most Dendro Cores.
vars.cond: Aino alone does not provide enough Hydro for consistent core production.

vars.title: Noblesse ATK Buffer
vars.stats: ER/EM Sands, CRIT Rate if Favonius; skip personal-damage targets.
vars.teams: ATK-scaling carry; no better Noblesse wearer in the team.
vars.when: Use when ATK buffs offer more value than Lunar buffs or another teammate already holds Silken Moon.
vars.cond: Noblesse 4pc buff does not stack with another Noblesse user.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: HP% improves healing, while switching directly to your damage dealer grants a large ATK buff at R5. Best when the next character benefits from ATK. R5 strongly recommended.

w.name: Everlasting Moonglow
w.text: HP% and Healing Bonus increase healing.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Craftable HP% catalyst that restores party HP and refunds Barbara Energy after using Burst. Useful for frequent emergency healing; passive only triggers on Burst.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Creates neutral particles after an on-field CRIT, helping the team generate Energy. Needs enough CRIT Rate and an on-field hit to trigger.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: EM helps Bloom damage; Skill damage can reset her long cooldown, improving uptime. On-field Bloom driver; Skill must hit enemies for reset.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Large EM stat supports Barbara-triggered Bloom and provides a small team EM benefit. Bloom-focused driver only; poor value for pure healing.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: Craftable ER option that can buff reaction elements when on-field Barbara triggers Electro-Charged. Only in teams consistently triggering Electro reactions.

a.text: Converts Barbara’s healing into extra Physical bubble damage, adding value beyond pure healing.
Converts healing into a limited damage bonus for an active attacker; useful when the team can exploit it.
Raises healing output, but often overheals without contributing extra team damage.

t.name: Idol Bloom Brigade
t.text: Barbara drives Bountiful Blooms with on-field Hydro while healing their self-damage. Nilou enables enhanced cores; the Dendro duo supplies aura.

t.name: Hyperbloom Harmony
t.text: Barbara drives with Hydro attacks, Nahida sustains Dendro, and Kuki triggers Hyperblooms. Xingqiu adds reliable off-field Hydro.

t.name: Hydro Healthcare
t.text: On-field Barbara heals the team to build Furina Fanfare while driving Yelan’s Burst; Kazuha buffs and shreds Hydro resistance.

t.name: Electro Idol Tour
t.text: Barbara drives Electro-Charged and team healing, Fischl and Beidou add off-field Electro, and Sucrose groups foes and shreds resistance.

why.v:
Bloom Driver: Sacrificial Fragments, Flower of Paradise Lost or Gilded Dreams; EM/EM/EM with HP or Healing Bonus as needed for survival.
Hyperbloom Driver: Barbara applies Hydro on-field; Kuki triggers the Hyperblooms. Keep Barbara on HP/Healing Bonus or Clam, not full EM.
Electro-Charged: Ocean-Hued Clam with HP/HP/Healing Bonus; drive Fischl and Beidou while healing and applying Hydro.
Vaporize DPS: Wanderer’s Troupe, EM or ATK%/Hydro DMG/CRIT with a damage catalyst; niche Charged Attack Vaporize build.
Budget Healer: R5 Thrilling Tales and HP/HP/Healing Bonus; prioritize Skill healing and switch directly to an ATK-scaling carry.

seo.about: Barbara is an accessible Hydro healer who keeps teams healthy through her Skill and emergency teamwide Burst. She can buff an ally with Thrilling Tales or drive Bloom and reaction teams with on-field Hydro attacks. Her Skill's self-Wet application and limited off-field Hydro reach require care.
stats: Energy Recharge: Team-dependent; Burst is optional

vars.title: Nilou Bloom Driver
vars.stats: Build EM/EM/EM for Bloom damage; replace one or more pieces with HP% or Healing Bonus if healing is insufficient.
vars.teams: Nilou plus two Dendro or Hydro allies; only Hydro and Dendro party members for Nilou passive.
vars.when: Use Barbara on-field to apply Hydro, trigger Bountiful Blooms, and heal through self-damage.
vars.cond: Barbara must trigger Blooms to benefit from her EM.
vars.notes: Sacrificial Fragments reset requires Skill damage to hit an enemy.

vars.title: Hyperbloom Hydro Driver
vars.stats: HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus; Barbara usually does not need EM because the Electro unit triggers Hyperbloom.
vars.teams: Dendro source, reliable Electro trigger built with EM, and enough Hydro application.
vars.when: Drive with Barbara’s attacks while an Electro teammate triggers Hyperblooms and Barbara maintains healing.
vars.cond: EM belongs primarily on the Electro Hyperbloom trigger.
vars.notes: On-field Barbara helps supplement her limited off-field Hydro application.

vars.title: Electro-Charged Clam Driver
vars.stats: HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus; prioritize enough healing to support Ocean-Hued Clam bubble damage.
vars.teams: Off-field Electro damage sources such as Fischl and Beidou.
vars.when: Keep Barbara on-field using Normal and Charged Attacks for continuous healing, Hydro application, and Clam damage.
vars.cond: Hakushin Ring requires Barbara to trigger an Electro-related reaction.
vars.notes: Clam bubble damage is Physical and does not scale with Hydro DMG Bonus.

vars.title: Charged Attack Vaporize DPS
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
vars.stats: EM or ATK% Sands / Hydro DMG Goblet / CRIT Circlet; prioritize CRIT, EM, ATK and sufficient stamina.
vars.teams: Strong off-field Pyro application and buffs to Vaporize Barbara’s Charged Attacks.
vars.when: A niche high-investment playstyle for players who enjoy carefully timed Hydro Charged Attack Vaporizes.
vars.cond: Requires reliable Pyro aura and Charged Attack stamina management.
vars.notes: Normal Attack talent becomes highest priority for this variation.

vars.title: Accessible Team Healer
vars.stats: HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus; ER is optional if Burst remains an emergency heal.
vars.teams: Works best with an ATK-scaling carry who can immediately follow Barbara for Thrilling Tales buff.
vars.when: Low-investment setup focused on steady Skill healing, emergency Burst healing, and an easy ATK buff.
vars.cond: R5 Thrilling Tales is ideal; its buff applies only to the next character switched in.
vars.notes: Barbara’s Skill does not generate particles and can apply Wet to the active character.

w.name: Engulfing Lightning
w.text: Generates teamwide particles on CRIT and helps meet her demanding Burst Energy needs. Needs CRIT Rate and an on-field CRIT hit.

w.name: Favonius Lance
w.text: Very high ER helps sustain her Burst.

w.name: Rightful Reward
w.text: HP% supports Candace’s buff.

w.name: Kitain Cross Spear
w.text: Energy restoration and EM help her Bloom setup, especially with refinements. Best for Bloom-focused builds or when the Skill passive fits rotations. R5 improves Energy refund.

w.name: Dragon's Bane
w.text: Large EM stat boosts Bloom damage when Candace herself triggers Dendro Cores. Bloom variation only; not a general HP/ER support weapon.

w.name: Prototype Starglitter
w.text: Craftable Energy Recharge stat stick that supports consistent Bursts. Normal/Charged Attack passive rarely matters off-field.

w.name: Black Tassel
w.text: Large HP% stat increases Candace’s HP-based Normal Attack buff. Only after meeting Energy Recharge needs from artifacts and team.

a.text: Burst activation grants the party ATK.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Provides reaction-based Elemental DMG buffs.
Increases ER and Burst DMG.

t.name: Bloom Oasis
t.text: Candace infuses Yaoyao or Dendro Traveler with Hydro to create Bountiful Cores. Give Bloom trigger characters EM; C6 adds Hydro waves.

t.name: Hyperbloom Guard
t.text: Candace grants Kuki Hydro-infused attacks to make Cores, while Kuki triggers Hyperbloom. Nahida supplies Dendro; Fischl adds damage.

t.name: Crimson Tide
t.text: C6 Candace supplies AoE Hydro waves for Arlecchino Vaporize; Bennett buffs and Kazuha groups and reduces resistance. Requires C6.

t.name: Frozen Crown
t.text: Candace buffs Skirk’s Elemental Normal Attacks and adds Hydro Resonance. Furina boosts damage; Escoffier shreds resistance and heals.

why.v:
Nilou Bloom: Build EM/ER with Flower of Paradise Lost or Gilded Dreams if Candace owns Blooms; Hydro-infused teammates own their own Blooms.
C6 Vaporize: C6 enables extra off-field Hydro waves for Arlecchino; use high ER and Favonius Lance or an energy option.
Hyperbloom: Keep support ER/HP build with Instructor; Electro trigger (such as Kuki) needs EM, not Candace.
C6 Damage: Use ER/HP or Hydro DMG/CRIT with Emblem if investing in her C6 Burst waves; low priority versus team buffs.
F2P Support: Prototype Starglitter for ER, or Black Tassel if ER needs are already met; Noblesse remains reliable.

seo.about: Candace is a Hydro support who buffs Elemental Normal Attacks and grants Hydro Infusion to Sword, Claymore, and Polearm allies. Her Burst enables creative Bloom and Normal Attack teams, while C6 adds off-field Hydro waves. Prioritize enough Energy Recharge to use her Burst reliably.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.title: Nilou Bloom Trigger
vars.stats: ER/EM Sands, EM Goblet, EM Circlet; level 90 is important for Blooms.
vars.teams: Nilou plus Dendro, with Candace actually triggering Dendro Cores.
vars.when: Use when Candace owns meaningful Bloom reactions, including her swap waves and C6. Other Hydro-infused teammates use their own EM.
vars.cond: Only Candace-owned Blooms scale with her EM.

vars.title: C6 Arlecchino Vaporize

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: Prioritize Burst uptime, then HP%; Favonius needs some CRIT Rate.
vars.teams: Arlecchino, a buffer, and an Anemo or Hydro-compatible support.
vars.when: C6 Hydro waves add application for Arlecchino to Vaporize in clustered fights.
vars.cond: Requires Candace C6.
vars.notes: Avoid presenting this as a reliable solo-Hydro Vaporize setup before C6.

vars.title: Hyperbloom Infusion
vars.stats: ER first, then HP%; do not stack EM for Candace.
vars.teams: An on-field melee Hydro-infused attacker, Dendro applier and EM Electro trigger.
vars.when: Candace creates Hydro access; an Electro character triggers the Hyperblooms and needs EM.
vars.cond: Instructor requires Candace to trigger an on-field reaction.

vars.title: C6 Burst Damage
vars.stats: Meet ER, then HP%, Hydro DMG and CRIT; her waves scale with HP.
vars.teams: Another on-field character whose Elemental Normal Attacks activate C6.
vars.when: Only for investment-focused players seeking more personal C6 Hydro damage.
vars.cond: Candace C6; her own attacks cannot trigger C6.

vars.title: Accessible ER Support

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: ER Sands as needed; HP% Goblet/Circlet once Burst is consistent.
vars.teams: Best with a second Hydro, enough team particles, or a healer for Rightful Reward.
vars.when: Use obtainable weapons and mixed ER pieces while farming better support equipment.
vars.cond: 2pc Scroll ER effect needs a Natlan teammate.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: ER and neutral particles help fund Dahlia’s costly Burst and recharge teammates. Build CRIT Rate to trigger its passive. Requires on-field CRIT hits to generate particles.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: Massive HP boosts his shield and helps reach the 40,000 HP cap for his A4 ATK SPD buff. Only after meeting his Burst ER requirement.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Can buff team ATK and Normal, Charged.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: 55.1% ER helps maintain Burst uptime.

w.name: Peak Patrol Song
w.text: Provides team Elemental DMG buffs when its conditions are met; competes with Dahlia’s preferred HP and ER stats. Only when team buffs outweigh lower HP and tougher ER needs.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Energy Recharge and a chance for another Skill improve particles and reduce Burst pressure. Passive needs to trigger; extra Skill costs field time.

w.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
w.text: HP% strengthens the shield and increases his HP-scaling Attack Speed buff. Meet ER needs first; weapon passive is secondary.

w.name: Skyrider Sword
w.text: Accessible Energy Recharge stat stick until better swords are available. Temporary F2P option; passive offers little support value.

a.text: Reliable team ATK buff when Dahlia uses Burst every rotation. Avoid duplicating with another Noblesse holder.

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Provides a modest reaction-based Elemental DMG buff without Nightsoul; useful for non-ATK scalers or if Noblesse is taken.
Two HP% bonuses help reach 40,000 HP when Burst uptime is already covered; lacks a team-wide set buff.

t.name: Frostbound Encore
t.text: Dahlia shields and speeds up Skirk’s Normal Attacks; Furina buffs DMG and Escoffier heals.

t.name: Windborne Chorus
t.text: Faruzan buffs Wanderer, Bennett supplies ATK and healing.

t.name: Suprise Baptism
t.text: Ayato uses Dahlia’s shield and Attack Speed.

t.name: Summer Serenade
t.text: Yoimiya appreciates Dahlia’s shield and Normal Attack Speed.

why.v:
HP Shield Focus: With ER already met, prioritize 40,000 HP for maximum A4 Attack Speed and stronger shielding.
Elemental Buff: Use 4pc Scroll for non-ATK carries or when Noblesse is taken; without Nightsoul.
C1 Energy Saver: C1 refunds Energy through Benison stacks, lowering ER needs.
Favonius Battery: Favonius Sword with sufficient CR helps generate team particles. Use Normal Attacks if Skill/Burst do not proc it.

seo.about: Dahlia shields the active character with his Burst and boosts their Normal Attack Speed based on his HP, up to 20% at 40,000 HP (30% at C6). His shield can refresh with Benison stacks, but he needs substantial Energy Recharge to Burst reliably. Best with Normal Attack-focused carries.
pros: Up to 30% ATK SPD at C6

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

stats: HP: up to 40,000 for full A4 buff

vars.title: HP Shield Focus
vars.stats: Prioritize HP% to approach 40,000 HP after meeting rotation ER. HP% circlet; ER Sands if necessary.
vars.teams: Best when party weapons/particles already cover Dahlia’s high ER needs.
vars.when: When more shield strength and maximum A4 Attack Speed matter more than the 4pc Noblesse team ATK buff.
vars.cond: Burst must remain available every rotation.
vars.notes: Dahlia’s A4 caps at 20% Attack Speed from 40,000 HP.

vars.title: Elemental Damage Support

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: Same ER and HP priorities; use CRIT Rate circlet for Favonius as needed.
vars.teams: Teams benefiting from Elemental DMG rather than ATK, or where another teammate carries Noblesse.
vars.when: A useful alternative for non-ATK-scaling carries or when 4pc Noblesse would duplicate another teammate.
vars.cond: Dahlia must trigger an appropriate elemental reaction.
vars.notes: Without Nightsoul, Dahlia receives only Scroll’s smaller reaction-based bonus, not the full enhanced buff.

vars.title: C1 Double-Hydro Battery
vars.stats: ER can drop to roughly 140–165% with C1, double Hydro and one Skill, depending on actual Benison stacks.
vars.teams: Two Hydro characters; sufficient Benison generation; reliable rotations.
vars.when: At C1+, use energy refunds to invest additional substats into HP and improve the ATK SPD buff.
vars.cond: C1 and consistent Benison stacks.
vars.notes: Two Skills or Favonius procs can lower ER further; verify the team’s actual particle generation.

w.name: Haran Geppaku Futsu
w.text: Signature CRIT Rate sword. Its Elemental DMG and Normal Attack bonuses strongly enhance Skill-empowered Shunsuiken. Use teammate Skills before Ayato Skill.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Excellent CR and HP-to-ATK conversion.

w.name: Mistsplitter Reforged
w.text: High CD and Elemental DMG bonuses.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: High CD and Normal Attack bonuses.

w.name: The Black Sword
w.text: Reliable CRIT Rate and Normal Attack DMG, plus a small heal during Shunsuiken attacks. One of his best 4-star swords.

w.name: Calamity of Eshu
w.text: Boosts Normal Attack DMG and CRIT Rate while shielded; can outperform Black Sword in shield teams. Only while protected by a shield.

w.name: Kagotsurube Isshin
w.text: Free Story Quest sword with ATK and a useful hit-triggered ATK buff. An accessible option for on-field Ayato.

w.name: Lion's Roar
w.text: Increases damage against Electro-affected foes, making it viable in Electro-Charged teams only. Electro aura must remain on targets. Higher refinement improves this niche.

a.text: A top general-purpose set: Hydro DMG plus a Normal Attack damage buff after Skill use.
Another top set; its ATK% and Normal Attack bonus perform close to Heart of Depth. Choose better substats.
Competitive Normal Attack proc set.

t.name: Boba Hyperbloom
t.text: Ayato creates Dendro Cores with Nahida; full-EM Kuki triggers Hyperbloom and heals. Fischl adds damage and Electro energy.

t.name: Blooming Boba
t.text: Nilou enables Bountiful Cores, Nahida provides Dendro, Baizhu heals, and Ayato applies AoE Hydro. Manage Bloom self-damage.

t.name: Burgeon Boba
t.text: Ayato makes cores with Nahida; EM Thoma detonates them. Fischl adds damage and reduces Burning. Shielding may need extra sustain.

t.name: Sparkle Princess
t.text: Ayato drives Fischl and Beidou while applying Hydro; Sucrose groups foes and shreds resistances. Beidou appreciates Electro energy.

why.v:
Furina Carry: With Furina and reliable healing, use Marechaussee Hunter; avoid overcapping CRIT Rate.
Burst Support: Use Emblem and an ER sword for off-field Hydro coverage; one Skill per Burst and higher ER.
Hyperbloom Driver: Keep a standard CRIT build; Electro trigger builds full EM and activates the Dendro Cores.
Shielded DPS: Calamity of Eshu is excellent with a reliable shield from Thoma, Kirara, Citlali, or Dahlia.
Electro-Charged: In Double Electro teams, 4pc Thundering Fury can shorten Skill cooldown for quicker rotations.

seo.about: Ayato is an on-field Hydro DPS whose Elemental Skill unleashes rapid AoE Shunsuiken slashes. His Burst adds off-field Hydro application and Normal Attack damage buffs. He fits Hyperbloom, Burgeon, Electro-Charged and carry teams, with flexible rotations and gear.

vars.title: Furina Hypercarry
vars.stats: CRIT Rate can be lower with 4pc Marechaussee; keep ATK%/Hydro/CRIT and enough ER.
vars.teams: Furina plus a reliable team healer such as Xilonen or Jean.
vars.when: Use this when Furina enables frequent HP changes to activate Marechaussee Hunter.
vars.cond: Requires consistent Furina HP fluctuation.
vars.notes: Be mindful that Ayato Burst can snapshot before Marechaussee CRIT stacks build.

vars.title: Off-Field Burst Support
vars.stats: Use ER Sands as needed; solo-Hydro, one-Skill rotations may need 155–175% ER or more.
vars.teams: An on-field carry that values extra Hydro application; account for cooldown and Energy.
vars.when: Use Ayato for his Burst droplets and Normal Attack buff when a different unit needs field time.
vars.cond: One Skill per Burst; more demanding Energy requirements.
vars.notes: Favonius sacrifices personal damage for team particles. Noblesse only if no teammate already carries it.

vars.title: Shielded Normal Attack DPS
vars.stats: Standard ATK%/Hydro/CRIT; balance CRIT with Eshu shielded bonuses.
vars.teams: Reliable shield such as Thoma, Kirara, Citlali, or Dahlia.
vars.when: Use an accessible event sword that shines while the shield stays active.
vars.cond: Shield uptime required for its damage and CRIT passive.

vars.title: Electro-Charged Cooldown
vars.stats: Normal offensive stats; meet ER. Lion’s Roar needs a consistent Electro aura.
vars.teams: Two Electro units, ideally Fischl and Beidou, with reliable reactions.
vars.when: Try 4pc Thundering Fury to reduce Skill cooldown and enable back-to-back Shunsuiken windows.
vars.cond: Requires regular Electro-Charged procs.
vars.notes: The cooldown-compression gain is situational rather than a universal best build.

vars.title: Accessible Hydro Carry
vars.stats: ATK% Sands, Hydro Goblet, CRIT Circlet; prioritize strong substats and enough ER.
vars.teams: Any suitable on-field team; Eshu needs a shield.
vars.when: Choose readily available equipment while saving premium weapons for other characters.
vars.cond: Story sword is free; Black Sword requires paid Battle Pass.
vars.notes: Kagotsurube Isshin is obtained from Kazuha’s Story Quest; Calamity of Eshu is a past event weapon.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: CRIT DMG and huge short-window buffs suit her Burst nuke; its random buff and 30s cooldown make damage inconsistent. Burst-nuke DPS; less reliable for repeated rotations.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: High base ATK and ATK% provide consistent personal damage without depending on a random buff. Personal-damage builds.

w.name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
w.text: CRIT Rate is useful, but its stacking Elemental DMG passive needs extended field time. Primarily an on-field Mona build.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Energy Recharge and CRIT-triggered particles help fund her costly Burst and support the entire team. Land on-field CRIT hits; build adequate CRIT Rate.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: R5 grants a major ATK buff to the character switched in next. Lacks ER, so Burst uptime can be difficult. ATK-scaling carry; 20s buff cooldown. R5 strongly preferred.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Refunds Energy after Burst and adds team healing, substantially lowering her demanding ER needs. Support or healer-lite setups. Higher refinements improve energy and healing.

w.name: Solar Pearl
w.text: CRIT Rate and a Normal Attack-activated Burst DMG buff help damage-focused builds. Use a Normal Attack before Burst to activate its passive.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable EM weapon with reaction-triggered Elemental DMG stacks; useful for budget Vaporize nukes. Mona must trigger reactions; less useful for pure Omen support.

a.text: Strong Burst-nuke set: converts required Energy Recharge into Burst DMG.
2pc Burst DMG plus 2pc Hydro DMG for a balanced nuke set; no 4pc effects are active.
Support option: using Burst grants the whole party 20% ATK for 12s; avoid duplicate Noblesse holders.

t.name: Frostbound Prophecy
t.text: Mona's Omen amplifies Skirk's damage; Furina adds Hydro and buffs while Escoffier heals and shreds Cryo/Hydro RES. ER needs can be high.

t.name: Morgana Starfall
t.text: Classic Freeze AoE team. Cryo and Mona's Hydro help sustain Freeze and prolong Omen; Venti groups foes and Diona sustains.

t.name: Hexerei Flamecraft
t.text: Mona drives Hydro for Durin's off-field Pyro Vaporize; Xingqiu stabilizes Hydro. With Witch's Homework, Mona and Sucrose enable Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Moonlit Divination
t.text: A Lunar-reaction setup: Mona's Omen and support gear help Columbina, while Ineffa enables Lunar-Charged and Lauma adds reaction support.

why.v:
Omen Support: 4pc Noblesse, Favonius Codex or R5 TTDS; prioritize ER to Burst each rotation. Omen buffs the next damage window.
Hexerei Buffer: 4pc Celestial Gift with another Hexerei ally and Witch's Homework completed; use Normal Attacks to extend Omen.
Freeze Support: 4pc Noblesse + Favonius/TTDS; pair with Cryo and Hydro to exploit extended Omen on frozen, unshattered enemies.
C6 Charged DPS: 4pc A Day Carved From Rising Winds; ATK/Hydro/CRIT, strong Pyro support, and Omen-boosted Charged Attacks.
Budget Support: Favonius or craftable Prototype Amber with 4pc Noblesse; solve Energy Recharge before chasing personal damage.

seo.about: Mona is a Hydro Burst nuker and Omen buffer whose Burst amplifies damage enemies take. Her Skill briefly taunts and applies Hydro, but cannot sustain most Vaporize carries alone. With another Hexerei teammate and Witch's Homework completed, her attacks can extend Omen and enhance Vaporize.
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

vars.title: Omen Support
vars.stats: ER until Burst every rotation; use CRIT Rate with Favonius. Personal damage is secondary.
vars.teams: Bring a carry who deals damage during Omen; TTDS works best with an ATK-scaling carry.
vars.when: Prioritize teamwide damage rather than Mona's Bubble pop. Swap to the carry after setting up Omen.
vars.cond: TTDS needs sufficient ER and proper swap order; do not duplicate Noblesse.
vars.notes: ER can exceed 250% in solo-Hydro teams. Prototype Amber reduces requirements.

vars.title: Hexerei Omen Buffer
vars.stats: ER first, then Favonius CRIT Rate; Hydro DMG and CRIT are optional personal-damage stats.
vars.teams: Needs another Hexerei teammate and completion of Witch's Homework to activate Mona's extra passive.
vars.when: Use Normal/Charged hits during the setup to extend Omen and, in Vaporize teams, build Astral Glow stacks.
vars.cond: Requires Witch's Homework and at least one other Hexerei character.
vars.notes: Celestial Gift is usually her preferred Hexerei support set unless another teammate already carries it.

vars.title: Freeze Omen Support
vars.stats: Prioritize enough ER for every Burst; TTDS can increase ER demands.
vars.teams: Use strong Cryo application; pair a Freeze carry such as Ganyu or Skirk with sustain/energy support.
vars.when: Apply Cryo before Mona's Burst when attempting Freeze-based Bubble extension. Shatter breaks the setup.
vars.cond: Best against freezable enemies; bosses and Shatter limit extended Omen.
vars.notes: Mona's Skill alone cannot replace a sustained Hydro applicator in every team.

vars.title: C6 Charged Attack DPS
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.stats: ATK% or EM Sands / Hydro DMG / CRIT. Level Normal Attacks for Charged Attack damage.
vars.teams: Needs C6; strong off-field Pyro for Vaporize and teammates supporting her on-field time.
vars.when: Use Omen windows to unleash amplified Charged Attacks; this is an investment-heavy alternative to support Mona.
vars.cond: C6 strongly recommended; Witch's Homework/Hexerei rules are separate.
vars.notes: Her new on-field recommendations continue to receive theorycrafting updates.

vars.title: Lunar-Charged Flex
vars.stats: ER to Burst reliably; invest EM only if Mona actually triggers relevant reactions.
vars.teams: Use an Electro Lunar-Charged enabler such as Ineffa plus a reaction-focused Hydro carry.
vars.when: Mona provides Omen and Hydro support in Lunar-Charged teams, but is not necessarily the best artifact holder.
vars.cond: Hakushin Ring needs Mona to trigger a reaction on-field; prioritize team-set coverage.
vars.notes: Silken Moon may be inferior if another ally can use its full bonus.

vars.title: Budget Burst Support
vars.stats: ER Sands often required; do not force damage stats at the expense of Burst uptime.
vars.teams: Pairs well with accessible teams that can funnel particles or use Favonius weapons.
vars.when: Choose craftable Prototype Amber when ER is difficult; TTDS is a free buff option once energy is solved.
vars.cond: Crafting and free catalyst access vary by account.
vars.notes: A dedicated healer may still be needed; Amber's healing is modest.

w.name: Silvershower Heartstrings
w.text: Huge HP% boosts healing and her off-field Skill buff; the passive aids her Burst DMG.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: HP% passive and CD boost her personal DMG, especially when her Burst is used.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: ER plus team ATK and EM buffs once its sigils are stacked.

w.name: Sequence of Solitude
w.text: 41.3% HP at level 90 boosts healing and her Skill buff.

w.name: Recurve Bow
w.text: 46.9% HP at level 90 is excellent for healing and her Skill buff; its defeat-heal passive is minor.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and team particles from on-field CRIT hits. When allies need energy; build enough CRIT Rate to trigger it.

w.name: Sacrificial Bow
w.text: Can reset her Skill for extra healing, Hydro application, and another set of buff stacks. Costs additional field time; reset requires a Skill hit. Higher refinements improve consistency.

a.text: Converts her frequent healing into extra Physical bubble DMG, even when teammates are healthy.
Converts healing into a flat DMG bonus for teammates.
Her Skill hits can provide an ATK buff for several seconds.

t.name: Bubble Taser
t.text: Sigewinne heals for Furina Fanfare and buffs off-field Skill hits from Furina and Fischl; Kazuha groups and shreds resistance.

t.name: House Call
t.text: Ayato drives Hydro damage while Furina buffs and attacks off-field. Sigewinne sustains Fanfare and buffs Furina’s Skill hits.

t.name: Bloom Ward
t.text: Nilou enables Bountiful Cores; Nahida supplies Dendro while Xingqiu drives Hydro application. Sigewinne keeps the team healthy.

t.name: Fireworks Clinic
t.text: Furina and Sigewinne provide Hydro for some Vaporizes; Sigewinne heals Furina’s HP drain while Zhongli protects Yoimiya.

why.v:
Furina Partner: Ocean-Hued Clam or Song of Days Past; focus HP to strengthen healing and Furina Fanfare.
Burst Quickswap: Use Emblem, ER/HP% sands and damage stats only when her Burst fits the rotation.
ATK Buffer: Tenacity can buff ATK when Skill hits connect; useful if no teammate already carries it.
Budget Healer: Recurve Bow and HP% main stats supply strong healing without premium weapons.

seo.about: Sigewinne is an HP-scaling Hydro healer whose Skill restores the team and boosts limited instances of off-field Elemental Skill damage. She pairs especially well with Furina. Her Hydro application is modest, and most healer builds skip her costly Burst to save field time.
cons: High HP goal for full buff

vars.title: Furina Fanfare Partner
vars.stats: HP% / HP% / HP%; ignore Burst ER if not casting Burst.
vars.teams: Furina plus off-field Skill damage dealers.
vars.when: Use Sigewinne’s Skill to restore team HP after Furina drains it and support Fanfare generation.
vars.cond: Furina healing synergy; off-field Skill damage buff has limited stacks.

vars.title: Quickswap Burst Damage
vars.stats: Prioritize enough ER for Burst, then HP%, Hydro DMG and CRIT.
vars.teams: A quickswap team with time for her Burst; preferably double Hydro.
vars.when: Add her Burst during downtime for personal Hydro damage, rather than spending all her field time on healing.
vars.cond: High energy needs; generally weaker than healer-focused builds at C0.

vars.title: Tenacity ATK Buffer
vars.stats: HP% / HP% / HP%; Energy Recharge only if Burst is used.
vars.teams: An ATK-scaling carry; no competing Tenacity holder.
vars.when: Use Skill hits to trigger Tenacity’s team ATK buff; less useful for HP-scaling or reaction-damage carries.
vars.cond: Buff is not permanent and depends on Skill hits.

vars.title: Accessible HP Healer
vars.stats: Stack HP%; with Favonius, add CRIT Rate and consider ER.
vars.teams: Any team needing reliable healing; especially useful alongside Furina.
vars.when: A low-cost build that gets strong team healing and off-field Skill buffs without her signature weapon.
vars.cond: Sequence of Solitude requires ownership from a past event.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Provides team ATK and Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack buffs after Traveler triggers two reactions. Requires reliable reaction triggers; not a personal-DPS pick.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: HP increases its Elemental Mastery team-share potential after three Skill hits; the Hold Skill can build stacks. For reaction support; hold Skill enough to stack before swapping.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: CRIT hits generate neutral particles.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: ER plus a chance to reset Skill adds another Hydro hit and improves support-set reaction uptime. Additional Skill costs field time. High refinements preferred.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Fishing sword grants Skill CRIT Rate and temporary Energy Recharge after using Skill; reliable free Burst support.

w.name: Festering Desire
w.text: Energy Recharge, Elemental Skill DMG Bonus and Skill CRIT Rate make it useful for a Skill-oriented build. Only if you own the limited event weapon. Event-limited.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: Craftable ATK% sword refunds Energy after Burst based on Skill-use seeds, reducing the need for ER. Best with multiple Skill uses across a rotation.

w.name: Skyrider Sword
w.text: Accessible Energy Recharge stat stick for early-game support; its Burst-triggered movement and ATK buff matter little. Budget option until a stronger ER sword is available.

a.text: Trigger a reaction while on field to grant the team 120 EM for 8 seconds. Best when a reaction carry benefits from EM.
a.stats: ER · Any / Hydro DMG · CRIT Rate (Favonius)

a.text: After Burst, grants 20% team ATK for 12 seconds.
a.stats: ER · Hydro DMG / Any · CRIT Rate

a.text: Situational Dendro RES shred in Bloom or Hyperbloom if no better teammate can hold the set; uptime is limited.
a.stats: ER · Hydro DMG / Any · CRIT Rate

t.name: Fontaine Vaporize
t.text: Furina supplements Traveler’s weak Hydro application for Xiangling Vaporize. Bennett heals and batteries Xiangling; Traveler adds Fanfare via HP changes.

t.name: Bountiful Dewdrops
t.text: Traveler aims Hydro at Dendro-marked enemies to make Nilou Bountiful Cores; Nahida supplies Dendro and Baizhu heals Bloom self-damage.

t.name: Rainstorm Hyperbloom
t.text: Kokomi covers Traveler’s Hydro downtime; Nahida creates Cores and full-EM Raiden triggers Hyperbloom. Traveler offers extra Hydro hits.

t.name: They're doing their best guys
t.text: Xiangling maintains Pyro for Traveler’s final Skill hit to Vaporize; Bennett buffs ATK and Kazuha groups foes. Timing is essential.

why.v:
Hold Skill DPS: Marechaussee Hunter with a CRIT sword; ATK% / Hydro / CRIT. Hold Skill drains HP and benefits from shields.
Vaporize Skill: EM or ATK% sands with a CRIT sword; Vaporize the finishing Torrent Surge with Pyro setup.
Nilou Bloom: Build level 90 and EM for owned Bloom triggers; pair Nilou, Dendro application and a reliable healer.
Hyperbloom Support: Favonius Sword with Instructor or Deepwood; pair a Dendro applicator and full-EM Electro trigger.
Budget Support: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman or Skyrider Sword; prioritize ER and team-focused artifact passives.

seo.about: Hydro Traveler offers ranged Hydro hits through a stationary Hold Skill and a traveling Burst, but has limited application and little innate team utility. Use Favonius Sword or support artifacts in reaction teams, or build Skill DMG for a niche on-field playstyle.
stats: ER: Team-dependent; often very high for each Burst
Support: Prioritize enough ER for planned Burst frequency
Skill DPS: Prioritize CRIT and ATK over Burst uptime

vars.title: On-field Hold Skill DPS
vars.stats: ATK% sands, Hydro goblet, CRIT circlet; prioritize CRIT > ATK%. Ignore Burst ER if focusing on Skill.
vars.teams: Shielder or interruption resistance; Furina and Bennett can amplify damage.
vars.when: Use Hold Skill for repeated Dewdrops and a stronger ending Torrent Surge. HP drain activates Marechaussee CRIT Rate.
vars.cond: Stationary Skill; interruption severely hurts damage.
vars.notes: The Skill cannot trigger Xingqiu, Yelan or Beidou Burst follow-ups.

vars.title: Vaporize Skill DPS
vars.stats: ATK% or EM sands, Hydro goblet, CRIT circlet; damage and reaction stats before ER.
vars.teams: Reliable Pyro aura from Xiangling; Bennett; optional Anemo buffer.
vars.when: Set up Pyro before firing Traveler’s ending Torrent Surge to Vaporize its hit.
vars.cond: Careful Pyro aura and hit timing required.
vars.notes: This is a niche, lower-ceiling build; HP stacking is not optimal for Skill damage.

vars.title: Nilou Bloom Driver
vars.stats: Level 90; invest in EM for Blooms Traveler owns. Maintain enough ER only if using Burst each rotation.
vars.teams: Nilou and Dendro units only; bring strong healing such as Baizhu.
vars.when: Aim Hold Skill at Dendro-afflicted targets to trigger additional Bountiful Blooms.
vars.cond: Only Hydro and Dendro party members with Nilou.
vars.notes: Bloom ownership varies with application and rotation; do not assume all cores belong to Traveler.

vars.title: Hyperbloom Utility
vars.stats: Build ER to desired Burst frequency, then Favonius CRIT Rate; Traveler does not need full EM.
vars.teams: Full-EM Kuki Shinobu or Raiden, Dendro application, and another Hydro source if needed.
vars.when: Supplement Hydro application while the Electro unit triggers Hyperblooms.
vars.cond: Often needs an extra Hydro unit for consistent cores.
vars.notes: Put Deepwood on a reliable Dendro unit when possible.

vars.title: Free-to-Play Support
vars.stats: ER sands; CRIT Rate if using Favonius later. Damage stats are secondary to reliable support effects.
vars.teams: Reaction team for Instructor, or ATK-scaling carry for Noblesse.
vars.when: A low-cost way to use Hydro Traveler as a reaction enabler and artifact buffer.
vars.cond: Noblesse is weaker if Burst cannot be cast regularly.
vars.notes: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman boosts Skill CRIT Rate and grants ER after Skill, not HP.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Huge CRIT Rate and an HP-based ATK bonus greatly boost sword-rain damage once Burst uptime is secured. Best in low-ER teams or with C6, Raiden, or strong batteries.

w.name: Mistsplitter Reforged
w.text: High CD and Element DMG raise his Hydro DMG.

w.name: Haran Geppaku Futsu
w.text: CRIT Rate and unconditional Elemental DMG Bonus benefit his Burst; the Normal Attack passive has little value off-field. Only after meeting ER requirements.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: Energy Recharge and high Base ATK help support frequent Bursts while retaining reasonable personal damage. Its on-field Normal Attack passive is mostly wasted.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: ER and a Skill reset produce extra Hydro particles.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Energy Recharge and neutral particles help Xingqiu and his entire team; weave a Normal Attack to trigger CRIT reliably. Build enough CRIT Rate and hit an enemy while on-field. Higher refinements improve reliability.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Free Energy Recharge sword with extra Skill CRIT Rate and a brief ER boost after using his Skill. A practical alternative when Favonius or Sacrificial is unavailable. R5 obtainable from Fontaine fishing.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: ATK% and an Energy refund after Burst can work in well-batteried teams, but usually require more ER than Sacrificial. More effective with refinements and consistent Skill casts. R3+ preferred.

a.text: His best general set: 20% ER and Burst DMG scaling with ER directly support his main damage source.
Provides a teamwide ATK buff after Burst if nobody else is using Noblesse, at the cost of personal damage.
Mixed Burst and Hydro DMG bonuses are an easy temporary option before farming a strong 4-piece Emblem set.

t.name: National Book Club
t.text: Xingqiu supplies Hydro for Xiangling Vaporize; Bennett buffs and batteries, while Sucrose groups and shares EM.

t.name: Raiden National
t.text: Raiden recharges the team and drives Xingqiu sword rains; Xiangling Vaporizes while Bennett buffs both damage dealers.

t.name: Rain Sword Hyperbloom
t.text: Xingqiu creates Bloom cores with Nahida and Alhaitham; Kuki triggers Hyperbloom while healing the team.

t.name: Double Hydro Vaporize
t.text: Xingqiu and Yelan maintain Hydro for Hu Tao Vaporize while Zhongli protects her and shreds resistance.

why.v:
High Energy Needs: Use Sacrificial Sword R3+ or Favonius, ER Sands as needed, and enough ER to Burst each rotation.
C6 Low ER: C6 restores Energy during sword rain hits; with strong batteries, swap to an offensive sword and ATK% Sands.
Team Buffer: Use 4pc Noblesse if no teammate carries it; trade some Burst damage for team ATK.
Double Hydro: Hydro partners lower energy needs, allowing more damage substats; verify rotation-specific ER.
F2P: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman or craftable Amenoma can work with enough ER; farm 4pc Emblem.

seo.about: Xingqiu is a premier off-field Hydro DPS whose Burst enables Vaporize, Hyperbloom, and other reactions through coordinated sword rains. He adds DMG reduction, interruption resistance, and minor healing. Prioritize enough ER to Burst every rotation; weapon, team.

vars.title: High-ER Off-field Hydro
vars.stats: ER Sands and CRIT substats; prioritize Burst uptime over raw damage.
vars.teams: Best for solo-Hydro teams, C0-C5, or weak particle generation.
vars.when: Sacrificial is most consistent at R3+.
vars.cond: Approx. 150–180% ER with R3+ Sacrificial or 190–220% with Favonius at C0–C5; team dependent.

vars.title: C6 Low-ER Damage
vars.stats: Use ATK% Sands once ER is covered; focus CRIT and ATK% for Burst damage.
vars.teams: Works best with Raiden, double Hydro, or Favonius teammates.
vars.when: Requires C6 for the extra Energy refund.
vars.cond: C6 lowers ER needs but does not remove them; prioritize reliable Bursts.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Buffer
vars.stats: ER first; aim for sufficient CRIT Rate to trigger Favonius.
vars.teams: ATK-scaling carry; nobody else should wear 4pc Noblesse.
vars.when: Choose when team ATK matters more than Xingqiu personal damage.
vars.cond: Avoid duplicate Noblesse buffs.
vars.notes: Best used with stable Burst uptime.

vars.title: Double-Hydro Off-field DPS
vars.stats: Reduce ER only as far as partner particles allow; invest leftovers in CRIT/ATK%.
vars.teams: A Hydro partner such as Yelan or Furina plus an active Normal Attack user.
vars.when: Useful when Hydro resonance and extra particles enable offensive gearing.
vars.cond: Energy needs vary with the Hydro partner.
vars.notes: Do not assume double Hydro alone guarantees low ER.

vars.title: Accessible Budget Build
vars.stats: ER Sands if necessary; then build 60%+ CRIT Rate and Hydro DMG.
vars.teams: Any reaction team that can trigger his Burst sword rains.
vars.when: Practical choice without premium 5-star swords or refined Sacrificial Sword.
vars.cond: Amenoma needs more ER than strong Sacrificial setups.
vars.notes: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman is obtained through fishing; refine when possible.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: ER and CRIT-triggered neutral particles help fund her costly Burst and the whole team.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: ER plus teamwide EM and ATK buffs when Skill and Burst hits build Sigils. Meet ER needs.

w.name: Rainbow Serpent's Rain Bow
w.text: ER secondary stat and an ATK-boosting passive improve both Burst access and ATK-scaling heals.

w.name: Snare Hook
w.text: Craftable ER bow that helps maintain Burst healing when Favonius is unavailable.

w.name: End of the Line
w.text: Fishing-obtainable Energy Recharge bow for dependable Burst access without weapon wishes. Its extra damage contributes little to team utility.

w.name: Fading Twilight
w.text: Energy Recharge with a rotating personal DMG buff; usable when stronger team-support bows are unavailable. Past limited-time event weapon; personal damage is modest.

a.text: Swirl reduces the absorbed Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo RES by 40%; long cooldowns can limit uptime.
Provides party EM from Moonsign effects; great for Lunar/reaction teams when no ally already equips it.
In Ascendant Gleam, off-field Skill hits can maintain the party ATK buff for ATK-scaling carries.
a.stats: Needs Ascendant Gleam and charged Skill flask

t.name: Moonlit Lightning
t.text: Jahoda enables Ascendant Gleam and absorbs Hydro for Flins; Mona provides Hydro and Omen, while Fischl adds Electro damage.

t.name: Purrfect Moonstorm
t.text: Ineffa enables Lunar-Charged, Furina buffs team damage, Jahoda heals for Fanfare, and Ifa drives reactions.

t.name: Secret Moon Garden
t.text: Nefer leads Lunar-Bloom with Lauma and Xingqiu. Jahoda heals and shares EM; her C6 adds substantial Moonsign CRIT buffs.

t.name: Budget Moon Circuit
t.text: Aino enables Ascendant Gleam with Jahoda; Fischl contributes Electro damage and Sucrose drives reactions and groups enemies.

why.v:
Lunar EM Support: Silken Moon for reaction-team EM if nobody else holds it; keep ER high and fully charge the Skill flask for C6.
ATK Team Buffer: Use 4pc Tenacity in Ascendant Gleam teams where recurring Skill hits can maintain its ATK buff.
Dendro Support: 4pc Deepwood is a niche option for Nefer teams if no teammate carries it; focus on ER and healing.
Quick Healer: Outside Ascendant Gleam, double-tap Skill to leave sooner; Burst heals and grants 100 EM above 70% HP.
C4 Battery Relief: At C4, robot conversion refunds Energy and reduces the ER needed for consistent Burst uptime.

seo.about: Jahoda is an ATK-scaling Anemo healer who grants the active character 100 EM after healing them above 70% HP. With another Moonsign character, Ascendant Gleam lets her Skill and Burst apply absorbed elements from off-field.

vars.title: Lunar EM Buffer
vars.stats: ER to Burst each rotation, then ATK%; Healing Bonus or Favonius CRIT circlet.
vars.teams: Another Moonsign teammate; prefer no existing Silken Moon holder.
vars.when: Use for Flins, Ineffa and other Lunar teams that benefit from team EM and healing.
vars.cond: Ascendant Gleam for off-field elemental application; C6 needs a full Skill flask.
vars.notes: Do not double-tap Skill before filling the flask if activating C6.

vars.title: Tenacity ATK Buffer
vars.stats: ER first, then ATK% for healing; CRIT Rate with Favonius.
vars.teams: Ascendant Gleam and an ATK-scaling main damage dealer.
vars.when: Use her repeated infused Skill hits to maintain the Tenacity party ATK buff.
vars.cond: Needs a full Skill flask and Ascendant Gleam to keep hitting off-field.
vars.notes: Weaker outside the infused Skill setup.

vars.title: Nefer Deepwood Healer
vars.stats: ER first, then ATK% and Healing Bonus; modest CRIT Rate for Favonius.
vars.teams: Nefer Dendro-focused teams with no other Deepwood user.
vars.when: Reduce Dendro RES while providing healing and EM utility; particularly relevant for Nefer.
vars.cond: Deepwood only when Dendro RES shred is not already supplied.
vars.notes: Skill/Burst hits must connect to maintain Deepwood; C6 improves her value.

vars.title: Fast Rotation Healer
vars.stats: Prioritize Burst ER and ATK%; Healing Bonus for added comfort.
vars.teams: Any team that needs Anemo healing and modest EM sharing.
vars.when: Outside Ascendant Gleam, shorten field time by cancelling the Skill charge before casting Burst.
vars.cond: No reliable off-field absorbed-element application without Ascendant Gleam.
vars.notes: Anemo Swirl VV shred still requires an on-field Swirl hit.

vars.title: C4 Energy-Saving Support
vars.stats: C4 conversion refunds lower ER needs; invest freed stats into ATK% and healing.
vars.teams: An Ascendant Gleam team with Burst robot elemental conversions.
vars.when: Use C4 refunds to improve healing stats without sacrificing Burst consistency.
vars.cond: Requires C4 and elemental conversion; ER needs still vary by team.
vars.notes: At C6 also fully charge the Skill flask to enable Moonsign CRIT buffs.
