w.name: Starcaller's Watch
w.text: Elemental Mastery and a strong team damage buff when she shields an ally; excellent premium support choice. Shielding support; ATK shield can be weaker than with high-ATK weapons.

w.name: Crane's Echoing Call
w.text: High base ATK supports stronger shields, with a plunge buff for teams using a plunging carry. Plunge teams with Xianyun or Xiao; passive requires plunge hits.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: At R5, gives the next character 48% ATK for 10s, making it an outstanding accessible carry buff. ATK-scaling on-field carry; low weapon base ATK lowers shield strength. R5 strongly recommended.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: Energy Recharge plus elemental damage buffs after Electro-related reactions; especially useful in Aggravate teams. Electro team and a relevant reaction triggered by Lan Yan. Higher refinements improve the buff.

w.name: Sacrificial Fragments
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and can reset Skill cooldown for extra shields, Swirls and flexible rotations. On-field driver or long rotations; reset depends on refinement. R3+ preferred for consistency.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Energy Recharge and neutral particles reduce the team's Energy needs when she lands a CRIT hit. Build enough CRIT Rate to trigger the passive reliably. Higher refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: Restores Energy and heals the team after Burst; useful for extra comfort when Burst is available. Only valuable when Bursting regularly; HP% does not strengthen her ATK shield. Higher refinements improve healing and Energy.

w.name: Wandering Evenstar
w.text: Elemental Mastery converts partly into flat ATK for Lan Yan and nearby allies, even while off-field. EM-focused driver or hybrid build. Higher refinements improve ATK sharing.

a.text: Swirl cuts the affected Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo RES by 40% for 10s; ideal for most elemental carries.
a.stats: ATK% / ATK% / ATK%; ER or CRIT Rate as needed

names: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
a.text: Grants 12% Anemo DMG Bonus through Swirl, useful for Wanderer or Xiao when VV does not buff the main damage type.
Boosts her Skill damage in a quickswap build; sacrifices the valuable team buffs provided by VV or Scroll.
a.stats: ATK% or EM / Anemo DMG / CRIT

t.name: Crimson Featherguard
t.text: Lan Yan shields Arlecchino, shreds Pyro RES with VV and can pass a TTDS ATK buff. Bennett boosts ATK; Yelan enables Vaporize.

t.name: Electro Featherdance
t.text: Lan Yan protects Clorinde and shreds Electro RES. Fischl and Nahida maintain Aggravate; Hakushin Ring is valuable here.

t.name: Frozen Flight
t.text: Lan Yan groups enemies, shields Ayaka and shreds Cryo RES. Xingqiu supplies Hydro while Rosaria adds Cryo damage.

t.name: Wanderer Windguard
t.text: Lan Yan protects Wanderer from interruption and can use Scroll to grant Anemo DMG. Faruzan and Bennett amplify his damage.

why.v:
Aggravate Shield: Use Hakushin Ring with 4pc VV in Electro teams; Swirl Electro before the damage dealer takes the field.
Anemo Carry Support: Use 4pc Scroll with Wanderer or Xiao; 4pc VV cannot reduce enemy Anemo RES.
On-Field Swirl Driver: Build EM/EM/EM with 4pc VV and Sacrificial Fragments; trigger Swirls through Normal Attacks.
Quickswap Skill DPS: Use 4pc Golden Troupe with damage stats; only when another unit handles the key team buffs.
Budget Shield: 4pc VV and R5 Thrilling Tales boost ATK carries; build ATK% for shield strength.

seo.about: Lan Yan is an ATK-scaling Anemo shielder who protects the on-field carry while reducing Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo resistance with Viridescent Venerer. Her Skill can absorb one of those elements for stronger matching-element protection. NA also swirls.

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.title: Aggravate Shield Buffer
vars.stats: ATK% main stats for shield; add ER for C4 Burst buff and CRIT Rate for Favonius.
vars.teams: Electro carry plus Dendro support; Lan Yan must Swirl Electro.
vars.when: Use in Clorinde, Keqing or other Aggravate teams for shields, Electro RES shred and conditional Hakushin buffs.
vars.cond: Hakushin requires an Electro-related reaction by Lan Yan.

vars.title: Anemo Carry Shield

sets: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

vars.stats: ATK% for stronger shields; ER only if Bursting every rotation.
vars.teams: Wanderer or Xiao as the main damage dealer; other teammates handle Anemo buffs.
vars.when: Use Scroll to grant a modest Anemo DMG buff while shielding your Anemo carry; VV cannot shred Anemo RES.
vars.cond: Shield lasts 12.5s and may not cover an entire extended rotation.

vars.title: On-Field Swirl Driver
vars.stats: Elemental Mastery / EM / EM; level to 90 for stronger Swirl damage.
vars.teams: Off-field Hydro and Electro or Electro and Dendro partners for repeated reactions.
vars.when: Drive reactions with Anemo Normal Attacks and Swirls while benefiting from her own shield.
vars.cond: EM reduces shield strength compared with ATK%; C2 helps shield sustain.

vars.title: Quickswap Skill DPS
vars.stats: ATK% or EM Sands, Anemo DMG Goblet, CRIT Circlet; sufficient ER if Bursting.
vars.teams: Teammates provide major buffs or another Anemo handles VV shred.
vars.when: Use repeated Skill casts for personal damage rather than maximizing the shield or team buffs.
vars.cond: Sacrificial reset or C6 charge enables extra Skills; Golden Troupe lowers team utility.

vars.title: F2P ATK Shield
vars.stats: ATK% / ATK% / ATK%; shield strength comes from ATK rather than HP.
vars.teams: Best with an ATK-scaling Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo carry.
vars.when: A low-investment defensive option: shield the carry, trigger Swirl for VV shred and pass the TTDS buff.
vars.cond: Use R5 TTDS where possible; its low base ATK weakens the shield.

vars.title: Aggravate Shield Buffer
vars.stats: ATK% main stats for shield; add ER for C4 Burst buff and CRIT Rate for Favonius.
vars.teams: Electro carry plus Dendro support; Lan Yan must Swirl Electro.
vars.when: Use in Clorinde, Keqing or other Aggravate teams for shields, Electro RES shred and conditional Hakushin buffs.
vars.cond: Hakushin requires an Electro-related reaction by Lan Yan.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: ER and CRIT-triggered neutral particles help fund her costly Burst and support team rotations.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Elemental Mastery strengthens Swirls; triggering reactions builds teamwide ATK and Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack buffs. Best when teammates use its buffs and Burst energy is covered.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: A substantial ER substat supports Burst uptime.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: ER plus a possible extra Skill use increases Anemo particles and Swirl opportunities.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: Its EM substat improves Swirl damage while converting EM into Energy Recharge for Lynette and her teammates. For EM-focused support or C6 reaction-driver builds. More refinements boost shared ER.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: A free fishing sword that adds Energy Recharge, Skill CRIT Rate, and temporary extra ER after using Skill. Excellent free choice if you can fish for it. R5 obtainable through fishing.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: ATK% boosts personal damage, while Skill-generated Succession Seeds restore Energy after Burst. Better when multiple Skills are used across rotations; watch ER. Refinement increases Energy restored.

w.name: Wolf-Fang
w.text: CRIT Rate plus Skill and Burst damage bonuses improve her personal damage when Energy Recharge is already sufficient. Primarily damage-oriented or C6 builds; its stacks need on-field hits.

a.text: Swirling Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo reduces that element’s enemy RES by 40% for 10s.
Converts Energy Recharge into Burst damage, ideal when another Anemo ally already provides VV shred.
Grants the party 20% ATK after Burst; only use if no other teammate already carries 4pc Noblesse.

t.name: Childe Vaporize
t.text: Lynette Swirls Hydro or Pyro for VV shred and offers a taunt; Tartaglia enables Xiangling Vaporize while Bennett buffs and heals.

t.name: Crimson Catwalk
t.text: Lynette shreds Pyro or Hydro RES with VV; Yelan supplies off-field Hydro and buffs while Bennett buffs Arlecchino.

t.name: Electric Masquerade
t.text: Lynette Swirls Electro for VV shred, boosting Clorinde and Fischl; Nahida maintains Dendro for Aggravate reactions.

t.name: C6 Plunge Revue
t.text: At C6, Lynette uses Anemo-infused attacks and Xianyun-enabled plunges; Faruzan buffs Anemo and Furina provides damage buffs.

why.v:
C6 Anemo Carry: C6 Anemo-infused on-field attacks: Marechaussee Hunter with Furina; ATK%/Anemo/CRIT, balanced ER.
C6 Hyperbloom Driver: C6 only: EM/EM/EM on 4pc VV or Gilded Dreams; Swirl Electro into Dendro Cores with Hydro and Dendro allies.
Burst Damage: 4pc Emblem, ER/ATK%/CRIT; best when another teammate already handles VV resistance shred.
Noblesse Buffer: 4pc Noblesse for 20% team ATK after Burst; avoid duplicating another Noblesse holder.
Free-to-Play: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman and 4pc VV; prioritize enough ER to Burst, then CRIT and ATK%.

seo.about: Lynette is an off-field Anemo support whose Burst taunts enemies and deals periodic Anemo damage. Viridescent Venerer lets her reduce Swirled elemental RES, while her passive grants a modest team ATK buff. Her C6 unlocks an Anemo-infused on-field driver playstyle.
stats: ER, solo Anemo (1 Skill, no Fav): 240%+

vars.title: C6 Anemo Carry
vars.stats: ATK%/Anemo DMG/CRIT; maintain Burst ER; account for Marechaussee CRIT Rate.
vars.teams: C6 required; Faruzan and Furina/Xianyun are strong partners.
vars.when: Use the C6 Anemo infusion for on-field attacks and optionally Xianyun-enhanced plunges. Lynette can self-drain/heal HP for Marechaussee.
vars.cond: Requires C6
vars.notes: Desert Pavilion is an alternative when its Charged Attack activation fits your rotation.

vars.title: C6 Hyperbloom Driver
vars.stats: EM/EM/EM; use ER Sands if Burst uptime is inconsistent. Level 90 matters for reaction damage.
vars.teams: C6; Electro + Hydro + Dendro teammates, e.g. Fischl, Xingqiu, Nahida.
vars.when: Anemo-infused attacks Swirl Electro into Dendro Cores, triggering Hyperbloom; VV also enhances Hydro and Electro teammate damage.
vars.cond: Requires C6 and Electro aura access
vars.notes: Do not assume Lynette owns every Hyperbloom when Electro teammates also trigger cores.

vars.title: Burst Damage
vars.stats: ER/ATK% Sands, Anemo Goblet, CRIT Circlet; meet Burst ER first.
vars.teams: Best if another Anemo already holds Viridescent Venerer or VV offers little value.
vars.when: Concentrates on her Burst damage rather than boosting Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo allies.
vars.cond: High Energy Recharge may be needed as solo Anemo
vars.notes: Emblem does not replace VV resistance reduction in reaction-focused teams.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Buffer
vars.stats: Prioritize ER; use CRIT Rate for Favonius, then ATK or CRIT as desired.
vars.teams: ATK-scaling main damage dealer; no existing 4pc Noblesse wielder.
vars.when: Use her Burst to provide 20% team ATK. This is a fallback when VV shred is unavailable, redundant, or assigned elsewhere.
vars.cond: Do not stack duplicate 4pc Noblesse buffs
vars.notes: Her modest built-in ATK buff remains separate from the Noblesse buff.

vars.title: Accessible VV Support
vars.stats: ER Sands if needed; Anemo DMG Goblet and CRIT Circlet.
vars.teams: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo carry who benefits from VV shred.
vars.when: Budget build that focuses on reliable Burst and on-field Swirl application instead of expensive weapons.
vars.cond: Solo Anemo and one Skill can need very high ER
vars.notes: Skyrider Sword offers an accessible ER fallback; Amenoma needs a suitable rotation to restore Energy.

w.name: Angelos' Heptades
w.text: Exceptional base ATK helps reach the 4,000 ATK Tolling Rally cap. Its other effects are secondary to the stat value. Premium ATK option; do not pull just for Prune.

w.name: Crane's Echoing Call
w.text: High base ATK and ATK% help strengthen Tolling Rally; its Plunging Attack buff is mostly unused on typical Prune teams. Use if already owned; ER must be covered.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: High base ATK plus ATK% makes reaching the 4,000 ATK buff cap easier without relying on niche passive triggers. Enough Energy Recharge from artifacts and team.

w.name: Memory of Dust
w.text: ATK% stat and stackable ATK can improve Tolling Rally; gaining passive stacks needs field time, so do not assume maximum stacks. Lower value without time to build stacks.

w.name: Oathsworn Eye
w.text: High base ATK and ATK% improve her buffs.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Craftable high-base-ATK catalyst with ATK% for stronger Tolling Rally; its Skill damage passive is not why Prune uses it. Best when Energy Recharge is already sufficient.

w.name: Hakushin Ring
w.text: Energy Recharge eases Burst requirements; Electro-related reactions may provide a brief elemental DMG buff in Electro teams. Electro team; Prune must trigger a qualifying reaction.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: Energy Recharge and CRIT-triggered neutral particles reduce steep Burst costs and help allies, at the expense of Prune's ATK buff. High-ER teams or teammates needing particles. Higher refinements improve consistency.

a.text: Shreds 40% RES of the Swirled Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo element when Prune triggers Swirl on-field; ideal for elemental carries.
Alternative for Anemo-focused Hexerei teams or when Prune cannot Swirl the primary carry's element; check for an existing set holder.
After Burst, buffs party ATK by 20%.

t.name: Witchhunter Vanguard
t.text: Prune enables Varka's Hexerei Anemo bonuses and teamwide DMG buffs; Durin supplies elemental application and Nicole buffs Varka.

t.name: Witchwind Encore
t.text: Venti activates Hexerei Anemo synergy and helps fund Prune's Burst; Durin maintains a Swirlable aura. Use an appropriate set holder.

t.name: Chimes of Frost
t.text: Prune grants Lohen teamwide DMG Bonus and supports Durin's off-field damage. Swirlable elemental application sustains Tolling Rally.

t.name: Keqing-A-Ling
t.text: Accessible Aggravate team: Prune Swirls Electro for VV and buffs damage, Fischl supports Keqing, and Kirara supplies Dendro and shielding.

why.v:
Hexerei Anemo Carry: Pair with Varka or Venti and another Swirlable element; stack ER first, then ATK toward 4,000 with Hexerei buffs active.
VV Electro Support: Use Viridescent Venerer and Swirl Electro on-field; Hakushin Ring can add conditional team buffs.
Anemo-Focused Buffs: Use Celestial Gift when VV cannot shred the main Anemo carry's resistance; avoid duplicating an existing holder.
High-ER / Favonius: Use Favonius Codex and some CRIT Rate when solo Anemo or Energy-starved; accept a smaller Tolling Rally buff.
TTDS Niche: Only use Thrilling Tales with enough other ATK buffs to approach 4,000 ATK; swap directly to an ATK-scaling carry.

seo.about: Prune is an off-field Anemo buffer whose converted hammer grants teammates Tolling Rally after a Swirl, providing up to 50% DMG Bonus based on her ATK above 2,000. Her Hexerei passive further boosts her ATK and Hexerei Anemo allies when two Hexerei units are present. Prioritize Burst uptime before ATK.

vars.title: Hexerei Anemo Buffer
vars.stats: ER to Burst every rotation, then ATK; count Hexerei-triggered 60% ATK toward the 4,000 cap.
vars.teams: Two Hexerei characters, an Anemo Hexerei carry and consistent Swirlable aura.
vars.when: For Varka/Venti-style teams where Prune grants 30% ATK to a Hexerei Anemo ally on qualifying Swirl.
vars.cond: Hexerei homework completed; two Hexerei in party.
vars.notes: 4pc VV still suits a team with important Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo damage.

vars.title: Electro VV Support
vars.stats: ER first; ATK% afterward. CRIT Rate only if using Favonius.
vars.teams: Electro aura available for on-field Swirl; Electro damage dealers.
vars.when: For Keqing/Fischl and similar teams that value Electro RES shred and teamwide DMG Bonus.
vars.cond: Hakushin Ring requires Prune to trigger an Electro-related reaction.
vars.notes: Cast or hit with Anemo while on-field to activate VV RES shred.

vars.title: Anemo Carry Artifact Flex
vars.stats: Use ATK/ATK/ATK if ER met; ER Sands otherwise.
vars.teams: A primarily Anemo DPS; another character can already hold VV or Celestial Gift.
vars.when: Choose Celestial Gift when the primary damage is Anemo; use Noblesse if Celestial Gift already has a holder.
vars.cond: Do not duplicate team-wide artifact buffs unnecessarily.
vars.notes: 4pc Celestial Gift is conditional; check team artifact ownership.

vars.title: High-ER Solo Anemo
vars.stats: At C0 solo Anemo, start around 245-285% ER before weapon/particle reductions.
vars.teams: Solo Anemo team with a reliable Swirlable aura; Favonius helps energy.
vars.when: When her high Burst cost prevents every-rotation uptime; lower ATK is preferable to skipping Burst.
vars.cond: C1 and Favonius lower Energy needs substantially.
vars.notes: Aim for CRIT Rate if using Favonius; team ER needs vary.

vars.title: TTDS Heavy-Buff Setup
vars.stats: Requires strong external ATK buffs; verify Prune approaches 4,000 ATK when Tolling Rally applies.
vars.teams: ATK-scaling on-field carry plus enough ATK boosts for Prune; swap order matters.
vars.when: Niche setup that layers TTDS onto Tolling Rally only when its low base ATK does not meaningfully weaken her own buff.
vars.cond: Use TTDS only if A4 buff remains near cap; R5 advised.
vars.notes: TTDS is generally worse without exceptional external ATK.

w.name: Favonius Greatsword
w.text: ER and CRIT-triggered neutral particles help Sayu and the team sustain Burst rotations.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: High ATK boosts Burst healing.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: High base ATK supports healing, while its ER substat helps maintain Burst uptime.

w.name: Makhaira Aquamarine
w.text: Its EM substat supports Swirls, while its passive converts EM into ATK for Sayu and nearby allies.

w.name: Katsuragikiri Nagamasa
w.text: Craftable Energy Recharge claymore with Skill damage and a delayed flat Energy refund, improving Burst consistency. Skill must hit to activate the passive. Refinements improve Energy refund.

w.name: Sacrificial Greatsword
w.text: Energy Recharge plus a chance to reset Skill cooldown grants another cast and extra particles. The cooldown reset triggers from Skill damage, notably the finishing kick; extra cast takes field time. Higher refinements improve reset reliability.

w.name: Forest Regalia
w.text: Craftable ER option; after triggering a Dendro-related reaction, creates a leaf that grants EM to its collector. Only in teams where Sayu can trigger the required Dendro reaction.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: Elemental Mastery improves Swirl and transformative reactions for rolling on-field builds. Prioritize ER first; passive is situational against Hydro/Electro-affected enemies.

a.text: Best overall: Swirl lowers the affected Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro RES by 40% and improves Swirl damage.
Burst grants allies 20% ATK for 12s; use when no teammate carries Noblesse and Sayu can Burst reliably.
Converts healing into periodic physical damage; a niche option when Viridescent shred is already covered.

t.name: Roly-Poly Taser
t.text: Sayu rolls with Hydro absorption to Swirl and drive reactions; Kokomi and Fischl apply elements while Sucrose groups and shares EM.

t.name: Rolling Hyperbloom
t.text: Sayu absorbs Hydro and spreads it during her roll; Nahida sustains Dendro, and full-EM Kuki triggers Hyperbloom.

t.name: Sleepy Aggravate
t.text: Sayu heals and Swirls Electro to shred its RES; Nahida maintains Quicken for Keqing and Fischl Aggravates.

t.name: Firework Ninja
t.text: Sayu offers healing and Pyro RES shred for Lyney; Bennett buffs and Xiangling adds off-field Pyro damage.

why.v:
ATK Healing: Use ER/ATK% sands, ATK% goblet and Healing Bonus circlet; prioritize Burst uptime and healing before damage.
C6 EM Healer: At C6, EM also increases Daruma healing; use EM main stats after meeting Burst Energy needs.
On-Field Roll Driver: Use high EM and Viridescent; quick rolls absorb an element and drive Swirl reactions. Level Sayu to 90.
Noblesse Buffer: Choose 4pc Noblesse only when VV is covered and Sayu Bursts reliably; grants a teamwide ATK buff.
Budget Energy: Favonius or craftable Katsuragikiri plus ER sands can make frequent Burst healing much easier.

seo.about: Sayu is an Anemo healer who combines teamwide Burst healing with Viridescent Venerer RES shred. Her healing scales with ATK, while EM boosts Swirl damage and her active Swirl healing. Build enough Energy Recharge to Burst reliably; C6 makes EM-focused healing more effective.
stats: ER driver with C4: often 10% - 15% less

vars.title: ATK-Focused Healer
vars.stats: ER/ATK% Sands, ATK% Goblet, Healing Bonus Circlet; ER first, then ATK%.
vars.teams: Works wherever healing plus Anemo utility is needed.
vars.when: Use before C6 if you need stronger direct Burst healing and do not prioritize personal Swirl damage.
vars.cond: Very high ER can be needed as solo Anemo.

vars.title: C6 EM Swirl Healer
vars.stats: Build EM/EM/EM if Burst uptime permits; ER Sands if needed.
vars.teams: Teams that benefit from Swirl and can support her Energy needs.
vars.when: At C6, EM increases Daruma damage and healing while enhancing Swirl damage.
vars.cond: Requires Sayu C6.
vars.notes: C6 does not increase the initial teamwide Burst heal.

vars.title: On-Field Rolling Driver
vars.stats: Prioritize EM and ER; Skill talent matters more than in off-field builds.
vars.teams: Use persistent off-field application; avoid reliance on Normal Attack-triggered effects.
vars.when: Roll to absorb an element, spread it, and trigger Swirls/reactions. Sayu Level 90 improves Swirl damage.
vars.cond: Requires substantial on-field time.
vars.notes: Rolling does not trigger Xingqiu/Yelan rain swords or Beidou Burst lightning.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Buffer
vars.stats: Prioritize ER and ATK% for consistent Bursts and strong healing.
vars.teams: Use only if another unit already supplies Viridescent shred or it is not needed.
vars.when: Give ATK-scaling carries a 20% team ATK buff while retaining healing.
vars.cond: Needs reliable Burst uptime; avoid duplicating Noblesse.

vars.title: Accessible ER Healer
vars.stats: ER Sands; ATK% Goblet; Healing Bonus Circlet.
vars.teams: No premium weapon required; crafted sword materials may be needed.
vars.when: A budget path that prioritizes consistent Burst healing, then upgrades EM or ATK as Energy improves.
vars.cond: Forest Regalia passive needs Sayu to trigger a Dendro reaction.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: EM improves Swirl; reaction triggers can buff ally ATK and attack damage. Needs reliable reaction triggers; premium team buff.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: High CRIT Rate boosts Anemo Skill and Burst damage in hybrid builds. Best when energy and CRIT balance are covered.

w.name: Mistsplitter Reforged
w.text: Strong CRIT DMG and elemental damage; some stacks are hard to maintain. Personal damage build, not pure EM Swirl.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: Energy Recharge helps Burst uptime; extra passive damage needs on-field hits. ER-focused hybrid build.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: CRIT hits generate neutral particles, helping Traveler and teammates. Build enough CRIT Rate to trigger passive. Refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Skill cooldown reset adds Anemo particles and another chance to Swirl. Cooldown reset must trigger. Higher refinements preferred.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: EM supports Swirl while passive converts EM into team Energy Recharge. EM-focused support; gacha-limited.

w.name: Iron Sting
w.text: Craftable EM option that strengthens Swirl; passive also adds personal damage. Accessible EM support.

a.text: Swirl reduces enemy resistance to the Swirled element by 40%.
Burst grants party ATK; use only when no teammate already equips Noblesse.
Temporary damage mix; weaker team utility than 4pc Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Childe Vaporize
t.text: Traveler Swirls Hydro or Pyro for VV shred, while Tartaglia enables Xiangling Vaporize. Position the tornado carefully to avoid scattering small enemies.

t.name: Frostwind Freeze
t.text: Traveler shreds Cryo resistance and helps group lighter foes. Kokomi sustains Freeze, while Rosaria supplies Cryo energy and damage.

t.name: Rainstorm Taser
t.text: Traveler Swirls Electro or Hydro to reduce resistance as Beidou, Fischl, and Xingqiu deal off-field damage. Defensive utility comes from their kits.

t.name: Windswept Xiao
t.text: Traveler provides Anemo particles and C6 Anemo RES shred for Xiao; Zhongli protects him and Bennett boosts damage. Burst can displace light enemies.

why.v:
EM Swirl Support: 4pc Viridescent; EM/EM/EM after meeting ER needs. Swirl an enemy element to reduce its RES.
Hybrid Quickswap: 4pc Viridescent; ATK or ER/Anemo/CRIT for personal Skill and Burst damage.
C6 Xiao Battery: Favonius or Sacrificial Sword; use Skill for particles and Burst for Anemo RES shred.
Noblesse Buffer: 4pc Noblesse only if no ally wears it and Burst uptime is dependable.
Budget Support: Craft Iron Sting, build enough ER, then stack EM on 4pc Viridescent.

seo.about: Anemo Traveler is a flexible quickswap support who uses Palm Vortex and Gust Surge to trigger Swirl and reduce enemy resistance with Viridescent Venerer. Their C6 adds resistance reduction to Burst-affected enemies. The traveling tornado can push small foes away, so positioning matters.

vars.title: Hybrid Quickswap Damage
vars.stats: ATK% or ER Sands, Anemo DMG Goblet, CRIT Circlet; balance CRIT and ATK after meeting ER.
vars.teams: An allied Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo applier allows Swirl.
vars.when: Use for more personal Skill/Burst damage when already meeting energy needs. Four-piece VV still benefits the team most.
vars.cond: Best in teams with regular swaps.
vars.notes: Physical Normal Attack builds remain a low-damage novelty; this variant is Anemo-focused.

vars.title: C6 Xiao Anemo Battery
vars.stats: Prioritize reliable Skill particles and enough ER for Burst; build CRIT Rate with Favonius.
vars.teams: Requires Xiao as main carry; C6 Traveler for Anemo RES shred.
vars.when: Support Xiao with Anemo particles and Burst-based Anemo resistance reduction. Noblesse can buff ATK when no teammate already carries it.
vars.cond: C6 needed for extra Anemo RES shred.
vars.notes: Anemo RES shred from C6 works on Burst-hit targets. Avoid letting the tornado drag enemies beyond Xiao reach.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Buffer
vars.stats: ER first; optional ATK/Anemo/CRIT stats for personal damage.
vars.teams: No other Noblesse holder; consistent Burst access.
vars.when: Choose Noblesse for an ATK-scaling Anemo, Geo, or Dendro carry when VV elemental shred is less useful.
vars.cond: Team-specific; Noblesse buffs do not stack.
vars.notes: Noblesse requires Burst activation; positioning remains important.

vars.title: Accessible EM Swirl
vars.stats: Use ER Sands until Burst is consistent; otherwise aim for EM main stats.
vars.teams: Bring at least one Swirlable Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo source.
vars.when: A budget-friendly way to provide VV shred and Swirl damage. The craftable sword works well if ER is already covered.
vars.cond: Level 90 increases Swirl damage.
vars.notes: Iron Sting is craftable; Favonius/Sacrificial are gacha alternatives. Prioritize energy before extra EM.

w.name: Favonius Greatsword
w.text: CRIT hits make team Energy particles. Build CRIT Rate. Higher refinements help.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: High ATK; situational team ATK buff. If Burst uptime is already secure.

w.name: Sacrificial Greatsword
w.text: Extra Skill gives Energy and particles. Reset must activate. Higher refinements preferred.

w.name: Katsuragikiri Nagamasa
w.text: Craftable Energy refund from Skill hits. Mind its delayed Energy restoration. Higher refinements help.

w.name: Forest Regalia
w.text: ER plus a Dendro-reaction EM leaf buff. Use in Dendro teams; collect the leaf.

w.name: Makhaira Aquamarine
w.text: EM scaling adds an ATK buff for allies. Best on high-EM Hyperbloom variants.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: EM boosts reactions in driver builds. Needs enough ER from other sources.

w.name: Bloodtainted Greatsword
w.text: Budget EM for reaction-focused builds. Only with sufficient Energy Recharge.

a.text: Burst grants teamwide ATK.
Reduces enemy Dendro RES.
a.stats: Only if nobody else uses Deepwood

a.text: Reactions grant the team EM.

t.name: Claymore Superconduct
t.text: Dori supplies healing, Energy and Electro for Superconduct; Rosaria and Shenhe support Eula’s Physical damage.

t.name: C6 Aggravate Bazaar
t.text: At C6, Dori drives Aggravate with Electro-infused attacks. Fischl adds damage; Nahida and Sucrose enable and amplify reactions.

t.name: Swirling Jinni Bloom
t.text: Jean can Swirl Electro from Dori’s self-application to trigger Hyperbloom. Keep both Bursts active and position close to cores.

t.name: Cyno Energy Caravan
t.text: Dori sustains Cyno during field time and helps with Energy; Nahida and Xingqiu enable Quickbloom reactions.

why.v:
HP Healer: Build ER first, then HP% and Healing Bonus to improve Jinni healing.
Noblesse Buffer: Use 4pc Noblesse when the team benefits from ATK and no ally carries it.
Deepwood Carrier: In Dendro teams, equip Deepwood if nobody else handles Dendro RES shred.
C6 Aggravate: Use EM, Electro DMG, CRIT, and enough ER; C6 grants brief Electro infusion.
Jean Hyperbloom: Pair with Jean for Electro self-Swirls; reaction damage depends on trigger EM.

seo.about: Dori heals and restores Energy to the active character through her 80-Energy Burst. Prioritize Energy Recharge, then HP and Healing Bonus. Her off-field Electro application is limited, but C6 enables an on-field reaction driver.

vars.title: High-HP Burst Healer
vars.stats: ER/HP% sands, HP% goblet, Healing Bonus circlet. Prioritize ER then HP%.
vars.teams: Teams needing reliable active-character healing and Energy.
vars.when: Simple general-purpose healer when damage is handled by teammates.
vars.cond: Burst uptime comes first; prioritize CRIT Rate with Favonius.
vars.notes: Only the linked active character gets standard Burst healing.

vars.title: Dendro Resistance Shred
vars.stats: Maintain Burst uptime; use ER/HP%/Healing Bonus.
vars.teams: A Dendro damage dealer and no existing 4pc Deepwood user.
vars.when: Provides Dendro RES reduction without forcing your Dendro carry to equip Deepwood.
vars.cond: Needs consistent Dori Skill or Burst contact with enemies.
vars.notes: Burst tether can hit targets, but positioning matters.

vars.title: C6 Aggravate Driver
vars.stats: ER to needs; EM or ER sands, Electro goblet, CRIT circlet.
vars.teams: C6 Dori, Dendro enabler, and preferably Fischl.
vars.when: C6 grants short Electro infusion after Skill, allowing on-field Aggravates and partywide healing from Normal Attacks.
vars.cond: C6 required; refresh Skill frequently.
vars.notes: Thundering Fury helps extend infusion uptime via shorter Skill cooldowns.

vars.title: Jean Hyperbloom Engine
vars.stats: ER first, then EM/EM/EM if Dori triggers reactions.
vars.teams: Jean, off-field Hydro, and a Dendro applier.
vars.when: Electro self-application from Dori plus Jean’s Burst can Swirl Electro to trigger nearby Dendro cores.
vars.cond: Requires careful Burst overlap and positioning.
vars.notes: Reaction ownership may vary; the actual Hyperbloom trigger should build EM.

vars.title: Instructor Budget Support
vars.stats: Use a 5-star ER sands with 4pc Instructor; build HP and useful CRIT.
vars.teams: Reaction-based team that can reliably trigger Instructor.
vars.when: Accessible team Elemental Mastery support when a stronger 5-star artifact set is unavailable.
vars.cond: 4-star pieces reduce total stats and healing.
vars.notes: Instructor requires a reaction triggered while Dori is on field.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: ER and extra team ATK/EM when triggered.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: 674 base ATK; strong buff and Burst DMG.

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: Strong personal Burst DMG and CRIT.

w.name: Mouun's Moon
w.text: High base ATK; boosts Burst DMG. Best in high-total-Energy teams.

w.name: Fading Twilight
w.text: 565 base ATK, ER and damage bonus. Event-exclusive; unavailable to new players. R5 from original event.

w.name: Sacrificial Bow
w.text: ER and 565 base ATK; extra Skill use. Use a Crowfeather aimed shot for particles. Higher refinements ease resets.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: ER and team particles; weaker ATK buff. Lower base ATK; build CRIT Rate. More consistent at high refinement.

w.name: Prototype Crescent
w.text: Craftable choice for her ATK buff. Lower base ATK than Fading Twilight; aimed shots are situational.

a.text: ER plus amplified Burst damage.
Burst grants allies 20% ATK.
Burst damage and Electro DMG.

t.name: Shogun Thunder Court
t.text: Sara buffs Raiden before her Burst; Kazuha shreds Electro RES and Bennett adds healing and ATK. C6 Sara greatly amplifies Electro CRIT hits.

t.name: Aggravate Edict
t.text: Yaoyao enables Quicken; Fischl supplies off-field Electro and energy. Sara buffs Keqing’s short damage window, especially at C6.

t.name: Clorinde Lightning
t.text: Kirara enables Quicken and protection; Fischl batteries the team. Sara buffs Clorinde’s Electro damage, but her short buff limits uptime.

t.name: Overload Commission
t.text: Only Electro/Pyro teammates preserve Chevreuse’s Overloaded support. Sara buffs Raiden, while Xiangling provides Pyro and off-field damage.

why.v:
C6 Electro Buffer: C6 grants 60% Electro CRIT DMG to buffed allies; refresh Sara’s short ATK buff immediately before the carry attacks.
Burst DPS: Use Emblem, Electro DMG and CRIT. Skyward Harp, Polar Star or Mouun’s Moon raise personal Burst damage.
Noblesse Buffer: Use 4pc Noblesse when no teammate already carries it; prioritize ER to Burst regularly.
Favonius Battery: Trade some ATK-buff strength for team particles. Build enough CRIT Rate and trigger the passive on field.
Budget Buff: Fading Twilight works if owned; otherwise use craftable Prototype Crescent or another high-base-ATK bow.

seo.about: Kujou Sara is an Electro quickswap buffer whose short Crowfeather ATK boost scales with her base ATK and Skill level. Her Burst adds strong damage, while C6 grants buffed allies 60% Electro CRIT DMG. She shines with fast, Electro-focused carries.

vars.title: C6 Electro Hypercarry Buffer
vars.stats: Meet ER needs first; high weapon base ATK determines her ATK buff.
vars.teams: Electro damage dealer with a brief, frontloaded attack window.
vars.when: Apply Sara’s Crowfeather or Burst buff just before Raiden/Keqing attacks. C6 adds 60% Electro CRIT DMG that cannot be snapshotted.
vars.cond: Requires C6 for CRIT DMG bonus.
vars.notes: Skill talent increases the base-ATK-scaling ATK buff; artifact ATK% does not.

vars.title: Personal Burst Damage
vars.stats: ER to Burst each rotation, then Electro DMG, CRIT and ATK%.
vars.teams: Team supports Sara’s Burst and provides ample Energy.
vars.when: Use when Sara contributes meaningful personal damage as well as buffs; snapshot her own ATK buff onto her Burst when possible.
vars.cond: Polar Star stacks vary by rotation.
vars.notes: Mouun’s Moon performs well with high party Burst Energy costs.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Buffer
vars.stats: Increase ER until she can Burst reliably before prioritizing damage.
vars.teams: No other teammate should carry 4pc Noblesse Oblige.
vars.when: Choose when the team benefits more from an extra 20% ATK than Sara’s personal Burst damage. Sara’s Skill still sets her own ATK buff strength.
vars.cond: Not useful if another 4pc Noblesse user is present.
vars.notes: Aim Crowfeather explosion at enemy to generate Electro particles.

vars.title: Favonius Team Battery
vars.stats: Build CRIT Rate to trigger Favonius; retain enough ER.
vars.teams: Energy-hungry teams that value particles above a maximum ATK buff.
vars.when: Favonius reduces Sara’s ATK-buff strength due to its low base ATK, but can help stabilize the party’s rotation.
vars.cond: Favonius passive must CRIT while Sara is on field.
vars.notes: C2’s extra Crowfeather does not produce Skill particles; an aimed Crowfeather explosion does.

vars.title: Accessible Buff Support
vars.stats: ER first; use ATK% Sands only if Burst is already consistent.
vars.teams: Prefer double Electro with Raiden or Fischl for smoother energy.
vars.when: Fading Twilight is excellent if owned from its past event. Otherwise craft Prototype Crescent or use Sacrificial Bow for energy utility.
vars.cond: Fading Twilight is no longer obtainable.
vars.notes: Level the bow for base ATK; ATK% artifacts do not raise Sara’s Crowfeather buff.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: High EM plus a team buff. Trigger reactions consistently; team buff needs its passive to activate.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: HP scaling and shareable EM. Best in HP/EM hybrid builds; requires Skill-hit passive stacks.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: EM and teamwide Energy Recharge. Useful when teammates value its ER conversion. More ER at higher refinements.

w.name: Iron Sting
w.text: Craftable EM for Hyperbloom. Weapon passive does not boost Hyperbloom damage. R1 works.

w.name: Toukabou Shigure
w.text: EM substat boosts Hyperbloom. Event-limited; damage passive does not buff Hyperbloom.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Team particles on CRIT hits. Support only: build CRIT Rate to activate passive while on-field. Higher refinements improve consistency.

w.name: Dark Iron Sword
w.text: Free EM starter sword. Low-cost Hyperbloom option; smaller EM stat than 4-star alternatives.

w.name: Sapwood Blade
w.text: Craftable team EM leaf buff. Dendro reaction teams; an ally must collect the leaf.

a.text: Maximizes Hyperbloom damage.
Large EM bonus for Hyperbloom.
a.stats: EM / EM / EM; pair farming with Deepwood

a.text: Skill maintains team ATK buff.

t.name: Dendro Rainstorm
t.text: Nahida and double Hydro generate Dendro Cores; Kuki triggers Hyperbloom and heals. Keep Deepwood on Nahida.

t.name: Scholar Hyperbloom
t.text: Alhaitham drives Dendro damage; Xingqiu makes cores and Kuki triggers them while healing.

t.name: Budget Bloom Circuit
t.text: Accessible Hyperbloom core: Dendro Traveler and Collei enable cores, Xingqiu supplies Hydro and Kuki detonates them.

t.name: Coffee Needed
t.text: Kuki sustains Quicken and heals while Keqing and Fischl deal Aggravate damage; switch to Tenacity support stats.

why.v:
Gilded Hyperbloom: 4pc Gilded Dreams offers high EM and efficient farming alongside Deepwood Memories.
Aggravate Support: 4pc Tenacity, HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus; buff Electro carries and maintain strong healing.
Team Energy: Favonius Sword helps energy-hungry teammates; build enough CRIT Rate for an on-field proc.
Budget Hyperbloom: Iron Sting or Dark Iron Sword with triple EM; prioritize character level 90.
HP/EM Hybrid: Key of Khaj-Nisut and mixed HP/EM stats add healing and team utility; needs Skill hits.

seo.about: Kuki Shinobu heals and triggers Hyperbloom with off-field Electro Skill pulses. Build triple EM and level 90 for reaction damage; her Burst is optional. Outside Hyperbloom, HP-focused Tenacity support can improve healing and team buffs.

vars.title: Gilded Hyperbloom
vars.stats: Triple EM; prioritize level 90. Burst and ER are optional.
vars.teams: Hydro and Dendro applications; a Deepwood holder.
vars.when: Choose the efficient Gilded/Deepwood domain instead of farming Flower of Paradise Lost directly.
vars.cond: Kuki should trigger cores herself.
vars.notes: Set effectiveness depends on teammate elements.

vars.title: Aggravate Team Healer
vars.stats: HP%/HP%/Healing Bonus for healing; mix EM if comfortable.
vars.teams: Electro DPS and Dendro applier in a Quicken team.
vars.when: Keep Skill active for healing, Electro application and Tenacity ATK buff; do not treat this as her Hyperbloom damage build.
vars.notes: If on Favonius, get enough CRIT Rate to trigger its passive on-field.

vars.title: Energy Utility Support
vars.stats: ER as needed for Burst; HP% and CRIT Rate for healing/Favonius.
vars.teams: Team that values particles or a Dendro-reaction EM leaf.
vars.when: Trade reaction damage for energy support. Favonius particles require a CRIT hit while Kuki is on-field.
vars.notes: Sapwood leaf is collected by a teammate, not automatically granted.

vars.title: Key HP / EM Hybrid
vars.stats: Balance HP and EM; HP boosts healing and Key passive.
vars.teams: Able to stack Key passive with Skill hits; supportive teammates.
vars.when: Hybrid setup for additional healing and team buffs while retaining some reaction contribution.
vars.cond: Key passive stacks required.
vars.notes: Key can share EM; evaluate full-EM Hyperbloom separately.

vars.title: F2P Full-EM Trigger
vars.stats: Triple EM; aim for level 90 before chasing CRIT or ER.
vars.teams: At least one Dendro and one Hydro unit making cores.
vars.when: Accessible Hyperbloom damage with low weapon investment. Iron Sting R1 is sufficient.
vars.notes: Weapon damage bonuses do not increase Hyperbloom reaction damage.

w.text: CRIT Rate and on-field damage bonus. Needs sustained field time.

w.text: High ATK boosts direct Electro damage.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Large EM bonus benefits Aggravate. Lower direct damage in some builds.

w.name: Solar Pearl
w.text: CRIT Rate; boosts Skill and Burst. Use Normal Attacks to activate passive.

EM and ATK for Aggravate.

t.name: Library of Thunder
t.text: Nahida maintains Quicken, Fischl batteries Lisa and triggers Aggravate, while Xilonen supplies resistance shred and healing.

t.name: Storm Study Group
t.text: A practical Aggravate team: Yaoyao sustains Quicken and heals; Fischl batteries Lisa while Sucrose shares EM and shreds Electro RES.

t.name: Budget Lightning
t.text: Dendro Traveler enables Quicken; Fischl provides Electro damage and particles, and Sayu heals and applies VV Electro shred.

t.name: Rainy Research
t.text: Quickbloom mixes Aggravate with Hyperbloom. Lisa must Normal Attack to trigger Xingqiu; heavy Hydro may reduce Quicken uptime.

why.v:
Off-Field Burst: Emblem + Favonius; prioritize enough ER to Burst each rotation.
Noblesse Support: 4pc Noblesse + Favonius; use Burst for DEF shred and team ATK.
F2P Aggravate: Mappa Mare + 4pc Thundering Fury; invest in CRIT, EM and ER.
Quickbloom: Aggravate Lisa with a Hydro teammate; Quicken uptime may fall.

seo.about: Lisa is an Electro DPS who excels in on-field Aggravate teams. Her attacks and Burst apply Electro often, while her Burst lowers enemy DEF by 15%. Build CRIT, ATK and EM, maintain Quicken, and use her charged Skill to deal damage and generate Energy.
weapons: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

vars.title: Off-Field Burst DPS
vars.stats: Build enough ER to Burst each rotation; use Electro goblet and CRIT circlet.
vars.teams: A team that funnels Electro particles to Lisa.
vars.when: Use Lisa for her Burst’s repeated Electro hits and 15% enemy DEF reduction while another unit plays on-field.
vars.cond: Burst uptime varies with team Energy.
vars.notes: Hold Skill supplies particles; tap Skill supplies none.

vars.title: Noblesse DEF-Shred Support
vars.stats: ER first, then CRIT Rate for Favonius; personal damage is secondary.
vars.teams: An ATK-scaling team without another Noblesse user.
vars.when: Choose when Lisa’s DEF shred and a teamwide ATK buff matter more than her individual damage.
vars.cond: Requires reliable Burst uptime.

vars.title: Accessible Aggravate DPS
vars.stats: Balance EM or ATK sands with Electro goblet and CRIT circlet.
vars.teams: Dendro for Quicken, preferably another Electro for Energy.
vars.when: Use a craftable or affordable catalyst while learning Lisa’s on-field Aggravate combos.
vars.cond: Keep Quicken active.
vars.notes: At level 90, Aggravate damage improves.

vars.title: Quickbloom Driver
vars.stats: EM becomes more valuable; still build CRIT and enough ER for Burst.
vars.teams: Reliable Dendro, Electro battery and Hydro application.
vars.when: Use for mixed Aggravate and some Hyperbloom damage, with reaction ownership depending on the exact team.
vars.cond: Hydro application may reduce Quicken uptime.
vars.notes: Not the same as a guaranteed full-EM Hyperbloom trigger.

w.name: Beacon of the Reed Sea
w.text: CRIT Rate and conditional ATK. Keep ATK passive active.

w.name: Skyward Pride
w.text: ER and Burst vacuum blades. When Burst uptime needs help.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: CRIT and stackable damage. Shield helps preserve stacks.

w.name: Mailed Flower
w.text: EM and ATK for Aggravate. Trigger reactions consistently. R5 preferred.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: EM; bonus vs Electro-affected foes. Aggravate or Quickbloom. Higher refinements help.

w.name: Tidal Shadow
w.text: ATK bonus after healing. Requires reliable healing. R5 boosts ATK bonus.

w.name: Prototype Archaic

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Hexerei ATK and CRIT gains.
Aggravate and faster Skill taps.
EM and ATK for Quicken teams.

t.name: Hexerei Thunderpack
t.text: Unlock both Hexerei quests. Fischl enables Secret Rite; Nahida sustains Quicken, Baizhu heals, and Razor overflows Sigils during Burst.

t.name: Witchfire Overload
t.text: Unlocked Hexerei teammates activate Secret Rite. Chevreuse enables Electro-Pyro RES shred; Durin and Fischl support Razor damage.

t.name: Hexerei Quickbloom
t.text: Fischl enables Secret Rite; Nahida and Xingqiu generate Dendro Cores. Razor triggers some Hyperblooms; no dedicated healer.

t.name: High shelf main boss friends
t.text: Requires Bennett C6. Razor drives mixed Burgeon and Hyperbloom via Pyro-infused attacks and Burst Electro. No second Hexerei member.

why.v:
Hexerei Main: Finish Witch Homework on Razor and Fischl. Build ATK/Electro/CRIT; use Burst and Skill taps to overflow Sigils.
Quickbloom: Use Fischl, Nahida and Xingqiu; mix Electro and Hyperbloom. More EM can help, but watch sustain.
Physical DPS: Pale Flame, ATK/Physical/CRIT, Cryo teammate for Superconduct. Traditional sustained Normal Attack play.
Thundering Furry: Requires Bennett C6, Nahida and Xingqiu. Level 90 and triple EM; this does not trigger Secret Rite.
Hexerei C6: Razor C6 improves Sigil generation and grants CRIT bonuses after Sigil consumption. Strong with Secret Rite.

seo.about: Witch's Homework boosts Razor's Burst Electro damage. With another unlocked Hexerei ally, overflowing Skill sigils triggers extra Electro strikes and Energy. This main build favors Electro Aggravate; Physical and C6 Bennett reaction builds are alternatives.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.title: Hexerei Quickbloom
vars.stats: ATK% or EM sands; Electro goblet; prioritize CRIT, ER, then useful EM.
vars.teams: Razor and Fischl with completed Hexerei unlocks; Dendro and Hydro teammates.
vars.when: Use Burst and Skill taps to overflow Sigils; Hydro enables some Hyperblooms alongside Electro damage. Confirm energy and sustain.
vars.notes: No dedicated healer in Razor/Fischl/Nahida/Xingqiu. Reactions vary with elemental auras.

vars.title: Thundering Furry (C6 Bennett)
vars.stats: Level 90; EM/EM/EM; ER until Burst is reliable.
vars.teams: C6 Bennett, Dendro and Hydro (e.g. Nahida/Xingqiu).
vars.when: Bennett Pyro infusion plus Razor Burst Electro causes Burgeon, Hyperbloom and Overloaded. Stay in Bennett field.
vars.cond: Bennett C6 required
vars.notes: No Hexerei Secret Rite with this four-character composition.

vars.title: Physical Superconduct DPS
vars.stats: ATK% sands; Physical DMG goblet; CRIT circlet; adjust ER to team.
vars.teams: Cryo applier for Superconduct; Electro battery and sustain preferred.
vars.when: For traditional Razor gameplay. Keep Superconduct active and stay on-field during his Burst.
vars.cond: Better for players investing in Physical damage
vars.notes: Witch Homework still boosts Wolf Within, but this build prioritizes Physical hits.

vars.title: Hexerei C6 Sigil Carry

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

vars.stats: ATK%/Electro/CRIT; C6 supplies conditional CRIT after Sigil consumption.
vars.teams: Razor C6, Witch Homework completed, plus another unlocked Hexerei ally.
vars.when: Use C6-enhanced Sigil generation and Skill taps during Burst to trigger overflow strikes and maintain Energy.
vars.cond: Razor C6 and two unlocked Hexerei members
vars.notes: Extra CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG follow Sigil consumption; do not assume they are permanently active.

w.name: Hunter's Path
w.text: CRIT and EM-scaled Charged DMG. Premium best-in-slot; marginal over Slingshot.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: CRIT DMG and proximity-based damage. Stay close enough for its passive.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: CRIT DMG and Charged Attack bonus. Passive varies with party elements.

w.name: Skyward Harp
w.text: CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG stat stick. Solid alternative if already owned.

w.name: Slingshot
w.text: Big close-range Charged Attack buff. Stay close for passive; excellent 3-star. R5 recommended.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: CRIT Rate and Charged Attack mark. Mark requires Charged Attack to hit.

w.name: Ibis Piercer
w.text: Gains EM after Charged Attacks. Event-limited; stack the EM passive.

w.name: Cloudforged
w.text: EM bow; weaker than R5 Slingshot. Use only if stronger bows are missing.

a.text: EM and Charged Attack damage.
EM for Quicken teams.
Faster Burst Dusk Bolt attacks.

t.name: Sandstorm Aggravate
t.text: Fischl batteries Sethos, Kirara enables Quicken and shields, and Sucrose adds EM while shredding Electro RES. Swirl Electro before Dendro if needed.

t.name: Desert Thunder
t.text: Nahida supplies durable Quicken and EM; Fischl provides Energy, while Zhongli shields and shreds RES without relying on difficult Electro Swirls.

t.name: Twin Desert Archers
t.text: Alternate Sethos Shadowpiercing Shots with Tighnari Charged Shots. Fischl fuels Energy, and Baizhu keeps Quicken active with healing.

t.name: Budget Sandstorm
t.text: Accessible Aggravate core: Fischl batteries Sethos, Yaoyao heals and applies Dendro, and Sucrose shreds Electro RES and shares EM.

why.v:
Charged Shot: Skip Burst. Use quick Shadowpiercing Shots; Energy spent speeds charge time. Prefer Fischl and a short field window.
C6 Shot Cycle: C6 refunds Energy after a Shadowpiercing Shot once per 15s, easing the rapid-shot Energy budget.
Dual Archer: Pair with Tighnari for quickswap Quicken; alternate their short Charged Shot windows.
Burst Speed: Burst Dusk Bolts count as Charged Attack damage. Desert Pavilion trades flexibility for attack speed.

seo.about: Sethos is an Electro DPS built for Aggravate. His Burst turns Normal Attacks into piercing Dusk Bolts that deal Charged Attack damage. Alternatively, spend Energy on rapid Shadowpiercing Shots without using Burst.

vars.title: Shadowpiercing Quickswap
vars.stats: EM/Electro/CRIT; budget Energy for 3-4 enhanced shots. ER varies sharply by Skill count.
vars.teams: Strong Electro battery, preferably Fischl; Dendro for Quicken.
vars.when: Do not use Burst. Fire charged Shadowpiercing Shots, use Skill to regenerate Energy by triggering a reaction, then resume shooting.
vars.cond: Energy-hungry at C0; extra Skill or fewer shots improves consistency.
vars.notes: At C0, 1-Skill/Fischl Charged Shot cycles can need ~140-150% ER; 2 Skills can be near 100-110%.

vars.title: C6 Charged Shot Economy
vars.stats: EM/Electro/CRIT. C6 refunds Energy for one enhanced Shot every 15s.
vars.teams: Electro battery and Dendro support; stable reaction triggers on Skill.
vars.when: C6 enables a more forgiving 4-shot sequence or an extra fifth shot at some damage loss.
vars.cond: Requires C6.
vars.notes: Only the first four Shadowpiercing Shots can benefit from one A4 buff cycle.

vars.title: Tighnari Dual Carry
vars.stats: Favor rapid shots and shorter field time; adjust ER for repeated swaps.
vars.teams: Tighnari, Fischl and a Dendro sustain such as Baizhu.
vars.when: Alternate short Sethos charged-shot windows with Tighnari combos in a Quicken rotation.
vars.cond: Not for extended Burst Dusk Bolt field time.
vars.notes: Avoid firing Burst during Sethos charged-shot windows.

vars.title: Desert Pavilion Dusk Bolts
vars.stats: EM/Electro/CRIT; prioritize Burst talent and consistent Energy.
vars.teams: Fischl battery and a Dendro applicator; preserve full on-field Burst window.
vars.when: Use Burst to convert Normal Attacks into fast, piercing Dusk Bolts; cancel long third-attack animation.
vars.cond: Burst stance ends if Sethos switches out.
vars.notes: Dusk Bolts deal Charged Attack damage but retain Normal Attack action triggers.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: ER and teamwide particles. Requires on-field CRIT hits. R3+ helps rotations.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: High ER for reliable Burst uptime.

w.name: Freedom-Sworn
w.text: Team buffs if reactions trigger. Only when Energy is already covered.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Extra Skill after amulet collection. Collect old amulets before recasting. R3+ preferred.

w.name: Festering Desire
w.text: ER substat; modest Skill damage.

w.name: Amenoma Kageuchi
w.text: Self Energy after planned Skill casts. Requires multiple Skill uses before Burst. R3+ preferred.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: F2P ER and Skill CRIT Rate.

w.name: Skyrider Sword
w.text: Starter option with ER substat.

a.text: Buffs team ATK after Burst.
Energy support on a budget.
ER plus some Burst damage.

t.name: Stormcaller Battery
t.text: Traveler feeds Beidou Energy and shreds Electro RES at C2. Fischl generates particles; Xingqiu drives reactions with normal attacks.

t.name: Xiao Energy Relay
t.text: Traveler supplies Xiao with flat Energy and ER from amulets. Faruzan boosts Anemo damage; Bennett heals and buffs.

t.name: Eula Thunder Battery
t.text: Electro Traveler enables Superconduct and transfers Energy to Eula; Rosaria batteries Cryo and Mika provides sustain.

t.name: Broken Toaster
t.text: Burst follow-up strikes from Yoimiya normal hits can trigger Overloaded. Chevreuse buffs Pyro/Electro teams; time amulet pickup.

why.v:
Universal Battery: ER-first Favonius build. Let your energy-hungry carry collect Skill amulets.
Noblesse Buffer: Use 4pc Noblesse if no ally carries it; Burst before the main DPS window.
Exile Budget: 4pc The Exile gives team Energy on Burst; useful early-game option.
Beidou Battery: Pair with Beidou and another Electro battery; transfer amulets to Beidou.
Burst Sub DPS: Emblem and Electro/CRIT stats if team Energy is already secure.

seo.about: Electro Traveler is a universal Energy battery who gives allies flat Energy and Energy Recharge through Skill amulets and Burst follow-up strikes. Let the intended teammate collect amulets; the Traveler needs substantial ER to sustain their own costly Burst.

vars.title: Noblesse Team Battery
vars.stats: ER sands; prioritize ER and Favonius CRIT Rate over personal damage.
vars.teams: Best when no other teammate uses Noblesse Oblige.
vars.when: Burst before the main damage window; switch to the carry to collect amulets and restore Energy.

vars.title: Exile Budget Energy
vars.stats: Prioritize ER; 4-star artifact stats are naturally lower.
vars.teams: Teams needing cheap Energy support; suitable for early progression.
vars.when: Use Burst to grant extra team Energy, then Skill to place amulets for the selected teammate.

vars.title: Beidou Energy Partner
vars.stats: High ER for Traveler; CRIT Rate if holding Favonius.
vars.teams: Beidou plus a normal-attack driver; Fischl helps battery Traveler.
vars.when: Let Beidou collect Skill amulets. Burst follow-up strikes need the active character to hit with Normal or Charged Attacks.

vars.title: Emblem Burst Damage
vars.stats: ER sands, Electro goblet, CRIT circlet; meet Burst ER before offensive stats.
vars.teams: Needs external particles or Electro resonance to sustain Traveler Burst.
vars.when: Use when Energy needs are covered and you want incidental Burst damage rather than maximum battery utility.

vars.title: Skill Reset Utility
vars.stats: ER and on-field CRIT Rate for Favonius.
vars.teams: Teammates can pick up Skill amulets before a second Skill cast.
vars.when: Sacrificial reset enables another amulet cycle; new Skill erases any uncollected amulets.
vars.cond: Sacrificial passive proc and cooldown
vars.notes: A second Skill is not an automatic Energy gain unless amulets are actually collected.

w.name: Elegy for the End
w.text: ER plus teamwide EM and ATK buffs.

w.name: Polar Star
w.text: CRIT and Skill/Burst damage. Personal damage; needs extra attack inputs.

w.name: Favonius Warbow
w.text: CRIT hits generate team Energy. Build CRIT Rate to trigger passive.

w.name: Sacrificial Bow
w.text: Second Skill aids Dendro and Energy. Needs passive proc; adds field time.

w.name: The Stringless
w.text: EM plus Skill and Burst damage. Meet ER needs first.

w.name: Fading Twilight
w.text: ER and rotating damage bonus.

w.name: End of the Line
w.text: Fishable ER option for Burst uptime.

w.name: Raven Bow
w.text: Budget EM for Bloom reactions. ER requirement already met.

a.text: Shreds 30% Dendro RES on hits.
Burst grants 20% team ATK.
Grants team EM after reactions.

t.name: Hyperbloom Garden
t.text: Kokomi creates Bloom cores; full-EM Raiden triggers Hyperbloom. Both Dendro units maintain the aura. Raiden Skill should hit cores.

t.name: Tighnari Forestcall
t.text: Yae sustains Quicken for Tighnari Spread; Collei adds Dendro, energy, and support buffs while Zhongli protects. Collei can hold Deepwood.

t.name: Aggravate Sprouts
t.text: Collei keeps Quicken active for Keqing and Fischl Aggravates. Jean heals and shreds Electro RES with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Budget Bloom Circuit
t.text: Xingqiu supplies Hydro, Dendro teammates make cores, and full-EM Kuki heals and triggers Hyperbloom with her Skill.

why.v:
Deepwood Support: Default if no teammate holds Deepwood. Prioritize ER, then CRIT Rate for Favonius and personal damage.
Quicken Buffer: Use Noblesse or Instructor when Dendro RES shred is already covered; Elegy buffs team ATK and EM.
Pure Bloom: ER first, then EM where Collei owns Blooms. Dendro application uptime matters more than CRIT.
Personal Burst: With another Deepwood holder, invest in ER, Dendro DMG and CRIT; consider Stringless or Polar Star.
Budget Battery: Favonius Warbow or fishable End of the Line; double Dendro and enough ER help sustain Burst.

seo.about: Collei is a quickswap Dendro support who enables Bloom, Hyperbloom, Quicken and Spread with her boomerang Skill and off-field Burst. Prioritize enough Energy Recharge to maintain Dendro application; Elegy and support sets add team buffs.

vars.title: Quicken Team Buffer
vars.stats: ER sands; CRIT Rate with Favonius, then EM.
vars.teams: Electro damage dealer; ideally another Dendro RES shred source if Dendro damage matters.
vars.when: Use for Keqing, Clorinde, or other Aggravate teams when a second unit already carries Deepwood. Noblesse supports ATK-scaling Electro units.
vars.cond: Another unit must hold Deepwood if team needs Dendro RES shred.

vars.title: Pure Bloom Enabler
vars.stats: ER first; EM sands/goblet/circlet only if Collei owns significant Bloom reactions.
vars.teams: Reliable Hydro, and enough Dendro application for continuous cores.
vars.when: Use in Bloom teams to sustain Dendro and boost reaction damage. Do not assume Collei owns every Bloom; EM value depends on ownership.
vars.cond: ER and reaction ownership vary by team.

vars.title: Personal Burst Damage
vars.stats: ER to Burst consistently, then Dendro DMG, CRIT, ATK% and EM in Quicken.
vars.teams: Another character carrying Deepwood; Quicken helps personal Spread damage.
vars.when: Use when your team already provides Dendro RES shred and you want more from Collei’s Skill and Burst. Polar Star needs added attack inputs for stacks.
vars.cond: Not her default support build.

vars.title: F2P Energy Support
vars.stats: ER sands and CRIT Rate circlet with Favonius; otherwise flexible defensive/offensive stats.
vars.teams: Any Dendro reaction team; double Dendro or a battery lowers ER needs.
vars.when: Use a free or accessible ER bow to keep Burst available each rotation and maintain reaction support without premium equipment.
vars.cond: Favonius particles require a CRIT hit on-field.

vars.title: C2 Sprout Uptime
vars.stats: ER requirement first; personal damage remains secondary.
vars.teams: C2 Collei and a team that repeatedly triggers qualifying Dendro reactions.
vars.when: Use C2 to extend her off-field Sprout effect after Skill returns when a qualifying reaction occurs. Stay close enough for the ring to hit.
vars.cond: Requires Collei C2; extension can occur only once per Skill.

bosses.name: Wavebinder: Stormfang
bosses.mech:
Drinking builds Courage; Electro DMG drains it.
Stellar Glimmer Electro reactions drain more Courage.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Full Courage grants a shield and increased RES.
Depleting Courage removes the shield and deals massive backlash DMG.
bosses.beat:
Prioritize Electro DMG to drain Courage.
Trigger Stellar Glimmer reactions for faster Courage reduction.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Avoid wasting your strongest attacks against its shield.
Once Valiant Assault ends, unleash your strongest attacks during its backlash window.

bosses.name: Emperor of Fire and Iron
bosses.mech:
Pyro horns grant the boss massive RES to all elements.



Horns have greatly increased durability in Stygian Onslaught.



Sternshield Crabs can appear during the fight.



Watch for Radiant Coronation, a powerful AoE attack.
bosses.beat:
Bring a strong Hydro applicator to break the Pyro horns.



Focus on the horns before attacking the boss.



Once broken, the boss is stunned and loses its RES boost.



Use the stun window to unleash your strongest attacks.



Watch your positioning to avoid AoE attacks and crab pressure.

bosses.name: Radiant Moongecko
bosses.mech:
Geo shield has 18 layers on Dire; Geo and blunt attacks break it.



Shield break stuns the boss and lowers Geo RES from 70% to 10%.



Radiant Cocoon drains HP and reduces Crit Rate by 100%.



Healing everyone to 100% removes the debuff and grants 15% Crit Rate and 50% DMG.



Moonstone Anchor wards must be destroyed within 20 seconds or the boss gains 30% ATK.
bosses.beat:
Bring Geo or blunt attacks to break the shield quickly.



Use a strong team-wide healer to restore everyone to 100% HP.



Heal through Radiant Cocoon to remove the Crit Rate debuff and gain its damage bonus.



Destroy all Moonstone Anchor wards within 20 seconds.



Save your strongest attacks for the shield-break stun window.
